  // every click would let a network retry accidentally create another invoice.
  const invoiceIdempotencyKey =
    useRef<string | null>(
      null,
    );

  // Retain the shipment request key until a successful response so a retry
  // after a lost network response does not create a second shipment.
  const [customerPortalUrl, setCustomerPortalUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const shipmentIdempotencyKey =
    useRef<{
      orderId: string;
      key: string;
    } | null>(
      null,
    );

  const {
    overlay,
    closeOverlay,
    showSuccess,
    showError,
    showWarning,
  } =
    useSaMiOverlay();

  const staleCommissionWarningShownFor =
    useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!order.marginCommissionStale) {
      if (staleCommissionWarningShownFor.current === order.id) {
        staleCommissionWarningShownFor.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    if (staleCommissionWarningShownFor.current === order.id) {
      return;
    }

    staleCommissionWarningShownFor.current = order.id;
    showWarning(
      'Commission reversal needs attention',
      'This order has a received return while commission entries remain accrued. When the return reversal is processed, those commission rows will change. Review the commission ledger after processing.',
    );
  }, [order.id, order.marginCommissionStale, showWarning]);

  const isBusy =
    busy ||
    pending;

  async function run(
    payload:
      Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >,
    message:
      string,
  ) {
    if (
      inFlight.current
    ) {
      showWarning(
        'Action already in progress',
        'Another Sales action is still being saved.',
      );
      return null;
    }

    inFlight.current =
      true;

    setBusy(
      true,
    );

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales',
          {
            method:
              'POST',
            credentials:
              'same-origin',
            cache:
              'no-store',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type':
                'application/json',
            },
            body:
              JSON.stringify(
                payload,
              ),
          },
        );

      const body =
        await response
          .json()
          .catch(
            () => ({}),
          ) as {
            success?:
              boolean;
            error?:
              string;
            result?:
              Record<
                string,
                unknown
              >;
          };

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        body.success !==
          true
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          body.error ||
          'SaMi could not complete the Sales action.',
        );
      }

      showSuccess(
        'Action completed',
        message,
      );

      startTransition(
        () => {
          router.refresh();
        },
      );

      return body.result ||
        {};
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Sales action failed',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not complete the Sales action.',
      );

      return null;
    } finally {
      inFlight.current =
        false;

      setBusy(
        false,
      );
    }
  }

  async function createCustomerPortalLink() {
    const result = await run(
      { action: 'create_order_portal_link', orderId: order.id },
      'Customer tracking link created. Any previous link has been invalidated.',
    );
    if (!result) return;
    const tenantId = typeof result.tenantId === 'string' ? result.tenantId : '';
    const token = typeof result.token === 'string' ? result.token : '';
    if (!tenantId || !token) {
      showError('Link unavailable', 'SaMi did not return a valid customer portal link. Please try again.');
      return;
    }
    setCustomerPortalUrl(
      new URL('/order/' + encodeURIComponent(tenantId) + '/' + encodeURIComponent(token), window.location.origin).toString(),
    );
  }

  async function copyCustomerPortalLink() {
    if (!customerPortalUrl) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(customerPortalUrl);
      showSuccess('Link copied', 'The customer order tracking link is ready to share.');
    } catch {
      showWarning('Copy unavailable', 'Select the link field and copy it manually.');
    }
  }

  async function revokeCustomerPortalLink() {
    const result = await run(
      { action: 'revoke_order_portal_link', orderId: order.id },
      'Customer order tracking link revoked.',
    );
    if (result) setCustomerPortalUrl(null);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <SaMiOverlay
        {...overlay}
        onClose={
          closeOverlay
        }
      />

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {workspace.capabilities.canManageOrders && (
          <section className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4 sm:p-5">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Link2 className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">Customer tracking portal</h2>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                  Share a read-only order and shipment status page with the customer. Links expire after 90 days; rotating a link invalidates the previous one.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <button type="button" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => void createCustomerPortalLink()} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60">
                  <Link2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  {customerPortalUrl ? 'Rotate link' : 'Generate link'}
                </button>
                <button type="button" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => void revokeCustomerPortalLink()} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60">
                  Revoke link
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {customerPortalUrl && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                <input aria-label="Customer order tracking link" readOnly value={customerPortalUrl} onFocus={event => event.currentTarget.select()} className="h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-xs" />
                <button type="button" onClick={() => void copyCustomerPortalLink()} className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black">
                  <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />
                  Copy customer link
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        )}
        <section className="sami-surface rounded-[26px] p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300">
                Sales order
              </p>

              <h1 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black sm:text-2xl">
                {
                  order.orderNumber
                }
              </h1>

              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                {
                  order.customerName
                }
                {' · '}
                {
                  money(
                    order.totalAmount,
                    order.currency,
                  )
                }
              </p>

              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <State
                  label="Order"
                  value={
                    order.status
                  }
                />
                <State
                  label="Fulfillment"
                  value={
                    order.fulfillmentStatus
                  }
                />
                <State
                  label="Invoice"
                  value={
                    order.invoiceStatus
                  }
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Link
                href="/apps/sales"
                className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
              >
                Sales
              </Link>

              {
                order.quoteId &&
                (
                  <Link
                    href={
                      '/apps/sales/quotes/' +
                      order.quoteId
                    }
                    className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
                  >
                    Source quotation
                  </Link>
                )
              }
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {order.marginCommissionStale && (
          <div role="alert" className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-400/60 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-amber-950 dark:border-amber-500/40 dark:bg-amber-950/30 dark:text-amber-100">
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-black">Received return with accrued commissions</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5">
                This order has a received return while one or more commission entries remain accrued. Processing the related reversal will change those commission rows; review the commission ledger after the reversal is completed.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <section className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1fr_390px]">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <form
              className="sami-surface overflow-hidden rounded-[24px]"
              onSubmit={
                async event => {
                  event.preventDefault();

                  const form =
                    new FormData(
                      event.currentTarget,
                    );

                  await run(
                    {
                      action:
                        'update_fulfillment',
                      orderId:
                        order.id,
                      lines:
                        order.lines.map(
                          line => ({
                            lineId:
                              line.id,
                            deliveredQuantity:
                              form.get(
                                'delivered-' +
                                line.id,
                              ),
                          }),
                        ),
                    },
                    'Fulfillment quantities updated.',
                  );
                }
              }
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                    Order fulfillment
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Ordered, shipped, delivered and invoiceable quantities remain independently traceable.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {
                  workspace
                    .capabilities
                    .canManageOrders &&
                  order.status !==
                    'cancelled' &&
                  order.status !==
                    'closed' &&
                  (
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={
                        isBusy
                      }
                      className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      <Truck className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Save fulfillment
                    </button>
                  )
                }
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[1120px] text-sm">
                  <thead className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-left text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3">
                        Item
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Ordered
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Shipped
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Delivered
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Invoiced
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Returned
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Credited
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Invoiceable
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        Value
                      </th>
                      {workspace.capabilities.canViewMargin && (
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Cost / Margin
                        </th>
                      )}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                    {
                      order.lines.map(
                        line => (
                          <tr
                            key={
                              line.id
                            }
                          >
                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                              <p className="font-bold">
                                {
                                  line.description
                                }
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                {
                                  [
                                    line.sku,
                                    line.unit,
                                  ]
                                    .filter(
                                      Boolean,
                                    )
                                    .join(
                                      ' · ',
                                    )
                                }
                              </p>
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              {
                                line.quantity
                              }
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              {line.shippedQuantity}
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              {
                                workspace
                                  .capabilities
                                  .canManageOrders &&
                                order.status !==
                                  'cancelled' &&
                                order.status !==
                                  'closed'
                                  ? (
                                      <input
                                        name={
                                          'delivered-' +
                                          line.id
                                        }
                                        type="number"
                                        min={
                                          line.deliveredQuantity
                                        }
                                        max={
                                          line.quantity
                                        }
                                        step="0.0001"
                                        defaultValue={
                                          line.deliveredQuantity
                                        }
                                        className="h-9 w-24 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-right"
                                      />
                                    )
                                  : line.deliveredQuantity
                              }
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              {
                                line.invoicedQuantity
                              }
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              {
                                line.returnedQuantity
                              }
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              {
                                line.creditedQuantity
                              }
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-black text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                              {
                                line.invoiceableQuantity
                              }
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-black">
                              {
                                money(
                                  line.lineTotal,
                                  order.currency,
                                )
                              }
                            </td>
                            {workspace.capabilities.canViewMargin && (
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right align-top">
                                <div className="min-w-[150px] space-y-1">
                                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                    Cost: <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{line.costTotal == null ? '—' : money(line.costTotal, order.currency)}</span>
                                  </p>
                                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                    Margin: <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{line.marginAmount == null ? '—' : money(line.marginAmount, order.currency)}</span>
                                  </p>
                                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                                    {line.marginPercent == null ? '—' : line.marginPercent.toFixed(1) + '%'}
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              </td>
                            )}
                          </tr>
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </form>

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canManageShipping &&
              order.status !==
                'cancelled' &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      const lines =
                        order.lines
                          .map(
                            line => ({
                              lineId:
                                line.id,
                              quantity:
                                Number(
                                  form.get(
                                    'ship-' +
                                    line.id,
                                  ) ||
                                  0,
                                ),
                            }),
                          )
                          .filter(
                            line =>
                              line.quantity >
                              0,
                          );

                      const idempotencyKey =
                        shipmentIdempotencyKey.current?.orderId === order.id
                          ? shipmentIdempotencyKey.current.key
                          : (
                              globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ||
                              (
                                'sales-shipment-' +
                                order.id +
                                '-' +
                                Date.now().toString(36) +
                                '-' +
                                Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
                              )
                            );

                      shipmentIdempotencyKey.current = {
                        orderId: order.id,
                        key: idempotencyKey,
                      };

                      const result =
                        await run(
                          {
                            action:
                              'create_shipment',
                            orderId:
                              order.id,
                            idempotencyKey,
                            carrier:
                              form.get(
                                'carrier',
                              ),
                            serviceLevel:
                              form.get(
                                'serviceLevel',
                              ),
                            trackingNumber:
                              form.get(
                                'trackingNumber',
                              ),
                            trackingUrl:
                              form.get(
                                'trackingUrl',
                              ),
                            lines,
                          },
                          'Shipment created. Mark it shipped when goods leave Inventory.',
                        );

                      if (result) {
                        shipmentIdempotencyKey.current = null;
                        event.currentTarget
                          .reset();
                      }
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <PackageCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                        Create shipment
                      </h2>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        Split an order across multiple carrier shipments. Inventory posts only when the shipment is marked shipped/in transit/delivered.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <Field
                      name="carrier"
                      label="Carrier"
                    />
                    <Field
                      name="serviceLevel"
                      label="Service level"
                    />
                    <Field
                      name="trackingNumber"
                      label="Tracking number"
                    />
                    <Field
                      name="trackingUrl"
                      label="Tracking URL"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
                    {
                      order.lines.map(
                        line => {
                          const remaining =
                            Math.max(
                              0,
                              line.quantity -
                              line.shippedQuantity -
                              line.plannedQuantity,
                            );

                          return (
                            <label
                              key={
                                line.id
                              }
                              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                            >
                              <span className="min-w-0">
                                <span className="block truncate text-xs font-black">
                                  {
                                    line.description
                                  }
                                </span>
                                <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                  Up to {
                                    remaining
                                  } {
                                    line.unit
                                  } not yet shipped or assigned to a shipment
                                </span>
                              </span>
                              <input
                                name={
                                  'ship-' +
                                  line.id
                                }
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                max={
                                  remaining
                                }
                                step="0.0001"
                                defaultValue="0"
                                className="h-10 w-28 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-right text-sm"
                              />
                            </label>
                          );
                        },
                      )
                    }
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-4 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Create shipment
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }

            {
              order.shipments.length >
                0 &&
              (
                <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                    Shipments & tracking
                  </h2>

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                    {
                      order.shipments.map(
                        shipment => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              shipment.id
                            }
                            className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                          >
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                              <div>
                                <p className="text-xs font-black">
                                  {
                                    shipment.shipmentNumber
                                  }
                                </p>
                                <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                  {
                                    [
                                      shipment.carrier,
                                      shipment.serviceLevel,
                                      shipment.trackingNumber,
                                    ]
                                      .filter(
                                        Boolean,
                                      )
                                      .join(
                                        ' · ',
                                      ) ||
                                    'No tracking details'
                                  }
                                </p>
                              </div>
                              <State
                                label="Shipment"
                                value={
                                  shipment.status
                                }
                              />
                            </div>

                            {
                              workspace
                                .capabilities
                                .canManageShipping &&
                              ![
                                'delivered',
                                'cancelled',
                              ].includes(
                                shipment.status,
                              ) &&
                              (
                                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                  {
                                    shipment.status ===
                                      'ready' &&
                                    (
                                      <SmallAction
                                        disabled={
                                          isBusy
                                        }
                                        onClick={
                                          () =>
                                            void run(
                                              {
                                                action:
                                                  'update_shipment_status',
                                                shipmentId:
                                                  shipment.id,
                                                status:
                                                  'shipped',
                                              },
                                              'Shipment posted to Inventory and marked shipped.',
                                            )
                                        }
                                      >
                                        Mark shipped
                                      </SmallAction>
                                    )
                                  }
                                  {
                                    [
                                      'ready',
                                      'shipped',
                                    ].includes(
                                      shipment.status,
                                    ) &&
                                    (
                                      <SmallAction
                                        disabled={
                                          isBusy
                                        }
                                        onClick={
                                          () =>
                                            void run(
                                              {
                                                action:
                                                  'update_shipment_status',
                                                shipmentId:
                                                  shipment.id,
                                                status:
                                                  'in_transit',
                                              },
                                              'Shipment marked in transit.',
                                            )
                                        }
                                      >
                                        In transit
                                      </SmallAction>
                                    )
                                  }
                                  {
                                    [
                                      'ready',
                                      'shipped',
                                      'in_transit',
                                    ].includes(
                                      shipment.status,
                                    ) &&
                                    (
                                      <SmallAction
                                        disabled={
                                          isBusy
                                        }
                                        onClick={
                                          () =>
                                            void run(
                                              {
                                                action:
                                                  'update_shipment_status',
                                                shipmentId:
                                                  shipment.id,
                                                status:
                                                  'delivered',
                                              },
                                              'Shipment marked delivered.',
                                            )
                                        }
                                      >
                                        Delivered
                                      </SmallAction>
                                    )
                                  }
                                </div>
                              )
                            }
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            }

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canManageReturns &&
              order.status !==
                'cancelled' &&
              order.lines.some(
                line =>
                  line.deliveredQuantity >
                  0,
              ) &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      const lines =
                        order.lines
                          .map(
                            line => ({
                              lineId:
                                line.id,
                              quantity:
                                Number(
                                  form.get(
                                    'return-' +
                                    line.id,
                                  ) ||
                                  0,
                                ),
                            }),
                          )
                          .filter(
                            line =>
                              line.quantity >
                              0,
                          );

                      const result =
                        await run(
                          {
                            action:
                              'create_return',
                            orderId:
                              order.id,
                            reason:
                              form.get(
                                'returnReason',
                              ),
                            lines,
                          },
                          'Return request created.',
                        );

                      if (
                        result
                      ) {
                        event.currentTarget
                          .reset();
                      }
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                        Create return
                      </h2>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        Use this workflow instead of lowering delivered quantities. Receiving the return reverses Inventory; invoice credits are created separately.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <textarea
                    name="returnReason"
                    required
                    rows={3}
                    placeholder="Reason for return"
                    className="mt-4 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  />

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                    {
                      order.lines
                        .filter(
                          line =>
                            line.deliveredQuantity >
                            0,
                        )
                        .map(
                          line => (
                            <label
                              key={
                                line.id
                              }
                              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                            >
                              <span className="min-w-0">
                                <span className="block truncate text-xs font-black">
                                  {
                                    line.description
                                  }
                                </span>
                                <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                  Currently delivered {
                                    line.deliveredQuantity
                                  } {
                                    line.unit
                                  }
                                </span>
                              </span>
                              <input
                                name={
                                  'return-' +
                                  line.id
                                }
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                max={
                                  line.deliveredQuantity
                                }
                                step="0.0001"
                                defaultValue="0"
                                className="h-10 w-28 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-right text-sm"
                              />
                            </label>
                          ),
                        )
                    }
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-4 h-10 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Create return request
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }

            {
              order.returns.length >
                0 &&
              (
                <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                    Returns, credits & refunds
                  </h2>

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                    {
                      order.returns.map(
                        item => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              item.id
                            }
                            className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                          >
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                              <div>
                                <p className="text-xs font-black">
                                  {
                                    item.returnNumber
                                  }
                                </p>
                                <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                  {
                                    item.reason
                                  }
                                </p>
                              </div>
                              <State
                                label="Return"
                                value={
                                  item.status
                                }
                              />
                            </div>

                            {
                              workspace
                                .capabilities
                                .canManageReturns &&
                              (
                                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                  {
                                    item.status ===
                                      'requested' &&
                                    (
                                      <SmallAction
                                        disabled={
                                          isBusy
                                        }
                                        onClick={
                                          () =>
                                            void run(
                                              {
                                                action:
                                                  'approve_return',
                                                returnId:
                                                  item.id,
                                              },
                                              'Return approved.',
                                            )
                                        }
                                      >
                                        Approve
                                      </SmallAction>
                                    )
                                  }
                                  {
                                    item.status ===
                                      'approved' &&
                                    (
                                      <SmallAction
                                        disabled={
                                          isBusy
                                        }
                                        onClick={
                                          () =>
                                            void run(
                                              {
                                                action:
                                                  'receive_return',
                                                returnId:
                                                  item.id,
                                              },
                                              'Returned stock received and Inventory reversed.',
                                            )
                                        }
                                      >
                                        Receive stock
                                      </SmallAction>
                                    )
                                  }
                                  {
                                    item.status ===
                                      'received' &&
                                    (
                                      <SmallAction
                                        disabled={
                                          isBusy
                                        }
                                        onClick={
                                          () =>
                                            void run(
                                              {
                                                action:
                                                  'issue_return_credit',
                                                returnId:
                                                  item.id,
                                              },
                                              'Credit note created for invoiced returned quantities.',
                                            )
                                        }
                                      >
                                        Issue credit
                                      </SmallAction>
                                    )
                                  }
                                </div>
                              )
                            }

                            {
                              item.credits.length >
                                0 &&
                              (
                                <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                                  {
                                    item.credits.map(
                                      credit => (
                                        <div
                                          key={
                                            credit.id
                                          }
                                          className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-500/5 p-2.5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
                                        >
                                          <div>
                                            <p className="text-[10px] font-black">
                                              {
                                                credit.creditNoteNumber
                                              }
                                            </p>
                                            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                              Available refund {
                                                money(
                                                  credit.availableCredit,
                                                  order.currency,
                                                )
                                              }
                                            </p>
                                          </div>

                                          {
                                            workspace
                                              .capabilities
                                              .canManageReturns &&
                                            credit.availableCredit >
                                              0 &&
                                            (
                                              <SmallAction
                                                disabled={
                                                  isBusy
                                                }
                                                onClick={
                                                  () =>
                                                    void run(
                                                      {
                                                        action:
                                                          'refund_return_credit',
                                                        returnCreditId:
                                                          credit.id,
                                                        amount:
                                                          credit.availableCredit,
                                                        method:
                                                          'bank',
                                                        reason:
                                                          'Refund for Sales return',
                                                        idempotencyKey:
                                                          globalThis.crypto
                                                            ?.randomUUID?.(),
                                                      },
                                                      'Available customer credit refunded.',
                                                    )
                                                }
                                              >
                                                Refund
                                              </SmallAction>
                                            )
                                          }
                                        </div>
                                      ),
                                    )
                                  }
                                </div>
                              )
                            }
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            }

            <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
              <InfoCard
                title="Billing address"
                value={
                  order.billingAddress
                }
              />
              <InfoCard
                title="Shipping address"
                value={
                  order.shippingAddress
                }
              />
              <InfoCard
                title="Notes"
                value={
                  order.notes
                }
              />
              <InfoCard
                title="Terms"
                value={
                  order.terms
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                Order history
              </h2>

              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                {
                  order.history.map(
                    item => (
                      <div
                        key={
                          item.id
                        }
                        className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] pb-2 last:border-0"
                      >
                        <p className="text-xs font-black">
                          {
                            item.fromStatus
                              ? item.fromStatus +
                                ' → '
                              : ''
                          }
                          {
                            item.toStatus
                          }
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                          {
                            item.createdAt
                          }
                          {
                            item.reason
                              ? ' · ' +
                                item.reason
                              : ''
                          }
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <aside className="space-y-4">
            <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                Order summary
              </h2>

              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-sm">
                <Summary
                  label="Subtotal"
                  value={
                    money(
                      order.subtotal,
                      order.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Discount"
                  value={
                    '− ' +
                    money(
                      order.discountTotal,
                      order.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Tax"
                  value={
                    money(
                      order.taxTotal,
                      order.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Shipping"
                  value={
                    money(
                      order.shippingTotal,
                      order.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-3">
                  <span className="font-black">
                    Total
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-black text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                    {
                      money(
                        order.totalAmount,
                        order.currency,
                      )
                    }
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {workspace.capabilities.canViewMargin && (
                <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-4">
                  <h3 className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">Cost / margin summary</h3>
                  <Summary
                    label="Cost total"
                    value={order.costTotal == null ? '—' : money(order.costTotal, order.currency)}
                  />
                  <Summary
                    label="Margin amount"
                    value={order.marginAmount == null ? '—' : money(order.marginAmount, order.currency)}
                  />
                  <Summary
                    label="Margin %"
                    value={order.marginPercent == null ? '—' : order.marginPercent.toFixed(1) + '%'}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canManageDeposits &&
              (
                <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <BadgeDollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                    <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                      Customer deposit
                    </h2>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-sm">
                    <Summary
                      label="Required"
                      value={
                        money(
                          order.depositRequiredAmount,
                          order.currency,
                        )
                      }
                    />
                    <Summary
                      label="Received"
                      value={
                        money(
                          order.depositReceivedAmount,
                          order.currency,
                        )
                      }
                    />
                    <Summary
                      label="Status"
                      value={
                        order.depositStatus
                      }
                    />
                  </div>

                  {
                    order.depositReceivedAmount <=
                      0 &&
                    (
                      <>
                        <form
                          className="mt-4 space-y-3 border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-4"
                          onSubmit={
                            async event => {
                              event.preventDefault();

                              const form =
                                new FormData(
                                  event.currentTarget,
                                );

                              await run(
                                {
                                  action:
                                    'set_deposit_requirement',
                                  orderId:
                                    order.id,
                                  depositType:
                                    form.get(
                                      'depositType',
                                    ),
                                  depositValue:
                                    form.get(
                                      'depositValue',
                                    ),
                                },
                                'Deposit requirement updated.',
                              );
                            }
                          }
                        >
                          <label className="block">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                              Requirement
                            </span>
                            <select
                              name="depositType"
                              defaultValue={
                                order.depositType
                              }
                              className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-xs"
                            >
                              <option value="none">
                                No deposit
                              </option>
                              <option value="percent">
                                Percentage
                              </option>
                              <option value="fixed">
                                Fixed amount
                              </option>
                            </select>
                          </label>

                          <Field
                            name="depositValue"
                            label="Percent or fixed amount"
                            type="number"
                            defaultValue={
                              String(
                                order.depositValue,
                              )
                            }
                          />

                          <button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={
                              isBusy
                            }
                            className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
                          >
                            Save deposit requirement
                          </button>
                        </form>

                        {
                          order.depositRequiredAmount >
                            0 &&
                          (
                            <form
                              className="mt-4 space-y-3 border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-4"
                              onSubmit={
                                async event => {
                                  event.preventDefault();

                                  const form =
                                    new FormData(
                                      event.currentTarget,
                                    );

                                  await run(
                                    {
                                      action:
                                        'record_order_deposit',
                                      orderId:
                                        order.id,
                                      amount:
                                        form.get(
                                          'depositAmount',
                                        ),
                                      method:
                                        form.get(
                                          'depositMethod',
                                        ),
                                      reference:
                                        form.get(
                                          'depositReference',
                                        ),
                                      idempotencyKey:
                                        globalThis.crypto
                                          ?.randomUUID?.(),
                                    },
                                    'Customer deposit recorded through Invoicing.',
                                  );
                                }
                              }
                            >
                              <Field
                                name="depositAmount"
                                label="Amount received"
                                type="number"
                                defaultValue={
                                  String(
                                    order.depositRequiredAmount,
                                  )
                                }
                                required
                              />
                              <Field
                                name="depositMethod"
                                label="Payment method"
                                defaultValue="bank"
                                required
                              />
                              <Field
                                name="depositReference"
                                label="Payment reference"
                              />

                              <button
                                type="submit"
                                disabled={
                                  isBusy
                                }
                                className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                              >
                                Record deposit
                              </button>
                            </form>
                          )
                        }
                      </>
                    )
                  }

                  {
                    order.depositPaymentId &&
                    order.invoices.some(
                      item =>
                        Boolean(
                          item.invoiceId,
                        ),
                    ) &&
                    order.depositStatus !==
                      'applied' &&
                    (
                      <form
                        className="mt-4 space-y-3 border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-4"
                        onSubmit={
                          async event => {
                            event.preventDefault();

                            const form =
                              new FormData(
                                event.currentTarget,
                              );

                            await run(
                              {
                                action:
                                  'apply_order_deposit',
                                orderId:
                                  order.id,
                                invoiceId:
                                  form.get(
                                    'depositInvoiceId',
                                  ),
                                amount:
                                  form.get(
                                    'depositApplyAmount',
                                  ) ||
                                  undefined,
                              },
                              'Deposit allocated to the selected invoice.',
                            );
                          }
                        }
                      >
                        <p className="text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-500">
                          Confirm the invoice in Invoicing first, then apply the customer deposit against its open balance.
                        </p>

                        <select
                          name="depositInvoiceId"
                          required
                          className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-xs"
                        >
                          <option value="">
                            Choose invoice
                          </option>
                          {
                            order.invoices
                              .filter(
                                item =>
                                  Boolean(
                                    item.invoiceId,
                                  ),
                              )
                              .map(
                                item => (
                                  <option
                                    key={
                                      item.batchId
                                    }
                                    value={
                                      item.invoiceId ||
                                      ''
                                    }
                                  >
                                    {
                                      item.sourceReference
                                    }
                                  </option>
                                ),
                              )
                          }
                        </select>

                        <Field
                          name="depositApplyAmount"
                          label="Amount to apply (blank = maximum)"
                          type="number"
                        />

                        <button
                          type="submit"
                          disabled={
                            isBusy
                          }
                          className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
                        >
                          Apply deposit to invoice
                        </button>
                      </form>
                    )
                  }
                </div>
              )
            }

            <div className="sami-soft-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                Invoice policy
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-black">
                {
                  workspace.settings
                    .invoicePolicy ===
                    'delivered'
                    ? 'Delivered quantities'
                    : 'Ordered quantities'
                }
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                {
                  workspace.settings
                    .allowPartialInvoicing
                    ? 'Partial invoicing is allowed.'
                    : 'Partial invoicing is disabled.'
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canManageOrders &&
              order.status !==
                'cancelled' &&
              order.lines.some(
                line =>
                  line.invoiceableQuantity >
                  0,
              ) &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      const lines =
                        order.lines
                          .map(
                            line => ({
                              lineId:
                                line.id,
                              quantity:
                                Number(
                                  form.get(
                                    'invoice-' +
                                    line.id,
                                  ) ||
                                  0,
                                ),
                            }),
                          )
                          .filter(
                            line =>
                              line.quantity >
                              0,
                          );

                      const idempotencyKey =
                        invoiceIdempotencyKey.current ||
                        globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ||
                        (
                          'sales-invoice-' +
                          order.id +
                          '-' +
                          Date.now().toString(36) +
                          '-' +
                          Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
                        );

                      invoiceIdempotencyKey.current =
                        idempotencyKey;

                      const result = await run(
                        {
                          action:
                            'create_order_invoice',
                          orderId:
                            order.id,
                          idempotencyKey,
                          exchangeRate:
                            order.currency ===
                              workspace.company.currency
                              ? 1
                              : Number(
                                  form.get(
                                    'exchangeRate',
                                  ) ||
                                  0,
                                ),
                          lines,
                        },
                        'Draft invoice created from the sales order.',
                      );

                      if (result) {
                        invoiceIdempotencyKey.current = null;
                      }
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Receipt className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                    <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                      Create invoice
                    </h2>
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                    Choose remaining invoiceable quantities. SaMi prevents duplicate batches and over-invoicing.
                  </p>

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                    {
                      order.lines
                        .filter(
                          line =>
                            line.invoiceableQuantity >
                            0,
                        )
                        .map(
                          line => (
                            <label
                              key={
                                line.id
                              }
                              className="block rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                            >
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-black">
                                {
                                  line.description
                                }
                              </span>
                              <input
                                name={
                                  'invoice-' +
                                  line.id
                                }
                                type="number"
                                min={
                                  workspace
                                    .settings
                                    .allowPartialInvoicing
                                    ? '0'
                                    : String(
                                        line.invoiceableQuantity,
                                      )
                                }
                                max={
                                  line.invoiceableQuantity
                                }
                                step="0.0001"
                                defaultValue={
                                  line.invoiceableQuantity
                                }
                                className="mt-2 h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
                              />
                            </label>
                          ),
                        )
                    }
                  </div>

                  {
                    order.currency !==
                      workspace.company.currency &&
                    (
                      <label className="mt-3 block rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                          Exchange rate
                        </span>
                        <input
                          name="exchangeRate"
                          type="number"
                          min="0.00000001"
                          step="0.00000001"
                          required
                          placeholder={
                            '1 ' +
                            order.currency +
                            ' in ' +
                            workspace.company.currency
                          }
                          className="mt-2 h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
                        />
                        <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-400">
                          The rate is snapshotted on the invoice and used for accounting postings.
                        </span>
                      </label>
                    )
                  }

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-3 h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Create draft invoice
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }

            <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                Invoice batches
              </h2>

              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                {
                  order.invoices.length ===
                    0
                    ? (
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                          No invoices created from this order yet.
                        </p>
                      )
                    : order.invoices.map(
                        batch => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              batch.batchId
                            }
                            className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                          >
                            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-400">
                              {
                                batch.status
                              }
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold">
                              {
                                batch.sourceReference
                              }
                            </p>
                            {
                              batch.invoiceId &&
                              (
                                <Link
                                  href={
                                    '/apps/invoicing/' +
                                    batch.invoiceId
                                  }
                                  className="mt-2 inline-block text-xs font-black text-blue-700 hover:underline dark:text-blue-300"
                                >
                                  Open invoice
                                </Link>
                              )
                            }
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                }
              </div>
            </div>

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canManageOrders &&
              order.status !==
                'cancelled' &&
              order.invoicedPercent ===
                0 &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      await run(
                        {
                          action:
                            'cancel_order',
                          orderId:
                            order.id,
                          reason:
                            form.get(
                              'reason',
                            ),
                        },
                        'Sales order cancelled.',
                      );
                    }
                  }
                >
