'use client';

import {
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from 'react';

import type {
  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';


type Pricelist = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  code: string | null;
  currency: string;
  billingCustomerId: string | null;
  validFrom: string | null;
  validUntil: string | null;
  priority: number;
  isActive: boolean;
};

export default function SalesPricelistsManager({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data: SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy: boolean;
  request: (
    payload:
      Record<string, unknown>,
  ) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  showSuccess: (
    title: string,
    message: string,
  ) => void;
  showError: (
    title: string,
    message: string,
  ) => void;
}) {
  const [
    pricelists,
    setPricelists,
  ] =
    useState<Pricelist[]>([]);

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(true);

  const [
    selected,
    setSelected,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    name,
    setName,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    code,
    setCode,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    currency,
    setCurrency,
  ] =
    useState(
      data.settings
        .defaultCurrency ||
      data.company.currency,
    );

  const [
    customerId,
    setCustomerId,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    validFrom,
    setValidFrom,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    validUntil,
    setValidUntil,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    priority,
    setPriority,
  ] =
    useState('100');

  const [
    active,
    setActive,
  ] =
    useState(true);

  async function refresh() {
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales?commercial=1',
          {
            cache:
              'no-store',
            credentials:
              'same-origin',
          },
        );

      const body =
        await response.json()
          .catch(
            () => ({}),
          ) as {
            success?: boolean;
            error?: string;
            commercial?: {
              pricelists?: Pricelist[];
            };
          };

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        body.success !==
          true
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          body.error ||
          'SaMi could not load pricelists.',
        );
      }

      setPricelists(
        body.commercial
          ?.pricelists ||
        [],
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Pricelists unavailable',
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not load pricelists.',
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(
    () => {
      void refresh();
    },
    [],
  );

  function reset() {
    setSelected('');
    setName('');
    setCode('');
    setCurrency(
      data.settings
        .defaultCurrency ||
      data.company.currency,
    );
    setCustomerId('');
    setValidFrom('');
    setValidUntil('');
    setPriority('100');
    setActive(true);
  }

  function load(
    id:
      string,
  ) {
    setSelected(id);

    const item =
      pricelists.find(
        row =>
          row.id ===
          id,
      );

    if (
      !item
    ) {
      reset();
      return;
    }

    setName(item.name);
    setCode(
      item.code ||
      '',
    );
    setCurrency(
      item.currency,
    );
    setCustomerId(
      item.billingCustomerId ||
      '',
    );
    setValidFrom(
      item.validFrom ||
      '',
    );
    setValidUntil(
      item.validUntil ||
      '',
    );
    setPriority(
      String(
        item.priority,
      ),
    );
    setActive(
      item.isActive,
    );
  }

  async function save() {
    try {
      await request({
        action:
          'save_pricelist',
        id:
          selected ||
          undefined,
        name,
        code:
          code ||
          undefined,
        currency,
        billingCustomerId:
          customerId ||
          undefined,
        validFrom:
          validFrom ||
          undefined,
        validUntil:
          validUntil ||
          undefined,
        priority:
          Number(
            priority,
          ),
        isActive:
          active,
      });

      showSuccess(
        'Pricelist saved',
        'Pricelist scope and validity were updated without replacing advanced pricing rules.',
      );

      reset();
      await refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Pricelist save failed',
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save the pricelist.',
      );
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">
          Roadmap Part 8
        </p>
        <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">
          Pricelists
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">
          Control customer scope, currency, validity and precedence separately from the advanced product and quantity rules in Part 9.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <select
            value={
              selected
            }
            disabled={
              loading
            }
            onChange={
              event =>
                load(
                  event.target.value,
                )
            }
            className="h-10 min-w-64 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-xs"
          >
            <option value="">
              New pricelist
            </option>
            {
              pricelists.map(
                item => (
                  <option
                    key={
                      item.id
                    }
                    value={
                      item.id
                    }
                  >
                    {
                      item.name
                    } · {
                      item.currency
                    }
                  </option>
                ),
              )
            }
          </select>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={
                reset
              }
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
            >
              <Plus
                className="h-4 w-4"
              />
              New
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={
                refresh
              }
              disabled={
                loading
              }
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <RefreshCw
                className="h-4 w-4"
              />
              Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <Field
            label="Name"
            value={
              name
            }
            onChange={
              setName
            }
          />
          <Field
            label="Code"
            value={
              code
            }
            onChange={
              setCode
            }
          />
          <Field
            label="Currency"
            value={
              currency
            }
            onChange={
              value =>
                setCurrency(
                  value
                    .toUpperCase()
                    .slice(
                      0,
                      3,
                    ),
                )
            }
          />
          <Field
            label="Priority"
            type="number"
            value={
              priority
            }
            onChange={
              setPriority
            }
          />

          <label className="block">
            <span className="text-xs font-black">
              Customer
            </span>
            <select
              value={
                customerId
              }
              onChange={
                event =>
                  setCustomerId(
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }
              className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="">
                All customers
              </option>
              {
                data.billingCustomers.map(
                  customer => (
                    <option
                      key={
                        customer.id
                      }
                      value={
                        customer.id
                      }
                    >
                      {
                        customer.name
                      }
                    </option>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </select>
          </label>

          <Field
            label="Valid from"
            type="date"
            value={
              validFrom
            }
            onChange={
              setValidFrom
            }
          />
          <Field
            label="Valid until"
            type="date"
            value={
              validUntil
            }
            onChange={
              setValidUntil
            }
          />

          <label className="mt-5 flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={
                active
              }
              onChange={
                event =>
                  setActive(
                    event.target.checked,
                  )
              }
            />
            Active pricelist
          </label>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={
              busy ||
              loading ||
              !name.trim()
            }
            onClick={
              save
            }
            className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            Save pricelist
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


function Field({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  type =
    'text',
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) => void;
  type?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="text-xs font-black">
        {
          label
        }
      </span>
      <input
        type={
          type
        }
        value={
          value
        }
        onChange={
          event =>
            onChange(
              event.target.value,
            )
        }
        className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}

'use client';

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';

import {
  Plus,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';

import type {
  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';

type Rule = {
  key: string;
  catalogItemId: string;
  minQuantity: string;
  calculation:
    'fixed' |
    'discount_percent' |
    'markup_percent';
  amount: string;
  priority: string;
};

type CommercialPricelist = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  code: string | null;
  currency: string;
  billingCustomerId: string | null;
  validFrom: string | null;
  validUntil: string | null;
  priority: number;
  isActive: boolean;
  rules: Array<{
    id?: string;
    catalogItemId?: string | null;
    minQuantity?: number | string;
    calculation?: string;
    amount?: number | string;
    priority?: number | string;
  }>;
};

function key() {
  return globalThis.crypto
    ?.randomUUID?.() ||
    Math.random()
      .toString(36)
      .slice(2);
}

function blankRule():
  Rule {
  return {
    key:
      key(),
    catalogItemId:
      '',
    minQuantity:
      '1',
    calculation:
      'fixed',
    amount:
      '0',
    priority:
      '100',
  };
}

function normalizeRule(
  rule:
    CommercialPricelist['rules'][number],
): Rule {
  const calculation =
    rule.calculation ===
      'discount_percent' ||
    rule.calculation ===
      'markup_percent'
      ? rule.calculation
      : 'fixed';

  return {
    key:
      rule.id ||
      key(),
    catalogItemId:
      rule.catalogItemId ||
      '',
    minQuantity:
      String(
        rule.minQuantity ??
        1,
      ),
    calculation,
    amount:
      String(
        rule.amount ??
        0,
      ),
    priority:
      String(
        rule.priority ??
        100,
      ),
  };
}

export default function SalesPricingManager({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy:
    boolean;
  request:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >
      >;
  showSuccess:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  showError:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  const [
    pricelists,
    setPricelists,
  ] =
    useState<
      CommercialPricelist[]
    >([]);

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );

  const [
    selectedId,
    setSelectedId,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    name,
    setName,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    code,
    setCode,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    currency,
    setCurrency,
  ] =
    useState(
      data.settings
        .defaultCurrency ||
      data.company.currency,
    );

  const [
    customerId,
    setCustomerId,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    validFrom,
    setValidFrom,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    validUntil,
    setValidUntil,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    priority,
    setPriority,
  ] =
    useState(
      '100',
    );

  const [
    active,
    setActive,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );

  const [
    rules,
    setRules,
  ] =
    useState<
      Rule[]
    >([
      blankRule(),
    ]);

  async function refresh() {
    setLoading(
      true,
    );

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales?commercial=1',
          {
            cache:
              'no-store',
            credentials:
              'same-origin',
          },
        );

      const body =
        await response
          .json()
          .catch(
            () => ({}),
          ) as {
            success?:
              boolean;
            error?:
              string;
            commercial?: {
              pricelists?:
                CommercialPricelist[];
            };
          };

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        body.success !==
          true
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          body.error ||
          'SaMi could not load Sales pricelists.',
        );
      }

      setPricelists(
        body.commercial
          ?.pricelists ||
        [],
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Pricelists unavailable',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not load Sales pricelists.',
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(
        false,
      );
    }
  }

  useEffect(
    () => {
      void refresh();
    },
    [],
  );

  const selected =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        pricelists.find(
          item =>
            item.id ===
            selectedId,
        ) ||
        null,
      [
        pricelists,
        selectedId,
      ],
    );

  function reset() {
    setSelectedId(
      '',
    );
    setName(
      '',
    );
    setCode(
      '',
    );
    setCurrency(
      data.settings
        .defaultCurrency ||
      data.company.currency,
    );
    setCustomerId(
      '',
    );
    setValidFrom(
      '',
    );
    setValidUntil(
      '',
    );
    setPriority(
      '100',
    );
    setActive(
      true,
    );
    setRules([
      blankRule(),
    ]);
  }

  function load(
    id:
      string,
  ) {
    setSelectedId(
      id,
    );

    const item =
      pricelists.find(
        candidate =>
          candidate.id ===
          id,
      );

    if (
      !item
    ) {
      reset();

      return;
    }

    setName(
      item.name,
    );
    setCode(
      item.code ||
      '',
    );
    setCurrency(
      item.currency,
    );
    setCustomerId(
      item.billingCustomerId ||
      '',
    );
    setValidFrom(
      item.validFrom ||
      '',
    );
    setValidUntil(
      item.validUntil ||
      '',
    );
    setPriority(
      String(
        item.priority,
      ),
    );
    setActive(
      item.isActive,
    );
    setRules(
      item.rules.length >
        0
        ? item.rules.map(
            normalizeRule,
          )
        : [
            blankRule(),
          ],
    );
  }

  function patchRule(
    index:
      number,
    patch:
      Partial<Rule>,
  ) {
    setRules(
      current =>
        current.map(
          (
            rule,
            position,
          ) =>
            position ===
              index
              ? {
                  ...rule,
                  ...patch,
                }
              : rule,
        ),
    );
  }

  async function submit(
    event:
      React.FormEvent<
        HTMLFormElement
      >,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    try {
      await request({
        action:
          'save_pricelist',
        id:
          selectedId ||
          undefined,
        name,
        code:
          code ||
          undefined,
        currency,
        billingCustomerId:
          customerId ||
          undefined,
        validFrom:
          validFrom ||
          undefined,
        validUntil:
          validUntil ||
          undefined,
        priority:
          Number(
            priority,
          ),
        isActive:
          active,
        rules:
          rules.map(
            rule => ({
              catalogItemId:
                rule.catalogItemId ||
                undefined,
              minQuantity:
                Number(
                  rule.minQuantity,
                ),
              calculation:
                rule.calculation,
              amount:
                Number(
                  rule.amount,
                ),
              priority:
                Number(
                  rule.priority,
                ),
            }),
          ),
      });

      showSuccess(
        'Pricelist saved',
        'Sales pricing rules were updated.',
      );

      reset();
      await refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Pricelist save failed',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save the pricelist.',
      );
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 xl:col-span-2">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-start lg:justify-between">

          <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
            Commercial pricing
          </p>
          <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-black">
            Pricelists & quantity rules
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-500">
            Set customer, product and quantity pricing without changing the base catalog. Rules are applied server-side when a quotation is saved.
          </p>

          value={
            selectedId
          }
          onChange={
            event =>
              load(
                event.target.value,
              )
          }
          disabled={
            loading
          }
          className="h-10 min-w-64 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-xs"

          <option value="">
            New pricelist
          </option>

                  key={
                    item.id
                  }

                    item.id
                  }
                >
                  {
                    item.name
                  } · {
                    item.currency
                  }
                  {
                    item.isActive
                      ? ''
                      : ' · inactive'
                  }
                </option>
              ),
            )
          }
        </select>
      </div>

      {
        selected &&
        (
          <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
            Editing {
              selected.name
            }. Saving replaces its pricing rules atomically.
          </p>
        )
      }

      <form
        onSubmit={
          submit
        }
        className="mt-4 space-y-4"
      >
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <Field
            label="Name"
            value={
              name
            }
            onChange={
              setName
            }
            required
          />
          <Field
            label="Code"
            value={
              code
            }
            onChange={
              setCode
            }
          />
          <Field
            label="Currency"
            value={
              currency
            }
            onChange={
              value =>
                setCurrency(
                  value
                    .toUpperCase()
                    .slice(
                      0,
                      3,
                    ),
                )
            }
            required
          />
          <Field
            label="Priority"
            value={
              priority
            }
            onChange={
              setPriority
            }
            type="number"
          />

          <label className="block">
            <Label>
              Customer
            </Label>
            <select
              value={
                customerId
              }
              onChange={

                  setCustomerId(
                    event.target.value,

function Label({
  children,
}: {
  children:
    React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
      {
        children
      }
    </span>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  type =
    'text',
  required =
    false,
  compact =
    false,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
  onChange:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  type?:
    string;
  required?:
    boolean;
  compact?:
    boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <Label>
        {
          label
        }
      </Label>
      <input
        type={
          type
        }
        value={
          value
        }
        onChange={
          event =>
            onChange(
              event.target.value,
            )
        }
        required={
          required
        }
        min={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0'
            : undefined
        }
        step={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0.01'
            : undefined
        }
        className={
          'mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm ' +
          (
            compact
              ? 'h-10'
              : 'h-11'
          )
        }
      />
    </label>
  );
}

'use client';

  Box,

  Upload,

  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,

  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';


type Item =
  SalesWorkspaceData[
    'catalogItems'
  ][number];

type Draft = {
  itemId:
    string;
  itemType:
    string;
  name:
    string;
  sku:
    string;
  description:
    string;
  unit:
    string;
  unitPrice:
    string;
  unitCost:
    string;
  taxRateId:
    string;
};

type VariantDraft = {
  variantId: string;
  sku: string;
  attributes: string;
  unitPrice: string;
  unitCost: string;
};

function blankVariant(unitPrice = ''): VariantDraft {
  return { variantId: '', sku: '', attributes: '', unitPrice, unitCost: '' };
}

function variantFromItem(item: Item): VariantDraft {
  return {
    variantId: item.variantId || '',
    sku: item.sku || '',
    attributes: item.variantAttributes.map(attribute => attribute.name + '=' + attribute.value).join('\n'),
    unitPrice: String(item.unitPrice),
    unitCost: item.unitCost === null ? '' : String(item.unitCost),
  };
}

function parseVariantAttributes(value: string): Array<{ name: string; value: string }> {
  const attributes = value.split(/\r?\n/).map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(line => {
    const split = line.indexOf('=');
    if (split < 1 || !line.slice(0, split).trim() || !line.slice(split + 1).trim()) {
      throw new Error('Enter each variant attribute on its own line as Name=Value, for example Color=Blue.');
    }
    return { name: line.slice(0, split).trim(), value: line.slice(split + 1).trim() };
  });
  if (!attributes.length) throw new Error('Add at least one variant attribute, such as Color=Blue.');
  if (attributes.length > 12) throw new Error('A variant can have at most 12 attributes.');
  return attributes;
}

function blank(defaultTaxRateId = ''): Draft {
  return {
    itemId:
      '',
    itemType:
      'product',
    name:
      '',
    sku:
      '',
    description:
      '',
    unit:
      'unit',
    unitPrice:
      '',
    unitCost:
      '',
    taxRateId:
      defaultTaxRateId,
  };
}

function fromItem(
  item:
    Item,
): Draft {
  return {
    itemId:
      item.id,
    itemType:
      item.itemType,
    name:
      item.name,
    sku:
      item.sku ||
      '',
    description:
      item.description ||
      '',
    unit:
      item.unit,
    unitPrice:
      String(
        item.unitPrice,
      ),
    unitCost:
      item.unitCost === null ? '' : String(item.unitCost),
    taxRateId:
      item.taxRateId ||
      '',
  };
}


function parseCsv(text: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let row: string[] = [];
  let cell = '';
  let quoted = false;
  const source = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
  for (let index = 0; index < source.length; index += 1) {
    const char = source[index];
    if (quoted) {
      if (char === '"' && source[index + 1] === '"') {
        cell += '"';
        index += 1;
      } else if (char === '"') {
        quoted = false;
      } else {
        cell += char;
      }
    } else if (char === '"' && cell.length === 0) {
      quoted = true;
    } else if (char === ',') {
      row.push(cell);
      cell = '';
    } else if (char === '\n') {
      row.push(cell.replace(/\r$/, ''));
      if (row.some(value => value.trim())) rows.push(row);
      row = [];
      cell = '';
    } else {
      cell += char;
    }
  }
  row.push(cell.replace(/\r$/, ''));
  if (row.some(value => value.trim())) rows.push(row);
  if (quoted) throw new Error('The CSV file has an unclosed quoted field.');
  return rows;
}

function csvCell(value: unknown): string {
  const text = String(value ?? '');
  return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : text;
}

function downloadCsv(filename: string, rows: unknown[][]) {
  const csv = rows.map(row => row.map(csvCell).join(',')).join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF', csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement('a');
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = filename;
  anchor.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}


export default function SalesProductCatalogueManager({

  const [
    draft,

      blank(defaultTaxRateId),

  const [
    variantDraft,
    setVariantDraft,
  ] = useState<VariantDraft>(blankVariant());

  const editing =
    Boolean(
      draft.itemId,
    );

  const selectedBaseItem = draft.itemId
    ? items.find(item => item.id === draft.itemId && !item.isVariant)
    : undefined;
  const variantsForSelected = selectedBaseItem?.itemType === 'product'
    ? items.filter(item => item.isVariant && item.baseCatalogItemId === selectedBaseItem.id)
    : [];

  const visible =

        const value =

        if (!value) {

              .toLowerCase()
              .includes(
                value,
              ),
        );
      },
      [
        items,
        query,
      ],
    );

  function set(
    key:
      keyof Draft,
    value:
      string,
  ) {
    setDraft(
      current => ({
        ...current,
        [key]:
          value,
      }),
    );
  }

  async function save() {
    if (
      !draft.name.trim()
    ) {
      showError(
        'Item name required',
        'Enter a product or service name.',
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result =
        await request({
          action:
            editing
              ? 'update_catalog_item'
              : 'create_catalog_item',
          itemId:
            draft.itemId ||
            undefined,
          itemType:
            draft.itemType,
          name:
            draft.name,
          sku:
            draft.sku,
          description:
            draft.description,
          unit:
            draft.unit,
          unitPrice:
            draft.unitPrice,
          ...(data.capabilities.canManageMargin && draft.unitCost.trim() !== ''
            ? { unitCost: draft.unitCost }
            : {}),
          taxRateId:
            draft.taxRateId ||
            undefined,
        });

      const id =
        String(
          result.id ||
          draft.itemId ||
          '',
        );

      if (
        !id
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'SaMi did not return the saved catalogue item.',
        );
      }

      const previous =
        items.find(
          item =>
            item.id ===
            id,
        );
      const selectedTax = data.taxRates.find(rate => rate.id === draft.taxRateId);
      const keptExistingTax = draft.taxRateId && draft.taxRateId === previous?.taxRateId;

      const next: Item = {
        id,
        itemType:
          draft.itemType,
        name:
          draft.name.trim(),
        sku:
          draft.sku.trim() ||
          null,
        description:
          draft.description.trim() ||
          null,
        unit:
          draft.unit.trim() ||
          'unit',
        unitPrice:
          Number(
            draft.unitPrice ||
            0,
          ),
        taxRateId:
          draft.taxRateId ||
          null,
        taxName:
          selectedTax?.name ||
          (keptExistingTax ? previous?.taxName : null) ||
          null,
        taxRate:
          selectedTax?.rate ??
          (keptExistingTax ? previous?.taxRate : 0) ??
          0,
        unitCost:
          data.capabilities.canManageMargin && draft.unitCost.trim() !== ''
            ? Number(draft.unitCost)
            : previous?.unitCost ?? null,
        isVariant: false,
        variantId: null,
        baseCatalogItemId: null,
        baseProductName: null,
        variantLabel: null,
        variantAttributes: [],
      };

      setItems(
        current => [
          next,
          ...current.filter(
            item =>
              item.id !==
              id,
          ),
        ],
      );

      setDraft(blank(defaultTaxRateId));
      setVariantDraft(blankVariant());

      showSuccess(
        editing
          ? 'Catalogue item updated'
          : 'Catalogue item created',
        'The shared product master is ready for Sales quotations and Invoicing.',
      );
      router.refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Catalogue item could not be saved',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save the catalogue item.',
      );
    }
  }


  async function saveVariant() {
    if (!selectedBaseItem || selectedBaseItem.itemType !== 'product') {
      showError('Select a base product', 'Product variants can only be created from an active product.');
      return;
    }
    if (!variantDraft.sku.trim()) {
      showError('Variant SKU required', 'Enter a unique SKU for this variant.');
      return;
    }
    let attributes: Array<{ name: string; value: string }>;
    try {
      attributes = parseVariantAttributes(variantDraft.attributes);
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Variant attributes required', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Check the variant attributes.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: variantDraft.variantId ? 'update_product_variant' : 'create_product_variant',
        ...(variantDraft.variantId ? { variantId: variantDraft.variantId } : { baseCatalogItemId: selectedBaseItem.id }),
        sku: variantDraft.sku.trim(),
        attributes,
        ...(variantDraft.unitPrice.trim() ? { unitPrice: variantDraft.unitPrice } : {}),
        ...(data.capabilities.canManageMargin && variantDraft.unitCost.trim() ? { unitCost: variantDraft.unitCost } : {}),
      });
      if (!result.catalogItemId && !result.id) {
        throw new Error('SaMi did not return the saved variant catalogue item.');
      }
      showSuccess(variantDraft.variantId ? 'Product variant updated' : 'Product variant created', 'The variant has its own SKU and catalogue identity for quotations, orders and invoices.');
      setVariantDraft(blankVariant(String(selectedBaseItem.unitPrice)));
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Product variant could not be saved', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save the product variant.');
    }
  }

  async function archiveVariant(item: Item) {
    if (!item.variantId) {
      showError('Variant could not be archived', 'The variant record identifier is missing.');
      return;
    }
    if (!window.confirm('Archive variant ' + (item.sku || item.name) + '? It will no longer be available for new quotations, but historical documents remain unchanged.')) return;
    try {
      await request({ action: 'archive_product_variant', variantId: item.variantId });
      setItems(current => current.filter(candidate => candidate.id !== item.id));
      if (variantDraft.variantId === item.variantId) setVariantDraft(blankVariant(String(selectedBaseItem?.unitPrice || '')));
      showSuccess('Product variant archived', 'Historical quotation and order lines retain their saved snapshots.');
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Product variant could not be archived', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not archive the product variant.');
    }
  }

  function exportCatalogue() {
    const rows = items;
    downloadCsv('sami-sales-catalogue.csv', [
      ['name', 'itemType', 'sku', 'description', 'unit', 'unitPrice', 'taxRateId', 'baseProductSku', 'variantAttributes', 'unitCost'],
      ...rows.map(item => {
        const base = item.isVariant
          ? items.find(candidate => candidate.id === item.baseCatalogItemId)
          : undefined;
        return [
          item.name,
          item.itemType,
          item.sku || '',
          item.description || '',
          item.unit,
          item.unitPrice,
          item.taxRateId || '',
          base?.sku || '',
          item.isVariant ? JSON.stringify(item.variantAttributes) : '',
          item.unitCost ?? '',
        ];
      }),
    ]);
  }

  async function importCatalogue(file: File) {
    if (!data.capabilities.canManageCatalog) {
      showError('Catalogue permission required', 'You need catalogue-management permission to import products.');
      return;
    }
    setImporting(true);
    try {
      const rows = parseCsv(await file.text());
      if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error('The CSV must include a header row and at least one product row.');
      if (rows.length - 1 > 200) throw new Error('Import is limited to 200 product rows per file.');
      const normalizeHeader = (value: string) => value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[ _-]/g, '');
      const headers = rows[0].map(normalizeHeader);
      const column = (...names: string[]) => headers.findIndex(header => names.includes(header));
      const nameColumn = column('name', 'productname', 'itemname');
      if (nameColumn < 0) throw new Error('The CSV needs a name or productName column.');
      const val = (row: string[], index: number) => index < 0 ? '' : row[index]?.trim() || '';
      const itemsToImport = rows.slice(1).map(row => ({
        name: val(row, nameColumn),
        itemType: val(row, column('itemtype', 'type')).toLowerCase() || 'product',
        sku: val(row, column('sku', 'itemsku')),
        description: val(row, column('description', 'details')),
        unit: val(row, column('unit', 'uom')) || 'unit',
        unitPrice: val(row, column('unitprice', 'price', 'sellingprice')) || '0',
        taxRateId: val(row, column('taxrateid')),
        baseProductSku: val(row, column('baseproductsku', 'parentproductsku')),
        variantAttributes: val(row, column('variantattributes', 'attributes')),
        unitCost: val(row, column('unitcost', 'cost')),
      }));
      const result = await request({ action: 'bulk_import_catalog_items', items: itemsToImport }) as {
        total?: number; created?: number; failed?: number; results?: Array<{ row?: number; success?: boolean; error?: string; name?: string }>;
      };
      const created = Number(result.created || 0);
      const failed = Number(result.failed || 0);
      const failures = (result.results || []).filter(item => item.success === false).slice(0, 3);
      const details = failures.map(item => 'Row ' + String(item.row || '?') + ': ' + String(item.error || 'Import failed')).join(' · ');
      const summary = created + ' created; ' + failed + ' failed.' + (details ? ' ' + details : '');
      if (created === 0 && failed > 0) showError('Catalogue import needs attention', summary);
      else showSuccess('Catalogue import finished', summary);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Catalogue import failed', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not read that CSV file.');
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">
          Roadmap Part 7
        </p>
        <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">
          Product catalogue
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">
          Maintain the shared product and service catalogue from Sales. The same item identity is reused by quotations and downstream invoices.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.95fr_1.05fr]">
        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Import or export catalogue data</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={exportCatalogue} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"><Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Export CSV</button>
              <label className={['inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold', importing || busy || !data.capabilities.canManageCatalog ? 'pointer-events-none opacity-50' : ''].join(' ')}>
                <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> {importing ? 'Importing…' : 'Import CSV'}
                <input type="file" accept=".csv,text/csv" disabled={importing || busy || !data.capabilities.canManageCatalog} className="sr-only" onChange={event => { const file = event.currentTarget.files?.[0]; event.currentTarget.value = ''; if (file) void importCatalogue(file); }} />
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <Search
              className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-3 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400"
            />
            <input
              value={
                query
              }
              onChange={
                event =>
                  setQuery(
                    event.target.value,
                  )
              }
              placeholder="Search products, services or SKU"
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent pl-9 pr-3 text-sm"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 max-h-[680px] space-y-2 overflow-y-auto">
            {
              visible.length ===
                0
                ? (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-5 text-sm text-slate-500">
                      No catalogue items match this view.
                    </div>
                  )
                : visible.map(
                    item => (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        key={
                          item.id
                        }
                        onClick={() => {
                          setDraft(fromItem(item));
                          setVariantDraft(blankVariant(String(item.unitPrice)));
                        }}
                        className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3 text-left transition hover:bg-slate-500/[0.04]"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <Box
                                className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0"
                              />
                              <p className="truncate text-sm font-black">
                                {
                                  item.name
                                }
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                              {
                                [
                                  item.itemType,
                                  item.sku,
                                  item.unit,
                                  item.taxName,
                                ]
                                  .filter(
                                    Boolean,
                                  )
                                  .join(
                                    ' · ',
                                  )
                              }
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                            <p className="text-sm font-black">
                              {
                                new Intl.NumberFormat(
                                  'en-KE',
                                  {
                                    style:
                                      'currency',
                                    currency:
                                      data.company.currency,
                                    maximumFractionDigits:
                                      2,
                                  },
                                ).format(
                                  item.unitPrice,
                                )
                              }
                            </p>
                            <Pencil
                              className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    ),
                  )
            }
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black">
              {
                editing
                  ? 'Edit catalogue item'
                  : 'New catalogue item'
              }
            </h3>
            {
              data.capabilities
                .canManageCatalog &&
              (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDraft(blank(defaultTaxRateId));
                    setVariantDraft(blankVariant());
                  }}
                  className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
                >
                  <Plus
                    className="h-4 w-4"
                  />
                  New
                </button>
              )
            }
          </div>

          {
            data.capabilities
              .canManageCatalog
              ? (
                  <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <Select
                      label="Type"
                      value={
                        draft.itemType
                      }
                      onChange={
                        value =>
                          set(
                            'itemType',
                            value,
                          )
                      }
                    />
                    <Field
                      label="Name"
                      value={
                        draft.name
                      }
                      onChange={
                        value =>
                          set(
                            'name',
                            value,
                          )
                      }
                    />
                    <Field
                      label="SKU"
                      value={
                        draft.sku
                      }
                      onChange={
                        value =>
                          set(
                            'sku',
                            value,
                          )
                      }
                    />
                    <Field
                      label="Unit"
                      value={
                        draft.unit
                      }
                      onChange={
                        value =>
                          set(
                            'unit',
                            value,
                          )
                      }
                    />
                    <Field
                      label="Unit price"
                      type="number"
                      value={
                        draft.unitPrice
                      }
                      onChange={
                        value =>
                          set(
                            'unitPrice',
                            value,
                          )
                      }
                    />
                    {data.capabilities.canManageMargin ? (
                      <Field
                        label="Unit cost (internal)"
                        type="number"
                        value={draft.unitCost}
                        onChange={value => set('unitCost', value)}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                    <label className="block">
                      <span className="text-xs font-black">Tax rate</span>
                      <select
                        value={draft.taxRateId}
                        onChange={event => set('taxRateId', event.target.value)}
                        className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
                      >
                        <option value="">No tax</option>
                        {draft.taxRateId && !data.taxRates.some(rate => rate.id === draft.taxRateId) ? (
                          <option value={draft.taxRateId}>
                            Existing tax: {items.find(item => item.id === draft.itemId)?.taxName || 'unavailable rate'}
                          </option>
                        ) : null}
                        {data.taxRates.map(rate => (
                          <option key={rate.id} value={rate.id}>
                            {rate.name} · {rate.rate}%{rate.priceIncluded ? ' (included)' : ''}{rate.isDefault ? ' · default' : ''}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-slate-500">
                        Tax is taken from the company’s shared Invoicing tax configuration and recalculated on quotations.
                      </span>
                    </label>
                    <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                      <label className="block">
                        <span className="text-xs font-black">
                          Description
                        </span>
                        <textarea
                          value={
                            draft.description
                          }
                          rows={
                            4
                          }
                          onChange={
                            event =>
                              set(
                                'description',
                                event.target.value,
                              )
                          }
                          className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                        />
                      </label>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2 sm:col-span-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={
                          busy
                        }
                        onClick={
                          save
                        }
                        className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                      >
                        {
                          editing
                            ? 'Save item'
                            : 'Create item'
                        }
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={
                          busy
                        }
                        onClick={() => {
                          setDraft(blank(defaultTaxRateId));
                          setVariantDraft(blankVariant());
                        }}
                        className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
                      >
                        Clear
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )
              : (
                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-5 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    You can use catalogue items in quotations, but catalogue-management permission is required to create or edit them.
                  </div>
                )
          }
        </div>
      </div>

      {selectedBaseItem && selectedBaseItem.itemType === 'product' && data.capabilities.canManageCatalog ? (
        <section className="sami-surface space-y-4 rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">Product variants</p>
              <h3 className="mt-1 text-lg font-black">{selectedBaseItem.name}</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">Create SKU-level variants such as colour, size or packaging. Each variant becomes a shared catalogue item so quotes, orders and invoices keep the selected SKU.</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setVariantDraft(blankVariant(String(selectedBaseItem.unitPrice)))}
              className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New variant
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-black">{variantDraft.variantId ? 'Edit variant' : 'Create variant'}</h4>
              <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <Field label="Variant SKU" value={variantDraft.sku} onChange={value => setVariantDraft(current => ({ ...current, sku: value }))} />
                <Field label="Unit price" type="number" value={variantDraft.unitPrice} onChange={value => setVariantDraft(current => ({ ...current, unitPrice: value }))} />
                {data.capabilities.canManageMargin ? (
                  <Field label="Unit cost (restricted)" type="number" value={variantDraft.unitCost} onChange={value => setVariantDraft(current => ({ ...current, unitCost: value }))} />
                ) : null}
                <label className="block sm:col-span-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-black">Attributes (one per line)</span>
                  <textarea
                    value={variantDraft.attributes}
                    onChange={event => setVariantDraft(current => ({ ...current, attributes: event.target.value }))}
                    placeholder={'Color=Blue\nSize=Large'}
                    rows={4}
                    className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  />
                </label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 sm:col-span-2">
                  <button type="button" disabled={busy || importing} onClick={() => void saveVariant()} className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60">
                    {variantDraft.variantId ? 'Save variant' : 'Create variant'}
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" disabled={busy || importing} onClick={() => setVariantDraft(blankVariant(String(selectedBaseItem.unitPrice)))} className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60">
                    Clear
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-black">Active variants ({variantsForSelected.length})</h4>
              {variantsForSelected.length ? variantsForSelected.map(item => (
                <div key={item.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="break-words text-sm font-black">{item.variantLabel || item.name}</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{[item.sku, item.variantAttributes.map(attribute => attribute.name + ': ' + attribute.value).join(' · ')].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold">{new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency: data.company.currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(item.unitPrice)}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <button type="button" disabled={busy || importing} onClick={() => setVariantDraft(variantFromItem(item))} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-60">Edit</button>
                    <button type="button" disabled={busy || importing} onClick={() => void archiveVariant(item)} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-red-300 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-red-600 disabled:opacity-60">Archive</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )) : (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-5 text-sm text-slate-500">No active variants yet. Add the first SKU above.</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}


function Field({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  type =
    'text',
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
  onChange:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  type?:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="text-xs font-black">
        {
          label
        }
      </span>
      <input
        type={
          type
        }
        value={
          value
        }
        onChange={
          event =>
            onChange(
              event.target.value,
            )
        }
        className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}


function Select({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
  onChange:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="text-xs font-black">
        {
          label
        }
      </span>
      <select
        value={
          value
        }
        onChange={
          event =>
            onChange(
              event.target.value,
            )
        }
        className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
      >
        <option value="product">
          Product
        </option>
        <option value="service">
          Service
        </option>
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}

function money(value: number, currency: string) {

FILE: app\apps\sales\SalesProductVariantsManager.tsx

'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Archive, Layers3, Pencil, Plus, RotateCcw, Save, X } from 'lucide-react';
import type { SalesWorkspaceData } from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';

type CatalogItem = SalesWorkspaceData['catalogItems'][number];
type Attribute = { name: string; value: string };
type Draft = {
  variantId: string;
  baseCatalogItemId: string;
  sku: string;
  unitPrice: string;
  unitCost: string;
  attributesText: string;
};
const emptyDraft = (baseCatalogItemId = ''): Draft => ({
  variantId: '',
  baseCatalogItemId,
  sku: '',
  unitPrice: '',
  unitCost: '',
  attributesText: 'Color=\nSize=',
});
function attributesFromText(value: string): Attribute[] {
  return value.split(/\r?\n/)
    .map(line => line.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map(line => {
      const index = line.indexOf('=');
      if (index <= 0 || index === line.length - 1) {
        throw new Error('Enter each option as Name=Value, for example Color=Blue.');
      }
      return { name: line.slice(0, index).trim(), value: line.slice(index + 1).trim() };
    });
}
function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency: currency || 'KES', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return (currency || 'KES') + ' ' + Number(value || 0).toLocaleString();
  }
}

export default function SalesProductVariantsManager({
  data, busy, request, showSuccess, showError,
}: {
  data: SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy: boolean;
  request: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  showSuccess: (title: string, message: string) => void;
  showError: (title: string, message: string) => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const products = useMemo(
    () => data.catalogItems.filter(item => !item.isVariant && item.itemType === 'product'),
    [data.catalogItems],
  );
  const variants = useMemo(
    () => data.catalogItems.filter(item => item.isVariant),
    [data.catalogItems],
  );
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(() => emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || ''));
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [archiveId, setArchiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [attributeError, setAttributeError] = useState('');

  const editing = Boolean(draft.variantId);
  const canManage = data.capabilities.canManageCatalog;
  const selectedProduct = products.find(item => item.id === draft.baseCatalogItemId);
  const selectedVariant = variants.find(item => item.variantId === draft.variantId);

  function editVariant(item: CatalogItem) {
    setDraft({
      variantId: item.variantId || '',
      baseCatalogItemId: item.baseCatalogItemId || products[0]?.id || '',
      sku: item.sku || '',
      unitPrice: String(item.unitPrice),
      unitCost: String(item.unitCost ?? ''),
      attributesText: (item.variantAttributes || []).map(row => row.name + '=' + row.value).join('\n'),
    });
    setAttributeError('');
  }

  async function save(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!canManage) return;
    if (!draft.baseCatalogItemId && !editing) {
      showError('Choose a product', 'Create a base product in the catalogue before adding variants.');
      return;
    }
    if (!draft.sku.trim()) {
      showError('SKU required', 'Every sellable variant needs its own unique SKU.');
      return;
    }
    let attributes: Attribute[];
    try {
      attributes = attributesFromText(draft.attributesText);
      if (!attributes.length) throw new Error('Add at least one variant attribute, such as Color=Blue.');
      if (new Set(attributes.map(item => item.name.toLowerCase())).size !== attributes.length) {
        throw new Error('Attribute names must be unique within a variant.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setAttributeError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Check the variant attributes.');
      return;
    }
    setAttributeError('');
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await request(editing ? {
        action: 'update_product_variant',
        variantId: draft.variantId,
        sku: draft.sku.trim(),
        unitPrice: Number(draft.unitPrice),
        ...(data.capabilities.canViewMargin ? { unitCost: Number(draft.unitCost || 0) } : {}),
        attributes,
      } : {
        action: 'create_product_variant',
        baseCatalogItemId: draft.baseCatalogItemId,
        sku: draft.sku.trim(),
        unitPrice: Number(draft.unitPrice || selectedProduct?.unitPrice || 0),
        ...(data.capabilities.canViewMargin ? { unitCost: Number(draft.unitCost || 0) } : {}),
        attributes,
      });
      showSuccess(editing ? 'Variant updated' : 'Variant created',
        'The sellable SKU is saved in the shared catalogue and is available to quotations.');
      setDraft(emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || ''));
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Variant could not be saved', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save this product variant.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function archiveVariant(item: CatalogItem) {
    if (!item.variantId) return;
    try {
      await request({ action: 'archive_product_variant', variantId: item.variantId });
      showSuccess('Variant archived', 'The SKU is no longer available for new quotations. Historical documents remain unchanged.');
      setArchiveId(null);
      if (draft.variantId === item.variantId) setDraft(emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || ''));
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Variant could not be archived', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not archive this SKU.');
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600"><Layers3 className="h-5 w-5" /></span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">Sellable product SKUs</p>
            <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">Product variants</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">Define options such as size, colour, capacity or packaging. Each combination is its own shared catalogue item with its own SKU and price, so quotations and subsequent invoices keep the exact variant sold.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]">
        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black">{editing ? 'Edit product variant' : 'Add variant'}</h3>
            {editing ? <button type="button" onClick={() => { setDraft(emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || '')); setAttributeError(''); }} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"><X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Cancel edit</button> : null}
          </div>
          {!canManage ? (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">Catalogue-management permission is required to create or edit product variants.</p>
          ) : products.length === 0 && !editing ? (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">Create a base product first, then add its variant SKUs here.</p>
          ) : (
            <form className="mt-4 space-y-4" onSubmit={save}>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Base product
                <select value={draft.baseCatalogItemId} disabled={editing || saving || busy} onChange={event => {
                  const product = products.find(item => item.id === event.target.value);
                  setDraft(current => ({ ...current, baseCatalogItemId: event.target.value, unitPrice: product ? String(product.unitPrice) : current.unitPrice }));
                }} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm">
                  {products.map(item => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.name}{item.sku ? ' · ' + item.sku : ''}</option>)}
                </select>
              </label>
              {selectedVariant ? <p className="rounded-lg bg-[var(--sami-surface-soft)] p-2 text-xs text-slate-500">Base product: {selectedVariant.baseProductName || selectedProduct?.name || 'Product'}</p> : null}
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Variant attributes * <span className="font-normal text-slate-500">one Name=Value pair per line</span>
                <textarea value={draft.attributesText} onChange={event => { setDraft(current => ({ ...current, attributesText: event.target.value })); setAttributeError(''); }} required rows={4} placeholder={'Color=Blue\nSize=Large'} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent p-3 text-sm" />
              </label>
              {attributeError ? <p role="alert" className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">{attributeError}</p> : null}
              <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Unique SKU *
                  <input value={draft.sku} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, sku: event.target.value }))} required maxLength={120} placeholder="e.g. TSHIRT-BLU-L" className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
                </label>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Selling price *
                  <input type="number" value={draft.unitPrice} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, unitPrice: event.target.value }))} min={0} step="0.01" required className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
                </label>
                {data.capabilities.canViewMargin ? <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Unit cost
                  <input type="number" value={draft.unitCost} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, unitCost: event.target.value }))} min={0} step="0.01" className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
                </label> : null}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Variants must have distinct SKUs. The system blocks duplicate SKUs within the company and records variant changes in the activity history.</p>
              <button type="submit" disabled={busy || saving} className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"><Save className="h-4 w-4" /> {saving ? 'Saving…' : editing ? 'Save changes' : 'Create variant'}</button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><div><h3 className="text-sm font-black">Active variants</h3><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{variants.length} sellable SKU(s) in the loaded catalogue</p></div><button type="button" onClick={() => router.refresh()} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"><RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Refresh</button></div>
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
            {variants.length === 0 ? <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-6 text-center"><p className="text-sm font-bold">No variants yet</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Add colour, size or other sellable options to a product.</p></div> : variants.map(item => (
              <article key={item.variantId || item.id} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-sm font-black">{item.baseProductName || item.name}</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{item.variantLabel || item.name}</p><p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">SKU {item.sku || '—'}</p></div>
                  <p className="shrink-0 text-sm font-black tabular-nums">{money(item.unitPrice, data.company.currency)}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <button type="button" disabled={!canManage || busy || saving} onClick={() => editVariant(item)} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Edit</button>
                  {archiveId === item.variantId ? <><button type="button" disabled={busy || saving} onClick={() => void archiveVariant(item)} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-700 px-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-50"><Archive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Confirm archive</button><button type="button" onClick={() => setArchiveId(null)} className="h-8 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold">Cancel</button></> : <button type="button" disabled={!canManage || busy || saving} onClick={() => setArchiveId(item.variantId)} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/30 px-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-rose-300"><Archive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Archive</button>}

import type { SalesQuotationEffectivenessReport as Report, SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow } from '@/lib/apps/sales/quotation-effectiveness';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function days(value: number | null) {
  return value == null ? '—' : value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + ' days';
}

function EffectivenessTable({
  title,
  description,
  rows,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  rows: SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow[];
}) {

      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{description}</p>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No quotations are available for this breakdown in the last 90 days.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
          {currencies.map(currency => {
            const currencyRows = rows.filter(row => row.currency === currency);
            return (
              <section key={currency} aria-label={currency + ' quotation effectiveness'}>
                <h4 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{currency}</h4>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1180px] text-left text-sm">
                    <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">{title.includes('template') ? 'Template' : 'Salesperson'}</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Quotes</th>

                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Expired</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Quoted value</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Converted value</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Sent → accepted</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Accepted → order</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Days to accept</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Days to order</th>

                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{row.convertedCount.toLocaleString()}</td>

                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{money(row.convertedValue, currency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.sentToAcceptedRate.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%</td>

        title="Quotation template effectiveness"
        description="Compares template performance. Quotes without a template and quotes linked to deleted templates remain visible separately."
