                            type="button"
                            disabled={busy}
                            onClick={() => void bulkSendSelectedQuotes()}
                            className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                          >
                            <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                            Send selected drafts ({sendableSelectedQuoteIds.length})
                          </button>
                        )}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          const selectedQuotes = quoteRecords.filter(
                            quote => selectedQuoteIds.includes(quote.id),
                          );
                          if (selectedQuotes.length > 0) {
                            exportSales(initialData, selectedQuotes);
                          }
                        }}
                        className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white"
                      >
                        <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
                        Export selected CSV
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedQuoteIds([])}
                        className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
                      >
                        Clear selection
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="sami-surface overflow-hidden rounded-[24px]">
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-left text-sm">
                    <thead className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-slate-500/[0.04] text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.09em] text-slate-400">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="w-12 px-4 py-3">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            aria-label="Select all visible quotations"
                            checked={allVisibleQuotesSelected}
                            onChange={event => {
                              if (event.target.checked) {
                                setSelectedQuoteIds(current => Array.from(new Set([
                                  ...current,
                                  ...visibleQuotes.map(quote => quote.id),
                                ])));
                              } else {
                                const visibleIds = new Set(visibleQuotes.map(quote => quote.id));
                                setSelectedQuoteIds(current => current.filter(id => !visibleIds.has(id)));
                              }
                            }}
                            className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-blue-600"
                          />
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3">
                          Quotation
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3">
                          Customer
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3">
                          Status
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3">
                          Approval
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3">
                          Valid until
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Total
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                      {
                        visibleQuotes.length ===
                          0
                          ? (
                              <tr>
                                <td
                                  colSpan={
                                    7
                                  }
                                  className="px-4 py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500"
                                >
                                  No quotations match this view.
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            )
                          : visibleQuotes.map(
                              quote => (
                                <tr
                                  key={
                                    quote.id
                                  }
                                  className="hover:bg-slate-500/[0.03]"
                                >
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <input
                                      type="checkbox"
                                      aria-label={`Select quotation ${quote.quoteNumber}`}
                                      checked={selectedQuoteIds.includes(quote.id)}
                                      onChange={event => {
                                        if (event.target.checked) {
                                          setSelectedQuoteIds(current =>
                                            current.includes(quote.id)
                                              ? current
                                              : [...current, quote.id],
                                          );
                                        } else {
                                          setSelectedQuoteIds(current =>
                                            current.filter(id => id !== quote.id),
                                          );
                                        }
                                      }}
                                      className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-blue-600"
                                    />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <Link
                                      href={
                                        '/apps/sales/quotes/' +
                                        quote.id
                                      }
                                      className="font-black text-blue-700 hover:underline dark:text-blue-300"
                                    >
                                      {
                                        quote.quoteNumber
                                      }
                                    </Link>
                                    <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                      {
                                        quote.quoteDate
                                      }
                                    </p>
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <p className="font-bold">
                                      {
                                        quote.customerName
                                      }
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                      {
                                        quote.customerEmail ||
                                        quote.reference ||
                                        '—'
                                      }
                                    </p>
                                  </td>
                                  
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <Status
                                      value={
                                        quote.status
                                      }
                                    />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <Status
                                      value={
                                        quote.approvalStatus
                                      }
                                    />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                                    {
                                      quote.validUntil ||
                                      '—'
                                    }
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-black">
                                    {
                                      money(
                                        quote.totalAmount,
                                        quote.currency,
                                      )
                                    }
                                  </td>
                                </tr>
                              ),
                            )
                      }
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
              {quoteRegisterError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">{quoteRegisterError}</p>}
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
                <span>Showing {quoteRecords.length.toLocaleString()} of {quoteRegisterTotalCount.toLocaleString()} quotations</span>
                {quoteRegisterHasMore && (
                  <button type="button" disabled={quoteRegisterLoading} onClick={() => void loadMoreQuoteRecords()} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 py-2 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                    {quoteRegisterLoading ? 'Loading quotations…' : 'Load more quotations'}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </section>
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'templates' &&
          (
            <SalesTemplatesManager
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'pdfBuilder' &&
          (
            <SalesQuotePdfBuilder
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'catalogue' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canUseCatalog &&
          (
            <SalesProductCatalogueManager
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'pricelists' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewPricing &&
          (
            <SalesPricelistsManager
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'advancedPricing' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewPricing &&
          (
            <SalesAdvancedPricingManager
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'currencies' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewPricing &&
          (
            <SalesCurrenciesManager
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'orders' &&
          (
            <section className="space-y-4">
              <Toolbar
                title="Sales orders"
                search={
                  search
                }
                setSearch={
                  value => {
                    setSearch(value);
                    setSelectedOrderIds([]);
                  }
                }
                onExport={
                  () =>
                    exportSales(
                      initialData,
                    )
                }
              />

              <div className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                    Order work queues
                  </p>
                  <div
                    role="group"
                    aria-label="Sales order work queues"
                    className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"
                  >
                    {ORDER_STATUS_VIEWS.map(option => (
                      <button
                        key={option.key}
                        type="button"
                        aria-pressed={orderStatusView === option.key}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setOrderStatusView(option.key);
                          setSelectedOrderIds([]);
                        }}
                        className={[
                          'inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-colors',
                          orderStatusView === option.key
                            ? 'border-blue-600 bg-blue-600 text-white'
                            : 'border-[var(--sami-border)] hover:border-blue-500/60',
                        ].join(' ')}
                      >
                        {option.label}
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-black/5 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] dark:bg-white/10">
                          {orderRegisterQueueCounts?.[option.key] ?? '—'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Sort
                    <select
                      aria-label="Sort sales orders"
                      value={orderSortBy}
                      onChange={event => setOrderSortBy(event.target.value as SalesOrderSortBy)}
                      className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--sami-text)]"
                    >
                      {ORDER_SORT_OPTIONS.map(option => (
                        <option key={option.key} value={option.key}>
                          {option.label}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </label>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Focus on delivery or invoicing work. Sort by age, value, customer or the least-complete delivery and invoice work.
                </p>
              </div>

              <section className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-3" aria-label="Saved sales order views">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                      Saved order views
                    </h3>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Save the current fulfillment or invoicing queue and search so you can reopen the same work list later.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <form
                    className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row lg:w-auto"
                    onSubmit={event => {
                      event.preventDefault();
                      void saveCurrentOrderView();
                    }}
                  >
                    <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="sales-saved-order-view-name">Saved order view name</label>
                    <input
                      id="sales-saved-order-view-name"
                      value={savedOrderViewName}
                      onChange={event => setSavedOrderViewName(event.target.value)}
                      maxLength={80}
                      placeholder="e.g. Orders to invoice"
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-xs sm:w-64"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={busy || !savedOrderViewName.trim()}
                      className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      <BookmarkPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Save order view
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </div>

                {savedOrderViewsError && (
                  <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-600">
                    {savedOrderViewsError}
                  </p>
                )}

                {savedOrderViewsLoading ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">Loading your saved order views…</p>
                ) : savedOrderViews.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    No saved order views yet. Save this queue and search to create your first one.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {savedOrderViews.map(view => (
                      <div
                        key={view.id}
                        className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-1"
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => applySavedOrderView(view)}
                          className={[
                            'max-w-[280px] truncate rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-bold',
                            orderStatusView === view.statusView && search === view.searchQuery && orderSortBy === view.sortBy
                              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                              : 'hover:bg-slate-500/10',
                          ].join(' ')}
                          title={view.name}
                        >
                          {view.name}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          aria-label={'Delete saved order view ' + view.name}
                          onClick={() => void removeSavedOrderView(view)}
                          className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-red-600"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex justify-end">
                  <div
                    role="group"
                    aria-label="Sales order display mode"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-1"
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-pressed={orderDisplayMode === 'register'}
                      onClick={() => setOrderDisplayMode('register')}
                      className={[
                        'inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-bold',
                        orderDisplayMode === 'register'
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-500/10',
                      ].join(' ')}
                    >
                      <List className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Register
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-pressed={orderDisplayMode === 'cards'}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setOrderDisplayMode('cards');
                        setSelectedOrderIds([]);
                      }}
                      className={[
                        'inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-bold',
                        orderDisplayMode === 'cards'
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-500/10',
                      ].join(' ')}
                    >
                      <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Cards
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {selectedOrderIds.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-3" aria-live="polite">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-black">
                          {selectedOrderIds.length} sales order{selectedOrderIds.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          {invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length} confirmed order(s) eligible for invoicing. Maximum 25 per batch.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {initialData.capabilities.canManageOrders &&
                          invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length > 0 && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={busy || invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length > 25}
                              onClick={() => void bulkInvoiceSelectedOrders()}
                              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                            >
                              <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                              Invoice eligible orders ({invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length})
                            </button>
                          )}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            const selectedOrders = orderRecords.filter(
                              order => selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id),
                            );
                            if (selectedOrders.length > 0) {
                              exportSales(initialData, undefined, selectedOrders);
                            }
                          }}
                          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3.5 text-xs font-black"
                        >
                          <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
                          Export selected CSV
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedOrderIds([])}
                          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
                        >
                          Clear selection
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length > 25 && (
                      <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
                        Select no more than 25 eligible orders for a single invoice batch.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {visibleOrders.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                    No sales orders match this view.
                  </div>
                ) : orderDisplayMode === 'register' ? (
                  <div className="sami-surface overflow-hidden rounded-[24px]" aria-label="Sales order register">
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full min-w-[1120px] text-left text-sm" aria-label="Sales order register">
                        <thead className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-slate-500/[0.04] text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.09em] text-slate-400">
                          <tr>
                            <th scope="col" className="w-12 px-4 py-3">
                              <input
                                type="checkbox"
                                aria-label="Select all visible sales orders"
                                checked={allVisibleOrdersSelected}
                                disabled={busy || visibleOrders.length === 0}
                                onChange={event => {
                                  if (event.target.checked) {
                                    setSelectedOrderIds(current => Array.from(new Set([
                                      ...current,
                                      ...visibleOrders.map(order => order.id),
                                    ])));
                                  } else {
                                    const visibleIds = new Set(visibleOrders.map(order => order.id));
                                    setSelectedOrderIds(current => current.filter(id => !visibleIds.has(id)));
                                  }
                                }}
                                className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-blue-600"
                              />
                            </th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Order</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Customer</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Order date</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Fulfillment</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Invoicing</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Delivered</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Invoiced</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Order value</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                          {visibleOrders.map(order => (
                            <tr key={order.id} className="hover:bg-slate-500/[0.03]">
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <input
                                  type="checkbox"
                                  aria-label={'Select sales order ' + order.orderNumber}
                                  checked={selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id)}
                                  disabled={busy}
                                  onChange={event => {
                                    if (event.target.checked) {
                                      setSelectedOrderIds(current =>
                                        current.includes(order.id) ? current : [...current, order.id],
                                      );
                                    } else {
                                      setSelectedOrderIds(current =>
                                        current.filter(id => id !== order.id),
                                      );
                                    }
                                  }}
                                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-blue-600"
                                />
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <Link
                                  href={'/apps/sales/orders/' + order.id}
                                  className="font-black text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                                >
                                  {order.orderNumber}
                                </Link>
                                {order.quoteNumber && (
                                  <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                    From {order.quoteNumber}
                                  </p>
                                )}
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{order.customerName}</td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{order.orderDate}</td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <Status value={order.status} />
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-semibold">
                                  {salesOrderFulfillmentLabel(order.fulfillmentStatus)}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-semibold">
                                  {salesOrderInvoiceLabel(order.invoiceStatus)}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(order.deliveredPercent)}%</span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(order.invoicedPercent)}%</span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-black whitespace-nowrap">
                                {money(order.totalAmount, order.currency)}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    {visibleOrders.map(order => (
                      <Link
                        key={order.id}
                        href={'/apps/sales/orders/' + order.id}
                        className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md"
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                              <p className="font-black">{order.orderNumber}</p>
                              <Status value={order.status} />
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                              {order.customerName}
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:min-w-[460px]">
                            <Progress
                              label="Delivered"
                              value={order.deliveredPercent}
                              state={order.fulfillmentStatus}
                            />
                            <Progress
                              label="Invoiced"
                              value={order.invoicedPercent}
                              state={order.invoiceStatus}
                            />
                            <div className="sm:text-right">
                              <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                                Order value
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-1 font-black">
                                {money(order.totalAmount, order.currency)}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              {orderRegisterError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">{orderRegisterError}</p>}
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
                <span>Showing {orderRecords.length.toLocaleString()} of {orderRegisterTotalCount.toLocaleString()} sales orders</span>
                {orderRegisterHasMore && (
                  <button type="button" disabled={orderRegisterLoading} onClick={() => void loadMoreOrderRecords()} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 py-2 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                    {orderRegisterLoading ? 'Loading sales orders…' : 'Load more sales orders'}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

            </section>
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'organization' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewOrganization &&
          (
            <SalesOrganizationManager
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'operations' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewOperations &&
          (
            <SalesOperationsManager
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'reports' &&
          (
            <Reports
              data={
                initialData
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'settings' &&
          (
            <Settings
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'newQuote' &&
          (
            <section className="sami-surface rounded-[26px] p-4 sm:p-5">
              <div className="mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-black">
                  {linkedOpportunity ? 'New quotation · ' + linkedOpportunity.name : 'New quotation'}
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Build the commercial offer from the selected opportunity. The link remains attached through the quotation lifecycle.
                </p>
              </div>

              {!opportunityLaunchResolved ? (
                <p className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
                  Loading opportunity details…
                </p>
              ) : opportunityLaunchError ? (
                <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-300/60 p-4 text-sm">
                  <p className="text-amber-700">{opportunityLaunchError}</p>
                  <Link href="/apps/sales/opportunities" className="font-black text-blue-600 hover:underline">
                    Return to Leads & Opportunities
                  </Link>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <SalesQuoteComposer
                  key={linkedOpportunity?.id || 'standalone-new-quote'}
                  data={initialData}
                  salespeople={initialData.salespeople}
                  currentSalespersonId={initialData.currentSalespersonId}
                  linkedOpportunity={linkedOpportunity}
                  busy={busy}
                  onSave={saveQuote}
                  onLocalError={(message) => showError('Exchange rate required', message)}
                  onCancel={() => {
                    router.push(
                      linkedOpportunityId
                        ? '/apps/sales/opportunities'
                        : '/apps/sales/quotes',
                    );
                  }}
                />
              )}
            </section>
          )
        }
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function Settings({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy:
    boolean;
  request:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >
      >;
  showSuccess:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  showError:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
      <form
        className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
        onSubmit={
          async event => {
            event.preventDefault();

            const form =
              new FormData(
                event.currentTarget,
              );

            try {
              await request({
                action:
                  'update_settings',
                defaultCurrency:
                  form.get(
                    'defaultCurrency',
                  ),
                defaultValidityDays:
                  form.get(
                    'defaultValidityDays',
                  ),
                quoteApprovalThreshold:
                  form.get(
                    'quoteApprovalThreshold',
                  ),
                invoicePolicy:
                  form.get(
                    'invoicePolicy',
                  ),
                requireQuoteApproval:
                  form.get(
                    'requireQuoteApproval',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                allowPartialInvoicing:
                  form.get(
                    'allowPartialInvoicing',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                allowOnlineAcceptance:
                  form.get(
                    'allowOnlineAcceptance',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                allowOnlineRejection:
                  form.get(
                    'allowOnlineRejection',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                requireBillingCustomerForInvoice:
                  form.get(
                    'requireBillingCustomerForInvoice',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                creditLimitEnforced:
                  form.get(
                    'creditLimitEnforced',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                lockConfirmedOrders:
                  form.get(
                    'lockConfirmedOrders',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                primaryColor:
                  form.get(
                    'primaryColor',
                  ),
                secondaryColor:
                  form.get(
                    'secondaryColor',
                  ),
                footerText:
                  form.get(
                    'footerText',
                  ),
                termsAndConditions:
                  form.get(
                    'termsAndConditions',
                  ),
                defaultNotes:
                  form.get(
                    'defaultNotes',
                  ),
                emailMessage:
                  form.get(
                    'emailMessage',
                  ),
              });

              showSuccess(
                'Sales settings saved',
                'The company Sales policy was updated.',
              );
            } catch (
              error
            ) {
              showError(
                'Sales settings failed',
                error instanceof
                  Error
                  ? error.message
                  : 'SaMi could not save Sales settings.',
              );
            }
          }
        }
      >
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
          Sales policy
        </h2>

        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <SettingInput
            name="defaultCurrency"
            label="Default currency"
            defaultValue={
              data.settings
                .defaultCurrency
            }
          />
          <SettingInput
            name="defaultValidityDays"
            label="Quote validity days"
            type="number"
            defaultValue={
              String(
                data.settings
                  .defaultValidityDays,
              )
            }
          />
          <SettingInput
            name="quoteApprovalThreshold"
            label="Approval threshold (base currency)"
            type="number"
            defaultValue={
              String(
                data.settings
                  .quoteApprovalThreshold,
              )
            }
          />

          <label>
            <SettingLabel>
              Invoicing policy
            </SettingLabel>
            <select
              name="invoicePolicy"
              defaultValue={
                data.settings
                  .invoicePolicy
              }
              className="mt-1 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="ordered">
                Ordered quantities
              </option>
              <option value="delivered">
                Delivered quantities
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>

          <SettingInput
            name="primaryColor"
            label="Primary color"
            defaultValue={
              data.settings
                .primaryColor
            }
          />
          <SettingInput
            name="secondaryColor"
            label="Secondary color"
            defaultValue={
              data.settings
                .secondaryColor
            }
          />

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">

                data.settings
                  .defaultNotes ||

            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">

function Toolbar({
  title,
  search,
  setSearch,
  onExport,
}: {
  title:
    string;
  search:
    string;
  setSearch:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  onExport:
    () =>
      void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="sami-surface flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-[22px] p-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
        {
          title
        }
      </h2>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
        <label className="relative block">
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-3 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            value={
              search
            }
            onChange={
              event =>
                setSearch(
                  event.target
                    .value,
                )
            }
            placeholder="Search"
            className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent pl-9 pr-3 text-xs sm:w-64"
          />
        </label>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={
            onExport
          }
          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
        >
          <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
          Export
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


function currencyTotalsLabel(
  rows: Array<{ currency: string; amount: number }>,
  fallbackCurrency: string,
) {
  if (rows.length === 0) return fallbackCurrency + ' 0.00';
  return rows.map(row =>
    row.currency + ' ' + row.amount.toLocaleString('en-KE', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }),
  ).join(' · ');
}

  label,
  value,

        {
          value
        }
      </p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">

          note
        }
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function Progress({
  label,
  value,
  state,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    number;
  state:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-400">
        <span>
          {
            label
          }
        </span>
        <span>
          {
            value
          }%
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-500/10">
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-blue-600"
          style={{
            width:
              Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                  100,
                  value,
                ),
              ) +
              '%',
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400">
        {
          state.replaceAll(
            '_',
            ' ',
          )
        }
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}


function ReportCard({

        string;

}) {

        {

        }
      </h2>

      <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {
          rows.length ===
            0
            ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  No report data yet.

            : rows.map(

                ) => (

                      index

                  >
                    <p className="text-xs font-black capitalize">
                      {
                        row.label
                      }
                    </p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-xs font-black">
                        {
                          row.primary
                        }
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {

                        }
                      </p>

                  </div>

      </div>

  );
}

function SettingInput({
  name,
  label,
  type =
    'text',
  defaultValue =
    '',
  required =
    false,
}: {
  name:
    string;
  label:
    string;
  type?:
    string;
  defaultValue?:
    string;
  required?:
    boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <SettingLabel>
        {
          label
        }
      </SettingLabel>
      <input
        name={
          name
        }
        type={
          type
        }
        defaultValue={
          defaultValue
        }
        required={
          required
        }
        min={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0'
            : undefined
        }
        step={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0.01'
            : undefined
        }
        className="mt-1 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}


function SettingArea({
  name,
  label,
  defaultValue =
    '',
}: {

    string;

    string;
}) {
  return (

      <SettingLabel>
        {
          label
        }
      </SettingLabel>
      <textarea
        name={
          name
        }
        rows={
          4
        }
        defaultValue={
          defaultValue
        }
        className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}


function Check({
  name,
  label,
  defaultChecked,
}: {
  name:
    string;
  label:
    string;
  defaultChecked:
    boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3 text-xs font-bold">
      <input
        name={
          name
        }
        type="checkbox"
        defaultChecked={
          defaultChecked
        }
        className="h-4 w-4"
      />
      {
        label
      }
    </label>
  );
}

    undatedCount: number;
    dueNext7Count: number;
    completedLast30Count: number;
    completedWithDueDateLast30Count: number;
    completedOnTimeLast30Count: number;
    onTimeRateLast30: number | null;
  };
  owners: SalesActivityOwnerSummary[];
  queue: SalesActivityQueueRow[];
};

type UserNameRow = { user_id: string; name: string };

function ownerId(value: unknown): string | null {
  return value == null || value === '' ? null : String(value);
}

export async function getSalesActivityExecutionReport(): Promise<SalesActivityExecutionReport> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );

  if (!canViewReports) {
    return {
      totals: {
        plannedCount: 0, overdueCount: 0, undatedCount: 0, dueNext7Count: 0,
        completedLast30Count: 0, completedWithDueDateLast30Count: 0,
        completedOnTimeLast30Count: 0, onTimeRateLast30: null,
      },
      owners: [],
      queue: [],
    };
  }

  const [ownerResult, queueResult] = await Promise.all([
    context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH activities AS (
          SELECT a.assigned_user_id, a.status, a.due_date, a.completed_at
          FROM sales_lead_activities a
          INNER JOIN sales_leads l
            ON l.id = a.lead_id AND l.company_id = a.company_id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
          WHERE a.company_id = $1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT a.assigned_user_id, a.status, a.due_date, a.completed_at
          FROM sales_opportunity_activities a
          INNER JOIN sales_opportunities o
            ON o.id = a.opportunity_id AND o.company_id = a.company_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          WHERE a.company_id = $1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
        )
        SELECT
          assigned_user_id::text AS owner_id,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'planned')::int AS planned_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'planned' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE)::int AS overdue_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'planned' AND due_date IS NULL)::int AS undated_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'planned' AND due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 7
          )::int AS due_next_7_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
          )::int AS completed_last_30_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'completed'
              AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
              AND due_date IS NOT NULL
          )::int AS completed_with_due_date_last_30_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'completed'
              AND completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
              AND due_date IS NOT NULL
              AND completed_at::date <= due_date
          )::int AS completed_on_time_last_30_count
        FROM activities
        GROUP BY assigned_user_id
        ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, planned_count DESC, owner_id NULLS LAST
      `,
      [context.companyId],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH activities AS (
          SELECT
            a.id AS activity_id, a.activity_type, a.subject, a.due_date, a.created_at,
            a.assigned_user_id::text AS assigned_user_id,
            'Lead'::text AS record_type, l.id AS record_id, l.lead_number AS record_number,
            l.name AS record_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(l.company_name), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(l.contact_name), ''),
              NULLIF(BTRIM(l.name), ''), 'Lead not named') AS customer_name
          FROM sales_lead_activities a
          INNER JOIN sales_leads l
            ON l.id = a.lead_id AND l.company_id = a.company_id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
          WHERE a.company_id = $1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'planned'
            AND (a.due_date IS NULL OR a.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 7)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT
            a.id AS activity_id, a.activity_type, a.subject, a.due_date, a.created_at,
            a.assigned_user_id::text AS assigned_user_id,
            'Opportunity'::text AS record_type, o.id AS record_id, o.opportunity_number AS record_number,
            o.name AS record_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.customer_name), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(o.contact_name), ''),
              NULLIF(BTRIM(o.name), ''), 'Customer not set') AS customer_name
          FROM sales_opportunity_activities a
          INNER JOIN sales_opportunities o
            ON o.id = a.opportunity_id AND o.company_id = a.company_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          WHERE a.company_id = $1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'planned'
            AND (a.due_date IS NULL OR a.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 7)
        )
        SELECT
          activity_id, activity_type, subject, due_date::text AS due_date,
          GREATEST(0, CURRENT_DATE - due_date)::int AS days_overdue,
          record_type, record_id, record_number, record_name, customer_name, assigned_user_id
        FROM activities
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 0 WHEN due_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
          due_date ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC, activity_id ASC
        LIMIT 25
      `,
      [context.companyId],
    ),
  ]);

  const ids = Array.from(new Set([
    ...ownerResult.rows.map(row => ownerId(row.owner_id)),
    ...queueResult.rows.map(row => ownerId(row.assigned_user_id)),
  ].filter((id): id is string => id !== null)));

  let activeUsers: UserNameRow[] = [];
  if (ids.length > 0) {
    const users = await queryControl(
      `
        SELECT tu.user_id::text AS user_id,
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(u.full_name, '')), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), u.email) AS name
        FROM tenant_users tu
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tu.user_id
        WHERE tu.tenant_id = $1 AND tu.user_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
          AND tu.status = 'active' AND tu.member_type = 'internal'
          AND tu.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      `,
      [context.tenantId, ids],
    );
    activeUsers = users.rows.map(row => ({ user_id: String(row.user_id), name: String(row.name || 'Salesperson') }));
  }
  const names = new Map(activeUsers.map(user => [user.user_id, user.name]));
  const displayOwner = (id: string | null) => id === null
    ? 'Unassigned'
    : names.get(id) || 'Inactive or unavailable user';

  const owners: SalesActivityOwnerSummary[] = ownerResult.rows.map(row => {
    const id = ownerId(row.owner_id);
    const completedWithDue = Number(row.completed_with_due_date_last_30_count || 0);
    const completedOnTime = Number(row.completed_on_time_last_30_count || 0);
    return {
      ownerId: id,
      ownerName: displayOwner(id),
      plannedCount: Number(row.planned_count || 0),
      overdueCount: Number(row.overdue_count || 0),
      undatedCount: Number(row.undated_count || 0),
      dueNext7Count: Number(row.due_next_7_count || 0),
      completedLast30Count: Number(row.completed_last_30_count || 0),
      completedWithDueDateLast30Count: completedWithDue,
      completedOnTimeLast30Count: completedOnTime,
      onTimeRateLast30: completedWithDue > 0
        ? Math.round(completedOnTime / completedWithDue * 1000) / 10
        : null,
    };
  });

  const totals = owners.reduce<SalesActivityExecutionReport['totals']>((acc, owner) => ({
    plannedCount: acc.plannedCount + owner.plannedCount,
    overdueCount: acc.overdueCount + owner.overdueCount,
    undatedCount: acc.undatedCount + owner.undatedCount,
    dueNext7Count: acc.dueNext7Count + owner.dueNext7Count,
    completedLast30Count: acc.completedLast30Count + owner.completedLast30Count,
    completedWithDueDateLast30Count: acc.completedWithDueDateLast30Count + owner.completedWithDueDateLast30Count,
    completedOnTimeLast30Count: acc.completedOnTimeLast30Count + owner.completedOnTimeLast30Count,
    onTimeRateLast30: null,
  }), {
    plannedCount: 0, overdueCount: 0, undatedCount: 0, dueNext7Count: 0,
    completedLast30Count: 0, completedWithDueDateLast30Count: 0,
    completedOnTimeLast30Count: 0, onTimeRateLast30: null,
  });
  totals.onTimeRateLast30 = totals.completedWithDueDateLast30Count > 0
    ? Math.round(totals.completedOnTimeLast30Count / totals.completedWithDueDateLast30Count * 1000) / 10
    : null;

  const queue: SalesActivityQueueRow[] = queueResult.rows.map(row => {
    const id = ownerId(row.assigned_user_id);
    return {
      activityId: String(row.activity_id),
      activityType: String(row.activity_type),
      subject: String(row.subject),
      dueDate: row.due_date ? String(row.due_date).slice(0, 10) : null,
      daysOverdue: Number(row.days_overdue || 0),
      recordType: String(row.record_type) as 'Lead' | 'Opportunity',
      recordId: String(row.record_id),
      recordNumber: String(row.record_number),
      recordName: String(row.record_name),
      customerName: String(row.customer_name || 'Customer not set'),
      assignedUserId: id,
      assignedUserName: displayOwner(id),
    };
  });

  return { totals, owners, queue };
}

/**
 * Shared quote-approval threshold semantics.
 *
 * The legacy company-wide threshold is denominated in the company's base
 * currency. Advanced policies with an explicit currency filter use the quote
 * currency; unscoped monetary policy thresholds use the snapshotted base value.
 */
function finiteAmount(value: unknown): number {
  const amount = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0;
}

export function salesQuoteRequiresLegacyApproval(
  enabled: unknown,
  threshold: unknown,
  baseTotalAmount: unknown,
): boolean {
  return enabled === true &&
    finiteAmount(baseTotalAmount) >= finiteAmount(threshold);
}

export function salesQuoteApprovalPolicyMatches(
  policy: Record<string, unknown>,
  quote: Record<string, unknown>,
): boolean {
  const policyCurrency = String(policy.currency_code ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const quoteCurrency = String(quote.currency ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (policyCurrency && policyCurrency !== quoteCurrency) return false;

  // A currency-scoped policy states its monetary unit explicitly. Without a
  // currency scope, compare against the immutable company-base snapshot.
  const quoteTotal = finiteAmount(
    policyCurrency ? quote.total_amount : quote.base_total_amount,
  );
  const subtotal = finiteAmount(quote.subtotal);
  const discountPercent = subtotal > 0
    ? finiteAmount(quote.discount_total) / subtotal * 100
    : 0;
  const marginPercent = quote.margin_percent == null
    ? null
    : finiteAmount(quote.margin_percent);
  const triggers: boolean[] = [];

  if (policy.min_quote_total != null) {
    triggers.push(quoteTotal >= finiteAmount(policy.min_quote_total));
  }
  if (policy.max_discount_percent != null) {
    triggers.push(discountPercent > finiteAmount(policy.max_discount_percent));
  }
  if (policy.min_margin_percent != null) {
    triggers.push(marginPercent == null || marginPercent < finiteAmount(policy.min_margin_percent));
  }

  return triggers.some(Boolean);
}
