type SalesRevisionRecord = Record<string, unknown>;
type SalesRevisionChange = {
  type: 'added' | 'removed' | 'changed';
  section: string;
  label: string;
  field: string;
  before: string | null;
  after: string | null;
};

function salesRevisionRecord(value: unknown): SalesRevisionRecord {
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value as SalesRevisionRecord;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try {
      const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed as SalesRevisionRecord;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return {};
}

function salesRevisionValue(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try { return JSON.stringify(value); } catch { return String(value); }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function salesRevisionItemLabel(item: SalesRevisionRecord, index: number): string {
  const description = String(item.description ?? '').trim();
  const sku = String(item.sku_snapshot ?? item.sku ?? '').trim();
  return description || (sku ? 'SKU ' + sku : 'Line ' + (index + 1));
}

function compareSalesRevisionCollection(
  changes: SalesRevisionChange[],
  section: string,
  beforeItems: unknown,
  afterItems: unknown,
  fields: Array<[string, string]>,
) {
  const before = Array.isArray(beforeItems) ? beforeItems.map(salesRevisionRecord) : [];
  const after = Array.isArray(afterItems) ? afterItems.map(salesRevisionRecord) : [];
  const keyFor = (item: SalesRevisionRecord, index: number) => {
    const sortOrder = String(item.sort_order ?? index);
    const productId = String(item.catalog_item_id ?? '');
    const sku = String(item.sku_snapshot ?? '');
    return productId
      ? sortOrder + ':product:' + productId
      : sortOrder + ':manual:' + (sku || String(item.description ?? ''));
  };
  const beforeMap = new Map<string, { item: SalesRevisionRecord; index: number }>();
  const afterMap = new Map<string, { item: SalesRevisionRecord; index: number }>();
  before.forEach((item, index) => beforeMap.set(keyFor(item, index), { item, index }));
  after.forEach((item, index) => afterMap.set(keyFor(item, index), { item, index }));

  for (const [key, current] of beforeMap) {
    const next = afterMap.get(key);
    if (!next) {
      changes.push({
        type: 'removed',
        section,
        label: salesRevisionItemLabel(current.item, current.index),
        field: section === 'Line item' ? 'Line item' : 'Optional product',
        before: salesRevisionValue(current.item.description) ?? salesRevisionItemLabel(current.item, current.index),
        after: null,
      });
      continue;
    }
    const label = salesRevisionItemLabel(next.item, next.index);
    for (const [field, fieldLabel] of fields) {
      const oldValue = current.item[field];
      const newValue = next.item[field];
      if (salesRevisionValue(oldValue) !== salesRevisionValue(newValue)) {
        changes.push({
          type: 'changed',
          section,
          label,
          field: fieldLabel,
          before: salesRevisionValue(oldValue),
          after: salesRevisionValue(newValue),
        });
      }
    }
  }

  for (const [key, current] of afterMap) {
    if (beforeMap.has(key)) continue;
    changes.push({
      type: 'added',
      section,
      label: salesRevisionItemLabel(current.item, current.index),
      field: section === 'Line item' ? 'Line item' : 'Optional product',
      before: null,
      after: salesRevisionValue(current.item.description) ?? salesRevisionItemLabel(current.item, current.index),
    });
  }
}

export async function getSalesQuoteRevisionDiff(input: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const quoteId = requireUuid(input.quoteId, 'Quotation');
  const rawRevisionNumber = Number(input.revisionNumber);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(rawRevisionNumber) || rawRevisionNumber < 1 || rawRevisionNumber > 100_000) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a valid quotation revision.');
  }

  const [currentQuoteResult, currentLinesResult, currentOptionalItemsResult, selectedResult] = await Promise.all([
    context.pool.query(
      `SELECT *
       FROM sales_quotes
       WHERE id = $1 AND company_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
       LIMIT 1`,
      [quoteId, context.companyId],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `SELECT *
       FROM sales_quote_items
       WHERE quote_id = $1 AND company_id = $2
       ORDER BY sort_order, id`,
      [quoteId, context.companyId],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `SELECT *
       FROM sales_quote_optional_items
       WHERE quote_id = $1 AND company_id = $2
       ORDER BY sort_order, id`,
      [quoteId, context.companyId],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `SELECT revision_number, snapshot
       FROM sales_quote_revisions
       WHERE quote_id = $1 AND company_id = $2 AND revision_number = $3
       LIMIT 1`,
      [quoteId, context.companyId, rawRevisionNumber],
    ),
  ]);

  if (currentQuoteResult.rows.length !== 1) {
    throw new SalesError('QUOTE_NOT_FOUND', 'Quotation was not found.');
  }
  const currentRevision = Math.max(1, Number(currentQuoteResult.rows[0].current_revision || 1));
  if (rawRevisionNumber >= currentRevision) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a saved previous revision to compare with the current quotation.');
  }
  if (selectedResult.rows.length !== 1) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'The selected quotation revision was not found.');
  }

  const selected = salesRevisionRecord(selectedResult.rows[0].snapshot);
  const currentSnapshot = {
    quote: currentQuoteResult.rows[0] as SalesRevisionRecord,
    lines: currentLinesResult.rows as SalesRevisionRecord[],
    optionalItems: currentOptionalItemsResult.rows as SalesRevisionRecord[],
  };
  const changes: SalesRevisionChange[] = [];

  {
    const oldQuote = salesRevisionRecord(selected.quote);
    const newQuote = salesRevisionRecord(currentSnapshot.quote);
    const canViewMargin = salesCapabilities(
      context.permissions.isOwner,
      context.permissions.permissionSet,
    ).canViewMargin;
    const quoteFields: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ['customer_name', 'Customer'],
      ['customer_email', 'Customer email'],
      ['customer_phone', 'Customer phone'],
      ['customer_tax_id', 'Customer tax ID'],
      ['billing_address', 'Billing address'],
      ['shipping_address', 'Shipping address'],
      ['quote_date', 'Quotation date'],
      ['valid_until', 'Valid until'],
      ['currency', 'Currency'],
      ['exchange_rate', 'Exchange rate'],
      ['reference', 'Reference'],
      ['template_id', 'Quotation template'],
      ['pricelist_id', 'Pricelist'],
      ['salesperson_user_id', 'Salesperson'],
      ['sales_team_id', 'Sales team'],
      ['territory_id', 'Territory'],
      ['subtotal', 'Subtotal'],
      ['discount_total', 'Discount total'],
      ['tax_total', 'Tax total'],
      ['shipping_total', 'Shipping total'],
      ['total_amount', 'Total'],
      ['deposit_type', 'Deposit type'],
      ['deposit_value', 'Deposit value'],
      ['notes', 'Customer notes'],
      ['terms', 'Terms and conditions'],
      ['internal_notes', 'Internal notes'],
    ];
    if (canViewMargin) {
      quoteFields.push(
        ['cost_total', 'Cost total'],
        ['margin_amount', 'Margin'],
        ['margin_percent', 'Margin percent'],
      );
    }
    for (const [field, label] of quoteFields) {
      const beforeValue = oldQuote[field];
      const afterValue = newQuote[field];
      if (salesRevisionValue(beforeValue) !== salesRevisionValue(afterValue)) {
        changes.push({
          type: 'changed',
          section: 'Quotation',
          label,
          field: label,
          before: salesRevisionValue(beforeValue),
          after: salesRevisionValue(afterValue),
        });
      }
    }

    const lineFields: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ['description', 'Description'],
      ['sku_snapshot', 'SKU'],
      ['unit', 'Unit'],
      ['quantity', 'Quantity'],
      ['unit_price', 'Unit price'],
      ['discount_type', 'Discount type'],
      ['discount_value', 'Discount value'],
      ['discount_amount', 'Discount amount'],
      ['tax_name_snapshot', 'Tax'],
      ['tax_rate', 'Tax rate'],
      ['tax_amount', 'Tax amount'],
      ['subtotal', 'Subtotal'],
      ['line_total', 'Line total'],
    ];
    if (canViewMargin) {
      lineFields.push(
        ['unit_cost', 'Unit cost'],
        ['cost_total', 'Cost total'],
        ['margin_amount', 'Margin'],
        ['margin_percent', 'Margin percent'],
      );
    }
    compareSalesRevisionCollection(changes, 'Line item', selected.lines, currentSnapshot.lines, lineFields);

    const optionalFields: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ['description', 'Description'],
      ['sku_snapshot', 'SKU'],
      ['unit', 'Unit'],
      ['quantity', 'Quantity'],
      ['unit_price', 'Unit price'],
      ['tax_name_snapshot', 'Tax'],
      ['tax_rate', 'Tax rate'],
      ['is_selected', 'Selected'],
    ];
    if (canViewMargin) optionalFields.push(['unit_cost', 'Unit cost']);
    compareSalesRevisionCollection(changes, 'Optional product', selected.optionalItems, currentSnapshot.optionalItems, optionalFields);
  }

  return {
    quoteId,
    revisionNumber: rawRevisionNumber,
    comparedToRevisionNumber: currentRevision,
    hasComparison: true,
    changes,
    message: null,
  };
}


export async function getSalesOrderDetail(
  orderId:
    string,
): Promise<
  SalesOrderDetail |
  null
> {
  const context =
    await requireSalesContext(
      SALES_PERMISSIONS
        .ORDER_VIEW,
    );

  const settings =
    (
      await context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            invoice_policy
          FROM sales_settings
          WHERE company_id = $1
          LIMIT 1
        `,
        [
          context.companyId,
        ],
      )
    ).rows[0] ||
    {};

  const invoicePolicy =
    settings.invoice_policy ===
      'delivered'
      ? 'delivered'
      : 'ordered';

  const access = salesCapabilities(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
  );

  const [
    order,
    lines,
    invoices,
    history,
    shipments,
    returns,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            o.*,
            (
              EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM sales_returns received_return
                WHERE received_return.sales_order_id = o.id
                  AND received_return.company_id = o.company_id
                  AND received_return.status = 'received'
              )
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM sales_commission_entries commission_entry
                WHERE commission_entry.order_id = o.id
                  AND commission_entry.company_id = o.company_id
                  AND commission_entry.status = 'accrued'
              )
            ) AS margin_commission_stale,
            q.quote_number,
            q.billing_customer_id,
            COALESCE(
              SUM(oi.quantity),
              0
            ) AS ordered_quantity,
            COALESCE(
              SUM(oi.delivered_quantity),
              0
            ) AS delivered_quantity,
            COALESCE(
              SUM(oi.invoiced_quantity),
              0
            ) AS invoiced_quantity
          FROM sales_orders_v2 o
          LEFT JOIN sales_quotes q
            ON q.id =
               o.quote_id
           AND q.company_id =
               o.company_id
          LEFT JOIN sales_order_items_v2 oi
            ON oi.sales_order_id =
               o.id
           AND oi.company_id =
               o.company_id
          WHERE o.id = $1
            AND o.company_id = $2
            AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          GROUP BY
            o.id,
            q.quote_number,
            q.billing_customer_id
          LIMIT 1
        `,
        [
          orderId,
          context.companyId,
        ],
      ),

      context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            line.id,
            line.catalog_item_id,
            line.description,
            line.sku_snapshot,
            line.unit,
            line.quantity,
            line.shipped_quantity,
            COALESCE(planned_shipments.planned_quantity, 0) AS planned_quantity,
            line.delivered_quantity,
            line.invoiced_quantity,
            line.returned_quantity,
            line.credited_quantity,
            line.unit_price,
            line.unit_cost,
            line.cost_total,
            line.margin_amount,
            line.margin_percent,
            line.discount_type,
            line.discount_value,
            line.tax_name_snapshot,
            line.tax_rate,
            line.line_total
          FROM sales_order_items_v2 line
          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(shipment_item.quantity), 0) AS planned_quantity
            FROM sales_shipment_items shipment_item
            INNER JOIN sales_shipments shipment
              ON shipment.id = shipment_item.shipment_id
             AND shipment.company_id = shipment_item.company_id
            WHERE shipment_item.sales_order_line_id = line.id
              AND shipment_item.company_id = line.company_id
              AND shipment.inventory_posted_at IS NULL
              AND shipment.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
          ) planned_shipments ON TRUE
          WHERE line.sales_order_id = $1
            AND line.company_id = $2
          ORDER BY
            line.sort_order,
            line.id
        `,
        [
          orderId,
          context.companyId,
        ],
      ),

      context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            id,
            invoice_id,
            source_reference,
            status,
            created_at
          FROM sales_order_invoice_batches
          WHERE sales_order_id = $1
            AND company_id = $2
          ORDER BY
            created_at DESC
        `,
        [
          orderId,
          context.companyId,
        ],
      ),

      context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            id,
            from_status,
            to_status,
            reason,
            created_at
          FROM sales_order_status_history
          WHERE sales_order_id = $1
            AND company_id = $2
          ORDER BY
            created_at DESC
          LIMIT 200
        `,
        [
          orderId,
          context.companyId,
        ],
      ),

      context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            shipment.id,
            shipment.shipment_number,
            shipment.status,
            shipment.carrier,
            shipment.service_level,
            shipment.tracking_number,
            shipment.tracking_url,
            shipment.recipient_name,
            shipment.proof_note,
            shipment.shipped_at,
            shipment.delivered_at,
            shipment.inventory_posted_at,
            COALESCE(
              jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                  'id',
                  item.id,
                  'salesOrderLineId',
                  item.sales_order_line_id,
                  'quantity',
                  item.quantity
                )
                ORDER BY item.id
              )
              FILTER (
                WHERE item.id IS NOT NULL
              ),
              '[]'::jsonb
            ) AS items
          FROM sales_shipments shipment
          LEFT JOIN sales_shipment_items item
            ON item.shipment_id =
               shipment.id
           AND item.company_id =
               shipment.company_id
          WHERE shipment.sales_order_id = $1
            AND shipment.company_id = $2
          GROUP BY
            shipment.id
          ORDER BY
            shipment.created_at DESC
        `,
        [
          orderId,
          context.companyId,
        ],
      ),

      context.pool.query(
        `
          SELECT
            return_row.id,
            return_row.return_number,
            return_row.status,
            return_row.reason,
            return_row.requested_at,
            return_row.approved_at,
            return_row.received_at,
            return_row.credited_at,
            return_row.refunded_at,
            COALESCE(
              (
                SELECT
                  jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                      'id',
                      item.id,
                      'salesOrderLineId',
                      item.sales_order_line_id,
                      'quantity',
                      item.quantity
                    )
                    ORDER BY item.id
                  )
                FROM sales_return_items item
                WHERE item.return_id =
                      return_row.id
                  AND item.company_id =
                      return_row.company_id
              ),
              '[]'::jsonb
            ) AS items,
            COALESCE(
              (
                SELECT
                  jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                      'id',
                      credit.id,
                      'invoiceId',
                      credit.invoice_id,
                      'creditNoteId',
                      credit.credit_note_id,
                      'creditNoteNumber',
                      credit.credit_note_number,
                      'amount',
                      credit.amount,
                      'availableCredit',
                      credit.available_credit,
                      'refundedAmount',
                      credit.refunded_amount
                    )
                    ORDER BY
                      credit.created_at
                  )
                FROM sales_return_credits credit
                WHERE credit.return_id =
                      return_row.id
                  AND credit.company_id =
                      return_row.company_id
              ),
              '[]'::jsonb
            ) AS credits
          FROM sales_returns return_row
          WHERE return_row.sales_order_id = $1
            AND return_row.company_id = $2
          ORDER BY
            return_row.created_at DESC
        `,
        [
          orderId,
          context.companyId,
        ],
      ),
    ]);

  if (
    order.rows.length !==
      1
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const row =
    order.rows[0];

  const orderedQuantity =
    Number(
      row.ordered_quantity ||
      0,
    );

  const deliveredQuantity =
    Number(
      row.delivered_quantity ||
      0,
    );

  const invoicedQuantity =
    Number(
      row.invoiced_quantity ||
      0,
    );

  return {
    id:
      String(
        row.id,
      ),
    orderNumber:
      String(
        row.order_number,
      ),
    quoteId:
      row.quote_id
        ? String(
            row.quote_id,
          )
        : null,
    quoteNumber:
      row.quote_number
        ? String(
            row.quote_number,
          )
        : null,
    latestInvoiceId:
      row.latest_invoice_id
        ? String(
            row.latest_invoice_id,
          )
        : null,
    status:
      String(
        row.status,
      ),
    fulfillmentStatus:
      String(
        row.fulfillment_status ||
        'not_started',
      ),
    invoiceStatus:
      String(
        row.invoice_status ||
        'not_invoiced',
      ),
    orderDate:
      String(
        row.order_date,
      ),
    currency:
      String(
        row.currency,
      ),
    baseCurrency:
      String(
        row.base_currency ||
        context.company
          .currentCompany
          .currency ||
        row.currency,
      ),
    exchangeRate:
      Number(
        row.exchange_rate ||
        1,
      ),
    exchangeRateDate:
      String(
        row.exchange_rate_date ||
        row.order_date,
      ).slice(
        0,
        10,
      ),
    exchangeRateSource:
      String(
        row.exchange_rate_source ||
        'base',
      ),
    baseTotalAmount:
      money(
        row.base_total_amount ??
        row.total_amount,
      ),
    customerName:
      String(
        row.customer_name,
      ),
    totalAmount:
      money(
        row.total_amount,
      ),
    costTotal:
      access.canViewMargin
        ? money(row.cost_total)
        : null,
    marginAmount:
      access.canViewMargin
        ? money(row.margin_amount)
        : null,
    marginPercent:
      access.canViewMargin
        ? money(row.margin_percent)
        : null,
    marginCommissionStale:
      row.margin_commission_stale === true,
    deliveredPercent:
      orderedQuantity >
        0
        ? Math.min(
            100,
            Math.round(
              deliveredQuantity /
              orderedQuantity *
              100,
            ),
          )
        : 0,
    invoicedPercent:
      orderedQuantity >
        0
        ? Math.min(
            100,
            Math.round(
              invoicedQuantity /
              orderedQuantity *
              100,
            ),
          )
        : 0,
    billingCustomerId:
      row.billing_customer_id
        ? String(
            row.billing_customer_id,
          )
        : null,
    customerEmail:
      row.customer_email
        ? String(
            row.customer_email,
          )
        : null,
    customerPhone:
      row.customer_phone
        ? String(
            row.customer_phone,
          )
        : null,
    customerTaxId:
      row.customer_tax_id
        ? String(
            row.customer_tax_id,
          )
        : null,
    billingAddress:
      row.billing_address
        ? String(
            row.billing_address,
          )
        : null,
    shippingAddress:
      row.shipping_address
        ? String(
            row.shipping_address,
          )
        : null,
    reference:
      row.reference
        ? String(
            row.reference,
          )
        : null,
    subtotal:
      money(
        row.subtotal,
      ),
    discountTotal:
      money(
        row.discount_total,
      ),
    taxTotal:
      money(
        row.tax_total,
      ),
    shippingTotal:
      money(
        row.shipping_total,
      ),
    depositType:
      row.deposit_type ===
        'percent'
        ? 'percent'
        : row.deposit_type ===
            'fixed'
          ? 'fixed'
          : 'none',
    depositValue:
      money(
        row.deposit_value,
      ),
    depositRequiredAmount:
      money(
        row.deposit_required_amount,
      ),
    depositReceivedAmount:
      money(
        row.deposit_received_amount,
      ),
    depositStatus:
      String(
        row.deposit_status ||
        'none',
      ),
    depositRetainerId:
      row.deposit_retainer_id
        ? String(
            row.deposit_retainer_id,
          )
        : null,
    depositPaymentId:
      row.deposit_payment_id
        ? String(
            row.deposit_payment_id,
          )
        : null,
    notes:
      row.notes
        ? String(
            row.notes,
          )
        : null,
    terms:
      row.terms
        ? String(
            row.terms,
          )
        : null,
    lines:
      lines.rows.map(
        line => {
          const quantity =
            Number(
              line.quantity,
            );

          const delivered =
            Number(
              line.delivered_quantity ||
              0,
            );

          const invoiced =
            Number(
              line.invoiced_quantity ||
              0,
            );

          const eligible =
            invoicePolicy ===
              'delivered'
              ? delivered
              : quantity;

          return {
            id:
              String(
                line.id,
              ),
            catalogItemId:
              line.catalog_item_id
                ? String(
                    line.catalog_item_id,
                  )
                : null,
            description:
              String(
                line.description,
              ),
            sku:
              line.sku_snapshot
                ? String(
                    line.sku_snapshot,
                  )
                : null,
            unit:
              String(
                line.unit ||
                'unit',
              ),
            quantity,
            shippedQuantity:
              Number(line.shipped_quantity || 0),
            plannedQuantity:
              Number(line.planned_quantity || 0),
            deliveredQuantity:
              delivered,
            invoicedQuantity:
              invoiced,
            returnedQuantity:
              Number(
                line.returned_quantity ||
                0,
              ),
            creditedQuantity:
              Number(
                line.credited_quantity ||
                0,
              ),
            invoiceableQuantity:
              Math.max(
                0,
                eligible -
                invoiced,
              ),
            unitPrice:
              money(
                line.unit_price,
              ),
            unitCost:
              access.canViewMargin
                ? money(line.unit_cost)
                : null,
            costTotal:
              access.canViewMargin
                ? money(line.cost_total)
                : null,
            marginAmount:
              access.canViewMargin
                ? money(line.margin_amount)
                : null,
            marginPercent:
              access.canViewMargin
                ? money(line.margin_percent)
                : null,
            discountType:
              line.discount_type ===
                'fixed'
                ? 'fixed'
                : 'percent',
            discountValue:
              money(
                line.discount_value,
              ),
            taxName:
              line.tax_name_snapshot
                ? String(
                    line.tax_name_snapshot,
                  )
                : null,
            taxRate:
              Number(
                line.tax_rate,
              ),
            lineTotal:
              money(
                line.line_total,
              ),
          };
        },
      ),
    shipments:
      shipments.rows.map(
        item => ({
          id:
            String(
              item.id,
            ),
          shipmentNumber:
            String(
              item.shipment_number,
            ),
          status:
            String(
              item.status,
            ),
          carrier:
            item.carrier
              ? String(
                  item.carrier,
                )
              : null,
          serviceLevel:
            item.service_level
              ? String(
                  item.service_level,
                )
              : null,
          trackingNumber:
            item.tracking_number
              ? String(
                  item.tracking_number,
                )
              : null,
          trackingUrl:
            item.tracking_url
              ? String(
                  item.tracking_url,
                )
              : null,
          recipientName:
            item.recipient_name
              ? String(
                  item.recipient_name,
                )
              : null,
          proofNote:
            item.proof_note
              ? String(
                  item.proof_note,
                )
              : null,
          shippedAt:
            item.shipped_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.shipped_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          deliveredAt:
            item.delivered_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.delivered_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          inventoryPostedAt:
            item.inventory_posted_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.inventory_posted_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          items:
            Array.isArray(
              item.items,
            )
              ? item.items.map(
                  (
                    line:
                      Record<
                        string,
                        unknown
                      >,
                  ) => ({
                    id:
                      String(
                        line.id,
                      ),
                    salesOrderLineId:
                      String(
                        line.salesOrderLineId,
                      ),
                    quantity:
                      Number(
                        line.quantity ||
                        0,
                      ),
                  }),
                )
              : [],
        }),
      ),
    returns:
      returns.rows.map(
        item => ({
          id:
            String(
              item.id,
            ),
          returnNumber:
            String(
              item.return_number,
            ),
          status:
            String(
              item.status,
            ),
          reason:
            String(
              item.reason,
            ),
          requestedAt:
            new Date(
              item.requested_at,
            ).toISOString(),
          approvedAt:
            item.approved_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.approved_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          receivedAt:
            item.received_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.received_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          creditedAt:
            item.credited_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.credited_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          refundedAt:
            item.refunded_at
              ? new Date(
                  item.refunded_at,
                ).toISOString()
              : null,
          items:
            Array.isArray(
              item.items,
            )
              ? item.items.map(
                  (
                    line:
                      Record<
                        string,
                        unknown
                      >,
                  ) => ({
                    id:
                      String(
                        line.id,
                      ),
                    salesOrderLineId:
                      String(
                        line.salesOrderLineId,
                      ),
                    quantity:
                      Number(
                        line.quantity ||
                        0,
                      ),
                  }),
                )
              : [],
          credits:
            Array.isArray(
              item.credits,
            )
              ? item.credits.map(
                  (
                    credit:
                      Record<
                        string,
                        unknown
                      >,
                  ) => ({
                    id:
                      String(
                        credit.id,
                      ),
                    invoiceId:
                      String(
                        credit.invoiceId,
                      ),
                    creditNoteId:
                      String(
                        credit.creditNoteId,
                      ),
                    creditNoteNumber:
                      String(
                        credit.creditNoteNumber,
                      ),
                    amount:
                      money(
                        credit.amount,
                      ),
                    availableCredit:
                      money(
                        credit.availableCredit,
                      ),
                    refundedAmount:
                      money(
                        credit.refundedAmount,
                      ),
                  }),
                )
              : [],
        }),
      ),
    invoices:
      invoices.rows.map(
        item => ({
          batchId:
            String(
              item.id,
            ),
          invoiceId:
            item.invoice_id
              ? String(
                  item.invoice_id,
                )
              : null,
          sourceReference:
            String(
              item.source_reference,
            ),
          status:
            String(
              item.status,
            ),
          createdAt:
            new Date(
              item.created_at,
            ).toISOString(),
        }),
      ),
    history:
      history.rows.map(
        item => ({
          id:
            String(
              item.id,
            ),
          fromStatus:
            item.from_status
              ? String(
                  item.from_status,
                )
              : null,
          toStatus:
            String(
              item.to_status,
            ),
          reason:
            item.reason
              ? String(
                  item.reason,
                )
              : null,
          createdAt:
            new Date(
              item.created_at,
            ).toISOString(),
        }),
      ),
  };
}


export async function searchSalesRecords(
  tenantId:
    string,
  companyId:
    string,
  query:
    string,
  limit =
    15,
) {
  const pool =
    await getTenantPoolByTenantId(
      tenantId,
    );

  const safeLimit =
    Math.max(
      1,
      Math.min(
        50,
        Math.floor(
          Number(
            limit,
          ) ||
          15,
        ),
      ),
    );

  const q =
    '%' +
    query
      .trim()
      .slice(
        0,
        120,
      ) +
    '%';

  const result =
    await pool.query(
      `
        SELECT *
        FROM (
          SELECT
            'quote'
              AS kind,
            q.id,
            q.quote_number
              AS number,
            q.customer_name,
            q.status,
            q.total_amount,
            q.currency,
            q.created_at
          FROM sales_quotes q
          WHERE q.company_id = $1
            AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND (
              q.quote_number ILIKE $2
              OR q.customer_name ILIKE $2
              OR COALESCE(
                   q.customer_email,
                   ''
                 ) ILIKE $2
              OR COALESCE(
                   q.reference,
                   ''
                 ) ILIKE $2
            )

          UNION ALL

          SELECT
            'order'
              AS kind,
            o.id,
            o.order_number
              AS number,
            o.customer_name,
            o.status,
            o.total_amount,
            o.currency,
            o.created_at
          FROM sales_orders_v2 o
          WHERE o.company_id = $1
            AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND (
              o.order_number ILIKE $2
              OR o.customer_name ILIKE $2
              OR COALESCE(
                   o.reference,
                   ''
                 ) ILIKE $2
            )
        ) records
        ORDER BY created_at DESC
        LIMIT $3
      `,
      [
        companyId,
        q,
        safeLimit,
      ],
    );

  return result.rows.map(
    row => ({
      kind:
        String(
          row.kind,
        ),
      id:
        String(
          row.id,
        ),
      number:
        String(
          row.number,
        ),
      customerName:
        String(
          row.customer_name,
        ),
      status:
        String(
          row.status,
        ),
      totalAmount:
        money(
          row.total_amount,
        ),
      currency:
        String(
          row.currency,
        ),
    }),
  );
}


export async function searchSalesPipelineRecords(
  tenantId: string,
  companyId: string,
  query: string,
  limit = 15,
) {
  const pool = await getTenantPoolByTenantId(tenantId);
  const safeLimit = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.min(50, Math.floor(Number(limit) || 15)),
  );
  const q = '%' + query.trim().slice(0, 120) + '%';

  const result = await pool.query(
    `
      SELECT *
      FROM (
        SELECT
          'lead' AS kind,
          l.id,
          l.lead_number AS number,
          l.name AS title,
          COALESCE(
            NULLIF(l.company_name, ''),
            NULLIF(l.contact_name, ''),
            NULLIF(l.email, '')
          ) AS subtitle,
          CONCAT_WS(
            ' · ',
            NULLIF(l.lead_number, ''),
            NULLIF(l.contact_name, ''),
            NULLIF(l.email, ''),
            NULLIF(l.phone, '')
          ) AS description,
          l.status AS badge,
          l.created_at
        FROM sales_leads l
        WHERE l.company_id = $1
          AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
            l.lead_number ILIKE $2
            OR l.name ILIKE $2
            OR COALESCE(l.company_name, '') ILIKE $2
            OR COALESCE(l.contact_name, '') ILIKE $2
            OR COALESCE(l.email, '') ILIKE $2
            OR COALESCE(l.phone, '') ILIKE $2
          )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
          'opportunity' AS kind,
          o.id,
          o.opportunity_number AS number,
          o.name AS title,
          COALESCE(
            NULLIF(o.customer_name, ''),
            NULLIF(o.contact_name, '')
          ) AS subtitle,
          o.opportunity_number AS description,
          COALESCE(
            NULLIF(stage.name, ''),
            CASE
              WHEN o.won_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Won'
              WHEN o.lost_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lost'
              ELSE 'Opportunity'
            END
          ) AS badge,
          o.created_at
        FROM sales_opportunities o
        LEFT JOIN sales_pipeline_stages stage
          ON stage.id = o.stage_id
          AND stage.company_id = o.company_id
          AND stage.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE o.company_id = $1
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
            o.opportunity_number ILIKE $2
            OR o.name ILIKE $2
            OR COALESCE(o.customer_name, '') ILIKE $2
          )
      ) records
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT $3
    `,
    [companyId, q, safeLimit],
  );

  return result.rows.map(row => ({
    kind: String(row.kind) as 'lead' | 'opportunity',
    id: String(row.id),
    number: String(row.number),
    title: String(row.title),
    subtitle: row.subtitle == null ? null : String(row.subtitle),
    description: row.description == null ? null : String(row.description),
    badge: row.badge == null ? null : String(row.badge),
  }));
}

const SALES_REGISTER_PAGE_SIZE = 250;

function normalizeSalesRegisterOffset(value: unknown) {
  const parsed = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed)
    ? Math.min(1_000_000, Math.max(0, Math.floor(parsed)))
    : 0;
}

function normalizeSalesRegisterLimit(value: unknown) {
  const parsed = Number(value ?? SALES_REGISTER_PAGE_SIZE);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed)
    ? Math.min(SALES_REGISTER_PAGE_SIZE, Math.max(1, Math.floor(parsed)))
    : SALES_REGISTER_PAGE_SIZE;
}

function normalizeQuoteRegisterStatus(value: unknown): SalesQuoteStatusView {
  const allowed: SalesQuoteStatusView[] = [
    'all', 'draft', 'needs_approval', 'awaiting_response',
    'accepted', 'converted', 'closed_without_sale', 'expired', 'expiring_soon',
  ];
  const status = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
  return allowed.includes(status as SalesQuoteStatusView)
    ? status as SalesQuoteStatusView
    : 'all';
}

function normalizeOrderRegisterStatus(value: unknown) {
  const allowed = [
    'all', 'awaiting_fulfillment', 'partially_fulfilled', 'fulfilled',
    'not_invoiced', 'partially_invoiced', 'invoiced',
  ] as const;
  const status = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
  return allowed.includes(status as typeof allowed[number])
    ? status as typeof allowed[number]
    : 'all';
}

function normalizeOrderRegisterSort(value: unknown): SalesOrderSortBy {
  const allowed: SalesOrderSortBy[] = [
    'newest', 'oldest', 'value_high', 'value_low',
    'delivery_first', 'invoice_first', 'customer_az',
  ];
  const sort = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
  return allowed.includes(sort as SalesOrderSortBy)
    ? sort as SalesOrderSortBy
    : 'newest';
}

export async function getSalesQuoteRegisterPage(input: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const offset = normalizeSalesRegisterOffset(input.offset);
  const limit = normalizeSalesRegisterLimit(input.limit);
  const search = typeof input.search === 'string' ? input.search.trim().slice(0, 120) : '';
  const statusView = normalizeQuoteRegisterStatus(input.statusView);

  const parameters = [context.companyId, search, statusView];
  const searchSql = `
    AND (
      $2::text = ''
      OR quote.quote_number ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR quote.customer_name ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(quote.customer_email, '') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(quote.reference, '') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR quote.effective_status ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(quote.approval_status, '') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
    )
  `;
  const statusSql = `
    AND (
      $3::text = 'all'
      OR ($3::text = 'draft' AND quote.effective_status = 'draft')
      OR ($3::text = 'needs_approval' AND quote.approval_status = 'pending')
      OR ($3::text = 'awaiting_response' AND quote.effective_status IN ('sent', 'viewed'))
      OR ($3::text = 'accepted' AND quote.effective_status = 'accepted')
      OR ($3::text = 'converted' AND quote.effective_status = 'converted')
      OR ($3::text = 'expired' AND quote.effective_status = 'expired')
      OR ($3::text = 'expiring_soon'
        AND quote.effective_status IN ('sent', 'viewed')
        AND quote.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE
        AND quote.valid_until <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days')
      OR ($3::text = 'closed_without_sale'
        AND quote.effective_status IN ('rejected', 'expired', 'cancelled'))
    )
  `;

  const [page, count] = await Promise.all([
    context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH quote_rows AS (
          SELECT quote.*,
            CASE
              WHEN quote.status IN ('sent', 'viewed')
                AND quote.valid_until IS NOT NULL
                AND quote.valid_until < CURRENT_DATE
              THEN 'expired'
              ELSE quote.status
            END AS effective_status
          FROM sales_quotes quote
          WHERE quote.company_id = $1
            AND quote.deleted_at IS NULL
        )
        SELECT
          quote.id, quote.quote_number, quote.effective_status, quote.quote_date,
          quote.valid_until, quote.currency, quote.base_currency, quote.exchange_rate,
          quote.exchange_rate_date, quote.exchange_rate_source, quote.base_total_amount,
          quote.customer_name, quote.customer_email, quote.total_amount, quote.current_revision,
          quote.template_id, quote.pricelist_id, quote.margin_amount, quote.margin_percent,
          quote.reference, quote.approval_status, quote.sales_order_id, quote.latest_invoice_id,
          quote.created_at
        FROM quote_rows quote
        WHERE TRUE
          ${searchSql}
          ${statusSql}
        ORDER BY quote.created_at DESC, quote.id DESC
        LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
      `,
      [...parameters, limit + 1, offset],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH quote_rows AS (
          SELECT quote.*,
            CASE
              WHEN quote.status IN ('sent', 'viewed')
                AND quote.valid_until IS NOT NULL
                AND quote.valid_until < CURRENT_DATE
              THEN 'expired'
              ELSE quote.status
            END AS effective_status
          FROM sales_quotes quote
          WHERE quote.company_id = $1
            AND quote.deleted_at IS NULL
        )
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE
            $3::text = 'all'
            OR ($3::text = 'draft' AND quote.effective_status = 'draft')
            OR ($3::text = 'needs_approval' AND quote.approval_status = 'pending')
            OR ($3::text = 'awaiting_response' AND quote.effective_status IN ('sent', 'viewed'))
            OR ($3::text = 'accepted' AND quote.effective_status = 'accepted')
            OR ($3::text = 'converted' AND quote.effective_status = 'converted')
            OR ($3::text = 'expired' AND quote.effective_status = 'expired')
            OR ($3::text = 'expiring_soon'
              AND quote.effective_status IN ('sent', 'viewed')
              AND quote.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE
              AND quote.valid_until <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days')
            OR ($3::text = 'closed_without_sale'
              AND quote.effective_status IN ('rejected', 'expired', 'cancelled'))
          )::int AS total,
          COUNT(*)::int AS all_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status = 'draft')::int AS draft,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.approval_status = 'pending')::int AS needs_approval,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status IN ('sent', 'viewed'))::int AS awaiting_response,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status = 'accepted')::int AS accepted,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status = 'converted')::int AS converted,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status = 'expired')::int AS expired,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status IN ('sent', 'viewed')
            AND quote.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE
            AND quote.valid_until <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days')::int AS expiring_soon,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote.effective_status IN ('rejected', 'expired', 'cancelled'))::int AS closed_without_sale
        FROM quote_rows quote
        WHERE TRUE
          ${searchSql}
      `,
      parameters,
    ),
  ]);

  const hasMore = page.rows.length > limit;
  const rows = page.rows.slice(0, limit).map((row): SalesQuoteSummary => ({
    id: String(row.id),
    quoteNumber: String(row.quote_number),
    status: String(row.effective_status),
    quoteDate: String(row.quote_date),
    validUntil: row.valid_until ? String(row.valid_until).slice(0, 10) : null,
    currency: String(row.currency),
    baseCurrency: String(row.base_currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || row.currency),
    exchangeRate: Number(row.exchange_rate || 1),
    exchangeRateDate: String(row.exchange_rate_date || row.quote_date).slice(0, 10),
    exchangeRateSource: String(row.exchange_rate_source || 'base'),
    baseTotalAmount: money(row.base_total_amount ?? row.total_amount),
    customerName: String(row.customer_name),
    customerEmail: row.customer_email ? String(row.customer_email) : null,
    totalAmount: money(row.total_amount),
    currentRevision: Math.max(1, Number(row.current_revision || 1)),
    templateId: row.template_id ? String(row.template_id) : null,
    pricelistId: row.pricelist_id ? String(row.pricelist_id) : null,
    marginAmount: hasSalesPermission(context.permissions.isOwner, context.permissions.permissionSet, SALES_PERMISSIONS.MARGIN_VIEW)
      ? money(row.margin_amount) : null,
    marginPercent: hasSalesPermission(context.permissions.isOwner, context.permissions.permissionSet, SALES_PERMISSIONS.MARGIN_VIEW)
      ? money(row.margin_percent) : null,
    reference: row.reference ? String(row.reference) : null,
    approvalStatus: String(row.approval_status || 'not_required'),
    salesOrderId: row.sales_order_id ? String(row.sales_order_id) : null,
    latestInvoiceId: row.latest_invoice_id ? String(row.latest_invoice_id) : null,
    createdAt: row.created_at ? new Date(row.created_at).toISOString() : null,
  }));

  return {
    rows,
    offset,
    limit,
    totalCount: Number(count.rows[0]?.all_count || 0),
    filteredTotalCount: Number(count.rows[0]?.total || 0),
    hasMore,
    nextOffset: offset + rows.length,
    queueCounts: {
      all: Number(count.rows[0]?.all_count || 0),
      draft: Number(count.rows[0]?.draft || 0),
      needs_approval: Number(count.rows[0]?.needs_approval || 0),
      awaiting_response: Number(count.rows[0]?.awaiting_response || 0),
      accepted: Number(count.rows[0]?.accepted || 0),
      converted: Number(count.rows[0]?.converted || 0),
      expired: Number(count.rows[0]?.expired || 0),
      expiring_soon: Number(count.rows[0]?.expiring_soon || 0),
      closed_without_sale: Number(count.rows[0]?.closed_without_sale || 0),
    },
  };
}

export async function getSalesOrderRegisterPage(input: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext();
  const canViewOrders =
    hasSalesPermission(context.permissions.isOwner, context.permissions.permissionSet, SALES_PERMISSIONS.ORDER_VIEW) ||
    hasSalesPermission(context.permissions.isOwner, context.permissions.permissionSet, SALES_PERMISSIONS.ORDER_MANAGE);
  if (!canViewOrders) {
    throw new SalesError('SALES_PERMISSION_REQUIRED', 'You do not have permission to view Sales orders.');
  }

  const offset = normalizeSalesRegisterOffset(input.offset);
  const limit = normalizeSalesRegisterLimit(input.limit);
  const search = typeof input.search === 'string' ? input.search.trim().slice(0, 120) : '';
  const statusView = normalizeOrderRegisterStatus(input.statusView);
  const sortBy = normalizeOrderRegisterSort(input.sortBy);
  const sortSql: Record<SalesOrderSortBy, string> = {
    newest: 'o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC',
    oldest: 'o.order_date ASC, o.id ASC',
    value_high: 'COALESCE(o.base_total_amount, o.total_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC',
    value_low: 'COALESCE(o.base_total_amount, o.total_amount) ASC NULLS LAST, o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC',
    delivery_first: '(CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(oi.delivered_quantity), 0) / SUM(oi.quantity)) ELSE 0 END) ASC, o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC',
    invoice_first: '(CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(oi.invoiced_quantity), 0) / SUM(oi.quantity)) ELSE 0 END) ASC, o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC',
    customer_az: 'LOWER(o.customer_name) ASC, o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC',
  };

  const parameters = [context.companyId, search, statusView];
  const searchSql = `
    AND (
      $2::text = ''
      OR o.order_number ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR o.customer_name ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(o.reference, '') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(o.status, '') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
      OR COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') ILIKE ('%' || $2::text || '%')
    )
  `;
  const statusSql = `
    AND (
      $3::text = 'all'
      OR ($3::text = 'awaiting_fulfillment' AND COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'not_started')
      OR ($3::text = 'partially_fulfilled' AND COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'partial')
      OR ($3::text = 'fulfilled' AND COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'fulfilled')
      OR ($3::text = 'not_invoiced' AND COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'not_invoiced')
      OR ($3::text = 'partially_invoiced' AND COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'partial')
      OR ($3::text = 'invoiced' AND COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'invoiced')
    )
  `;

  const [page, count] = await Promise.all([
    context.pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          o.id, o.order_number, o.quote_id, q.quote_number, o.latest_invoice_id,
          o.reference, o.status, o.fulfillment_status, o.invoice_status, o.order_date, o.currency,
          o.base_currency, o.exchange_rate, o.exchange_rate_date, o.exchange_rate_source,
          o.base_total_amount, o.customer_name, o.total_amount,
          COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS ordered_quantity,
          COALESCE(SUM(oi.delivered_quantity), 0) AS delivered_quantity,
          COALESCE(SUM(oi.invoiced_quantity), 0) AS invoiced_quantity
        FROM sales_orders_v2 o
        LEFT JOIN sales_order_items_v2 oi
          ON oi.sales_order_id = o.id AND oi.company_id = o.company_id
        LEFT JOIN sales_quotes q
          ON q.id = o.quote_id AND q.company_id = o.company_id
        WHERE o.company_id = $1
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          ${searchSql}
          ${statusSql}
        GROUP BY o.id, q.quote_number
        ORDER BY ${sortSql[sortBy]}
        LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
      `,
      [...parameters, limit + 1, offset],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE
            $3::text = 'all'
            OR ($3::text = 'awaiting_fulfillment' AND COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'not_started')
            OR ($3::text = 'partially_fulfilled' AND COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'partial')
            OR ($3::text = 'fulfilled' AND COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'fulfilled')
            OR ($3::text = 'not_invoiced' AND COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'not_invoiced')
            OR ($3::text = 'partially_invoiced' AND COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'partial')
            OR ($3::text = 'invoiced' AND COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'invoiced')
          )::int AS total,
          COUNT(*)::int AS all_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'not_started')::int AS awaiting_fulfillment,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'partial')::int AS partially_fulfilled,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.fulfillment_status, 'not_started') = 'fulfilled')::int AS fulfilled,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'not_invoiced')::int AS not_invoiced,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'partial')::int AS partially_invoiced,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.invoice_status, 'not_invoiced') = 'invoiced')::int AS invoiced
        FROM sales_orders_v2 o
        WHERE o.company_id = $1
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          ${searchSql}
      `,
      parameters,
    ),
  ]);

  const hasMore = page.rows.length > limit;
  const rows = page.rows.slice(0, limit).map((row): SalesOrderSummary => ({
    id: String(row.id),
    orderNumber: String(row.order_number),
    quoteId: row.quote_id ? String(row.quote_id) : null,
    quoteNumber: row.quote_number ? String(row.quote_number) : null,
    latestInvoiceId: row.latest_invoice_id ? String(row.latest_invoice_id) : null,
    reference: row.reference ? String(row.reference) : null,
    status: String(row.status),
    fulfillmentStatus: String(row.fulfillment_status || 'not_started'),
    invoiceStatus: String(row.invoice_status || 'not_invoiced'),
    orderDate: String(row.order_date),
    currency: String(row.currency),
    baseCurrency: String(row.base_currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || row.currency),
    exchangeRate: Number(row.exchange_rate || 1),
    exchangeRateDate: String(row.exchange_rate_date || row.order_date).slice(0, 10),
    exchangeRateSource: String(row.exchange_rate_source || 'base'),
    baseTotalAmount: money(row.base_total_amount ?? row.total_amount),
    customerName: String(row.customer_name),
    totalAmount: money(row.total_amount),
    deliveredPercent: Number(row.ordered_quantity || 0) > 0
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round(Number(row.delivered_quantity || 0) / Number(row.ordered_quantity) * 100))
      : 0,
    invoicedPercent: Number(row.ordered_quantity || 0) > 0
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round(Number(row.invoiced_quantity || 0) / Number(row.ordered_quantity) * 100))
      : 0,
  }));

  return {
    rows, offset, limit, totalCount: Number(count.rows[0]?.total || 0), hasMore, nextOffset: offset + rows.length,
    queueCounts: {
      all: Number(count.rows[0]?.all_count || 0),
      awaiting_fulfillment: Number(count.rows[0]?.awaiting_fulfillment || 0),
      partially_fulfilled: Number(count.rows[0]?.partially_fulfilled || 0),
      fulfilled: Number(count.rows[0]?.fulfilled || 0),
      not_invoiced: Number(count.rows[0]?.not_invoiced || 0),
      partially_invoiced: Number(count.rows[0]?.partially_invoiced || 0),
      invoiced: Number(count.rows[0]?.invoiced || 0),
    },
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: lib\apps\sales\quotation-effectiveness.ts

import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';
import { queryControl } from '@/lib/db/control';

export type SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow = {
  dimensionKey: string;
  dimensionLabel: string;
  salespersonUserId: string | null;
  currency: string;
  quoteCount: number;
  sentCount: number;
  acceptedCount: number;
  convertedCount: number;
  rejectedCount: number;
  expiredCount: number;
  quotedValue: number;
  acceptedValue: number;
  convertedValue: number;
  lostValue: number;
  sentToAcceptedDays: number | null;
  acceptedToOrderDays: number | null;
  sentToAcceptedRate: number;
  acceptedToOrderRate: number;
};

export type SalesQuotationEffectivenessReport = {
  canViewReports: boolean;
  companyCurrency: string;
  bySalesperson: SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow[];
  byTemplate: SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow[];
};

const EMPTY_REPORT: SalesQuotationEffectivenessReport = {
  canViewReports: false,
  companyCurrency: 'KES',
  bySalesperson: [],
  byTemplate: [],
};

function numeric(value: unknown): number {
  const number = Number(value || 0);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0;
}

export async function getSalesQuotationEffectivenessReport(): Promise<SalesQuotationEffectivenessReport> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const companyCurrency = String(context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase();
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );
  if (!canViewReports) return { ...EMPTY_REPORT, companyCurrency };

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      WITH quote_cohort AS (
        SELECT
          q.id,
          q.salesperson_user_id::text AS salesperson_user_id,
          q.template_id::text AS template_id,
          COALESCE(
            NULLIF(BTRIM(template.name), ''),
            CASE WHEN q.template_id IS NULL THEN 'No template' ELSE 'Deleted template' END
          ) AS template_name,
          UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(q.currency), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''), 'KES')) AS currency,
          q.status,
          q.total_amount,
          q.sent_at,
          q.accepted_at,
          q.converted_at,
          q.rejected_at,
          q.expired_at,
          q.sales_order_id
        FROM sales_quotes q
        LEFT JOIN sales_quote_templates template
          ON template.id = q.template_id
          AND template.company_id = q.company_id
          AND template.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE q.company_id = $1
          AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND q.quote_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
          AND q.quote_date <= CURRENT_DATE
      ),
      salesperson_rollup AS (
        SELECT
          'salesperson'::text AS dimension_type,
          COALESCE(salesperson_user_id, 'unassigned') AS dimension_key,
          NULL::text AS dimension_label,
          salesperson_user_id AS salesperson_user_id,
          currency,
          COUNT(*)::int AS quote_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS sent_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('accepted', 'converted') OR sales_order_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS accepted_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sales_order_id IS NOT NULL OR status = 'converted')::int AS converted_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rejected_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'rejected')::int AS rejected_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expired_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'expired')::int AS expired_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS quoted_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (
            WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('accepted', 'converted') OR sales_order_id IS NOT NULL
          ), 0) AS accepted_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (
            WHERE sales_order_id IS NOT NULL OR status = 'converted'
          ), 0) AS converted_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (
            WHERE rejected_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'rejected' OR expired_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'expired'
          ), 0) AS lost_value,
          ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (accepted_at - sent_at)) / 86400.0)
            FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at >= sent_at)::numeric, 1) AS sent_to_accepted_days,
          ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (converted_at - accepted_at)) / 86400.0)
            FILTER (WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND converted_at IS NOT NULL AND converted_at >= accepted_at)::numeric, 1) AS accepted_to_order_days
        FROM quote_cohort
        GROUP BY salesperson_user_id, currency
      ),
      template_rollup AS (
        SELECT
          'template'::text AS dimension_type,
          COALESCE(template_id, 'none') AS dimension_key,
          template_name AS dimension_label,
          NULL::text AS salesperson_user_id,
          currency,
          COUNT(*)::int AS quote_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS sent_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('accepted', 'converted') OR sales_order_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS accepted_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sales_order_id IS NOT NULL OR status = 'converted')::int AS converted_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rejected_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'rejected')::int AS rejected_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expired_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'expired')::int AS expired_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS quoted_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (
            WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('accepted', 'converted') OR sales_order_id IS NOT NULL
          ), 0) AS accepted_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (
            WHERE sales_order_id IS NOT NULL OR status = 'converted'
          ), 0) AS converted_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (
            WHERE rejected_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'rejected' OR expired_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'expired'
          ), 0) AS lost_value,
          ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (accepted_at - sent_at)) / 86400.0)
            FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at >= sent_at)::numeric, 1) AS sent_to_accepted_days,
          ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (converted_at - accepted_at)) / 86400.0)
            FILTER (WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND converted_at IS NOT NULL AND converted_at >= accepted_at)::numeric, 1) AS accepted_to_order_days
        FROM quote_cohort
        GROUP BY template_id, template_name, currency
      ),
      dimensions AS (
        SELECT * FROM salesperson_rollup
        UNION ALL
        SELECT * FROM template_rollup
      ),
      ranked_dimensions AS (
        SELECT dimensions.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY dimension_type, currency
            ORDER BY converted_value DESC, accepted_value DESC, quote_count DESC, dimension_label ASC NULLS LAST, dimension_key ASC, currency ASC
          ) AS dimension_rank
        FROM dimensions
      )
      SELECT *
      FROM ranked_dimensions
      WHERE dimension_rank <= 100
      ORDER BY dimension_type ASC, currency ASC, converted_value DESC, quote_count DESC, dimension_label ASC NULLS LAST
    `,
    [context.companyId, companyCurrency],
  );

  const salespersonIds = Array.from(new Set(
    result.rows
      .filter(row => row.dimension_type === 'salesperson' && row.salesperson_user_id != null)
      .map(row => String(row.salesperson_user_id)),
  ));
  let activeUsers: Array<{ user_id: string; name: string }> = [];
  if (salespersonIds.length > 0) {
    const users = await queryControl(
      `
        SELECT tu.user_id::text AS user_id,
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(u.full_name, '')), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), u.email) AS name
        FROM tenant_users tu
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tu.user_id
        WHERE tu.tenant_id = $1
          AND tu.user_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
          AND tu.status = 'active'
          AND tu.member_type = 'internal'
          AND tu.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      `,
      [context.tenantId, salespersonIds],
    );
    activeUsers = users.rows.map(row => ({ user_id: String(row.user_id), name: String(row.name || 'Salesperson') }));
  }
  const names = new Map(activeUsers.map(user => [user.user_id, user.name]));

  const rows = result.rows.map(row => {
    const dimensionType = String(row.dimension_type);
    const key = String(row.dimension_key);
    const rawUserId = row.salesperson_user_id == null ? null : String(row.salesperson_user_id);
    const dimensionLabel = dimensionType === 'salesperson'
      ? (rawUserId === null ? 'Unassigned salesperson' : names.get(rawUserId) || 'Inactive or unavailable user')
      : String(row.dimension_label || 'No template');
    const sentCount = Number(row.sent_count || 0);
    const acceptedCount = Number(row.accepted_count || 0);
    const convertedCount = Number(row.converted_count || 0);

    return {
      dimensionType,
      dimensionKey: key,
      dimensionLabel,
      salespersonUserId: rawUserId,
      currency: String(row.currency || companyCurrency).toUpperCase(),
      quoteCount: Number(row.quote_count || 0),
      sentCount,
      acceptedCount,
      convertedCount,
      rejectedCount: Number(row.rejected_count || 0),
      expiredCount: Number(row.expired_count || 0),
      quotedValue: numeric(row.quoted_value),
      acceptedValue: numeric(row.accepted_value),
      convertedValue: numeric(row.converted_value),
      lostValue: numeric(row.lost_value),
      sentToAcceptedDays: row.sent_to_accepted_days == null ? null : numeric(row.sent_to_accepted_days),
      acceptedToOrderDays: row.accepted_to_order_days == null ? null : numeric(row.accepted_to_order_days),
      sentToAcceptedRate: sentCount > 0 ? Math.round(acceptedCount / sentCount * 1000) / 10 : 0,
      acceptedToOrderRate: acceptedCount > 0 ? Math.round(convertedCount / acceptedCount * 1000) / 10 : 0,
    };
  });

  return {
    canViewReports: true,
    companyCurrency,
    bySalesperson: rows.filter(row => row.dimensionType === 'salesperson'),
    byTemplate: rows.filter(row => row.dimensionType === 'template'),
  };
}

import 'server-only';

import { hasSalesPermission, requireSalesContext, SALES_PERMISSIONS } from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';
import { queryControl } from '@/lib/db/control';

export type SalesRepresentativePerformanceRow = {
  representativeId: string | null;
  representativeName: string;
  currency: string;
  openOpportunityCount: number;
  openPipelineValue: number;
  weightedPipelineValue: number;
  overdueOpportunityCount: number;
  wonCount90Days: number;
  wonValue90Days: number;
  lostCount90Days: number;
  lostValue90Days: number;
  closedCount90Days: number;
  winRate90Days: number | null;
  averageDaysToWin90Days: number | null;
};

export async function getSalesRepresentativePerformance(): Promise<{ rows: SalesRepresentativePerformanceRow[] }> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(context.permissions.isOwner, context.permissions.permissionSet, SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW);
  if (!canViewReports) return { rows: [] };

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      SELECT
        o.salesperson_user_id::text AS representative_id,
        UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''), 'KES')) AS currency,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'open')::int AS open_opportunity_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'), 0) AS open_pipeline_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_value * LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(o.probability, s.probability, 0))) / 100.0)
          FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'), 0) AS weighted_pipeline_value,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'open' AND o.expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE)::int AS overdue_opportunity_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')::int AS won_count_90_days,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'), 0) AS won_value_90_days,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')::int AS lost_count_90_days,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'), 0) AS lost_value_90_days,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
          WHERE (s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
             OR (s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
        )::int AS closed_count_90_days,
        ROUND(
          100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
          / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (
              WHERE (s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
                 OR (s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
            ), 0),
          1
        ) AS win_rate_90_days,
        AVG(GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.won_at - o.created_at)) / 86400.0))
          FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') AS average_days_to_win_90_days
      FROM sales_opportunities o
      INNER JOIN sales_pipeline_stages s ON s.id = o.stage_id AND s.company_id = o.company_id
      WHERE o.company_id = $1 AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (s.stage_type = 'open'
          OR (s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
          OR (s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'))
      GROUP BY o.salesperson_user_id, currency
      ORDER BY currency, weighted_pipeline_value DESC, open_pipeline_value DESC, representative_id NULLS LAST
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
  );

  const representativeIds = Array.from(new Set(result.rows
    .map(row => row.representative_id == null ? null : String(row.representative_id))
    .filter((id): id is string => id !== null)));
  let userRows: Array<{ user_id: string; name: string }> = [];
  if (representativeIds.length) {
    const users = await queryControl(
      `
        SELECT tu.user_id::text AS user_id,
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(u.full_name, '')), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), u.email) AS name
        FROM tenant_users tu INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tu.user_id
        WHERE tu.tenant_id = $1 AND tu.user_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
          AND tu.status = 'active' AND tu.member_type = 'internal'
          AND tu.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      `,
      [context.tenantId, representativeIds],
    );
    userRows = users.rows.map(row => ({ user_id: String(row.user_id), name: String(row.name || 'Sales representative') }));
  }
  const names = new Map(userRows.map(row => [row.user_id, row.name]));
  return {
    rows: result.rows.map(row => {
      const id = row.representative_id == null ? null : String(row.representative_id);
      return {
        representativeId: id,
        representativeName: id === null ? 'Unassigned' : names.get(id) || 'Inactive or unavailable user',
        currency: String(row.currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
        openOpportunityCount: Number(row.open_opportunity_count || 0),
        openPipelineValue: Number(row.open_pipeline_value || 0),
        weightedPipelineValue: Number(row.weighted_pipeline_value || 0),
        overdueOpportunityCount: Number(row.overdue_opportunity_count || 0),
        wonCount90Days: Number(row.won_count_90_days || 0),
        wonValue90Days: Number(row.won_value_90_days || 0),
        lostCount90Days: Number(row.lost_count_90_days || 0),
        lostValue90Days: Number(row.lost_value_90_days || 0),
        closedCount90Days: Number(row.closed_count_90_days || 0),
        winRate90Days: row.win_rate_90_days == null ? null : Number(row.win_rate_90_days),
        averageDaysToWin90Days: row.average_days_to_win_90_days == null ? null : Number(row.average_days_to_win_90_days),
      };
    }),
  };
}

FILE: lib\apps\sales\return-credit-rules.ts

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

/**
 * Build a bounded Invoicing idempotency key from the complete caller key.
 * Invoicing prefixes this with "credit-refund:", so 106 characters keeps
 * the persisted key at or below 120 characters.
 */
export function salesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(
  returnCreditId: string,
  callerKey: string,
): string {
  const digest = createHash('sha256')
    .update(callerKey)
    .digest('hex');
  return 'srcr:' + returnCreditId + ':' + digest;
}

/**
 * Previous releases built a readable key and truncated it at 120 characters.
 * Look it up during recovery, but never use it for newly-created refunds.
 */
export function legacySalesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(
  returnCreditId: string,
  callerKey: string,
): string {
  return (
    'sales-return-credit:' +
    returnCreditId +
    ':refund:' +
    callerKey
  ).slice(0, 120);
}
