import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';

export type SalesReturnStatusSummary = {
  status: string;
  currency: string;
  returnCount: number;
  orderCount: number;
  itemQuantity: number;
  creditAmount: number;
  availableCredit: number;
  refundedAmount: number;
};

export type SalesReturnReasonSummary = {
  reason: string;
  currency: string;
  returnCount: number;
  itemQuantity: number;
  creditAmount: number;
};

export type SalesShipmentStatusSummary = {
  status: string;
  shipmentCount: number;
  orderCount: number;
  itemQuantity: number;
  averageHoursToShip: number | null;
  averageHoursToDeliver: number | null;
};

export type SalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport = {
  canViewReturns: boolean;
  canViewShipping: boolean;
  returnsByStatus: SalesReturnStatusSummary[];
  returnReasons: SalesReturnReasonSummary[];
  shipmentsByStatus: SalesShipmentStatusSummary[];
};

const EMPTY_REPORT: SalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport = {
  canViewReturns: false,
  canViewShipping: false,
  returnsByStatus: [],
  returnReasons: [],
  shipmentsByStatus: [],
};

export async function getSalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport(): Promise<SalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );
  if (!canViewReports) return EMPTY_REPORT;

  const canViewReturns = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.RETURN_VIEW,
  ) || hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.RETURN_MANAGE,
  );
  const canViewShipping = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.SHIPPING_VIEW,
  ) || hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.SHIPPING_MANAGE,
  );

  const [returnStatusResult, returnReasonResult, shipmentResult] = await Promise.all([
    canViewReturns ? context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH item_totals AS (
          SELECT company_id, return_id, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS item_quantity
          FROM sales_return_items
          WHERE company_id = $1
          GROUP BY company_id, return_id
        ),
        credit_totals AS (
          SELECT
            company_id,
            return_id,
            COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS credit_amount,
            COALESCE(SUM(available_credit), 0) AS available_credit,
            COALESCE(SUM(refunded_amount), 0) AS refunded_amount
          FROM sales_return_credits
          WHERE company_id = $1
          GROUP BY company_id, return_id
        ),
        return_rows AS (
          SELECT
            r.id,
            r.sales_order_id,
            r.status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(r.reason), ''), 'Unspecified') AS reason,
            UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''), 'KES')) AS currency,
            COALESCE(i.item_quantity, 0) AS item_quantity,
            COALESCE(c.credit_amount, 0) AS credit_amount,
            COALESCE(c.available_credit, 0) AS available_credit,
            COALESCE(c.refunded_amount, 0) AS refunded_amount
          FROM sales_returns r
          INNER JOIN sales_orders_v2 o
            ON o.id = r.sales_order_id
            AND o.company_id = r.company_id
            AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          LEFT JOIN item_totals i
            ON i.return_id = r.id
            AND i.company_id = r.company_id
          LEFT JOIN credit_totals c
            ON c.return_id = r.id
            AND c.company_id = r.company_id
          WHERE r.company_id = $1
            AND r.requested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
            AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
        ),
        status_totals AS (
          SELECT
            status,
            currency,
            COUNT(*)::int AS return_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT sales_order_id)::int AS order_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(item_quantity), 0) AS item_quantity,
            COALESCE(SUM(credit_amount), 0) AS credit_amount,
            COALESCE(SUM(available_credit), 0) AS available_credit,
            COALESCE(SUM(refunded_amount), 0) AS refunded_amount
          FROM return_rows
          GROUP BY status, currency
        ),
        ranked_statuses AS (
          SELECT status_totals.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY currency
              ORDER BY return_count DESC, status ASC
            ) AS currency_rank
          FROM status_totals
        )
        SELECT status, currency, return_count, order_count, item_quantity,
          credit_amount, available_credit, refunded_amount
        FROM ranked_statuses
        WHERE currency_rank <= 250
        ORDER BY currency ASC, return_count DESC, status ASC
      `,
      [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
    ) : Promise.resolve({ rows: [] }),
    canViewReturns ? context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH item_totals AS (
          SELECT company_id, return_id, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS item_quantity
          FROM sales_return_items
          WHERE company_id = $1
          GROUP BY company_id, return_id
        ),
        credit_totals AS (
          SELECT company_id, return_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS credit_amount
          FROM sales_return_credits
          WHERE company_id = $1
          GROUP BY company_id, return_id
        ),
        reason_totals AS (
          SELECT
            COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(r.reason), ''), 'Unspecified') AS reason,
            UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''), 'KES')) AS currency,
            COUNT(*)::int AS return_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(i.item_quantity), 0) AS item_quantity,
            COALESCE(SUM(c.credit_amount), 0) AS credit_amount
          FROM sales_returns r
          INNER JOIN sales_orders_v2 o
            ON o.id = r.sales_order_id
            AND o.company_id = r.company_id
            AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          LEFT JOIN item_totals i
            ON i.return_id = r.id
            AND i.company_id = r.company_id
          LEFT JOIN credit_totals c
            ON c.return_id = r.id
            AND c.company_id = r.company_id
          WHERE r.company_id = $1
            AND r.requested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
            AND r.status <> 'cancelled'
            AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
          GROUP BY reason, currency
        ),
        ranked_reasons AS (
          SELECT reason_totals.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY currency
              ORDER BY return_count DESC, credit_amount DESC, reason ASC
            ) AS currency_rank
          FROM reason_totals
        )
        SELECT reason, currency, return_count, item_quantity, credit_amount
        FROM ranked_reasons
        WHERE currency_rank <= 100
        ORDER BY currency ASC, return_count DESC, credit_amount DESC, reason ASC
      `,
      [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
    ) : Promise.resolve({ rows: [] }),
    canViewShipping ? context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH item_totals AS (
          SELECT company_id, shipment_id, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS item_quantity
          FROM sales_shipment_items
          WHERE company_id = $1
          GROUP BY company_id, shipment_id
        )
        SELECT
          s.status,
          COUNT(*)::int AS shipment_count,
          COUNT(DISTINCT s.sales_order_id)::int AS order_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.item_quantity), 0) AS item_quantity,
          ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.shipped_at - s.created_at)) / 3600.0)
            FILTER (WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at >= s.created_at))::numeric, 1) AS average_hours_to_ship,
          ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 3600.0)
            FILTER (WHERE s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at >= s.shipped_at))::numeric, 1) AS average_hours_to_deliver
        FROM sales_shipments s
        INNER JOIN sales_orders_v2 o
          ON o.id = s.sales_order_id
          AND o.company_id = s.company_id
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
        LEFT JOIN item_totals i
          ON i.shipment_id = s.id
          AND i.company_id = s.company_id
        WHERE s.company_id = $1
          AND s.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
        GROUP BY s.status
        ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, s.status ASC
        LIMIT 30
      `,
      [context.companyId],
    ) : Promise.resolve({ rows: [] }),
  ]);

  return {
    canViewReturns,
    canViewShipping,
    returnsByStatus: returnStatusResult.rows.map(row => ({
      status: String(row.status || 'unknown'),
      currency: String(row.currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
      returnCount: Number(row.return_count || 0),
      orderCount: Number(row.order_count || 0),
      itemQuantity: Number(row.item_quantity || 0),
      creditAmount: Number(row.credit_amount || 0),
      availableCredit: Number(row.available_credit || 0),
      refundedAmount: Number(row.refunded_amount || 0),
    })),
    returnReasons: returnReasonResult.rows.map(row => ({
      reason: String(row.reason || 'Unspecified'),
      currency: String(row.currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
      returnCount: Number(row.return_count || 0),
      itemQuantity: Number(row.item_quantity || 0),
      creditAmount: Number(row.credit_amount || 0),
    })),
    shipmentsByStatus: shipmentResult.rows.map(row => ({
      status: String(row.status || 'unknown'),
      shipmentCount: Number(row.shipment_count || 0),
      orderCount: Number(row.order_count || 0),
      itemQuantity: Number(row.item_quantity || 0),
      averageHoursToShip: row.average_hours_to_ship == null ? null : Number(row.average_hours_to_ship),
      averageHoursToDeliver: row.average_hours_to_deliver == null ? null : Number(row.average_hours_to_deliver),
    })),
  };
}

FILE: lib\apps\sales\saved-views.ts

import 'server-only';

import {
  cleanText,
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  requireUuid,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
  SalesError,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';

import type {
  SalesOrderSortBy,
  SalesOrderStatusView,
  SalesPipelineStatusView,
  SalesPipelineViewType,
  SalesLeadScoreView,
  SalesSavedPipelineView,
  SalesQuoteStatusView,
  SalesSavedOrderView,
  SalesSavedQuoteView,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';

const ALLOWED_STATUS_VIEWS = new Set<SalesQuoteStatusView>([
  'all',
  'draft',
  'needs_approval',
  'awaiting_response',
  'accepted',
  'converted',
  'closed_without_sale',
  'expired',
  'expiring_soon',
]);

const MAX_SAVED_VIEWS = 25;

function canViewOrders(
  context: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof requireSalesContext>>,
) {
  return (
    hasSalesPermission(
      context.permissions.isOwner,
      context.permissions.permissionSet,
      SALES_PERMISSIONS.ORDER_VIEW,
    ) ||
    hasSalesPermission(
      context.permissions.isOwner,
      context.permissions.permissionSet,
      SALES_PERMISSIONS.ORDER_MANAGE,
    )
  );
}

type SavedQuoteViewRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status_view: SalesQuoteStatusView;
  search_query: string;
  created_at: Date | string;
};

function mapSavedView(row: SavedQuoteViewRow): SalesSavedQuoteView {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    name: String(row.name),
    statusView: row.status_view,
    searchQuery: String(row.search_query || ''),
    createdAt: new Date(row.created_at).toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function getSalesSavedQuoteViews(): Promise<SalesSavedQuoteView[]> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);

  const result = await context.pool.query<SavedQuoteViewRow>(
    `
      SELECT id, name, status_view, search_query, created_at
      FROM sales_quote_saved_views
      WHERE company_id = $1
        AND user_id = $2
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY LOWER(name), created_at DESC
      LIMIT $3
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.userId, MAX_SAVED_VIEWS],
  );

  return result.rows.map(mapSavedView);
}

export async function saveSalesSavedQuoteView(
  input: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<SalesSavedQuoteView> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const name = cleanText(input.name, 80);
  const rawStatusView = cleanText(input.statusView, 40) || 'all';
  const searchQuery = cleanText(input.searchQuery, 120);

  if (!name) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Enter a name for this saved quotation view.');
  }

  if (!ALLOWED_STATUS_VIEWS.has(rawStatusView as SalesQuoteStatusView)) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a valid quotation work queue.');
  }

  const countResult = await context.pool.query<{ count: number | string }>(
    `
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count
      FROM sales_quote_saved_views
      WHERE company_id = $1
        AND user_id = $2
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.userId],
  );

  if (Number(countResult.rows[0]?.count || 0) >= MAX_SAVED_VIEWS) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'INVALID_INPUT',
      'You can save up to 25 quotation views. Delete an unused view before saving another.',
    );
  }

  try {
    const result = await context.pool.query<SavedQuoteViewRow>(
      `
        INSERT INTO sales_quote_saved_views (
          company_id,
          user_id,
          name,
          status_view,
          search_query,
          created_by,
          updated_by
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $6)
        RETURNING id, name, status_view, search_query, created_at
      `,
      [
        context.companyId,
        context.userId,
        name,
        rawStatusView,
        searchQuery,
        context.userId,
      ],
    );

    return mapSavedView(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error &&
      typeof error === 'object' &&
      'code' in error &&
      error.code === '23505'
    ) {
      throw new SalesError(
        'INVALID_INPUT',
        'A saved quotation view with that name already exists.',
      );
    }

    throw error;
  }
}

export async function deleteSalesSavedQuoteView(
  input: Record<string, unknown>,
) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const viewId = requireUuid(input.viewId, 'Saved quotation view');

  const result = await context.pool.query<{ id: string }>(
    `
      UPDATE sales_quote_saved_views
      SET
        deleted_at = NOW(),
        updated_by = $4,
        updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = $1
        AND company_id = $2
        AND user_id = $3
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      RETURNING id
    `,
    [viewId, context.companyId, context.userId, context.userId],
  );

  if (result.rows.length !== 1) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'The saved quotation view was not found.');
  }

  return { id: String(result.rows[0].id) };
}


const ALLOWED_ORDER_STATUS_VIEWS = new Set<SalesOrderStatusView>([
  'all',
  'awaiting_fulfillment',
  'partially_fulfilled',
  'fulfilled',
  'not_invoiced',
  'partially_invoiced',
  'invoiced',
]);


const ALLOWED_ORDER_SORTS = new Set<SalesOrderSortBy>([
  'newest',
  'oldest',
  'value_high',
  'value_low',
  'delivery_first',
  'invoice_first',
  'customer_az',
]);


type SavedOrderViewRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status_view: SalesOrderStatusView;
  search_query: string;
  sort_by: SalesOrderSortBy;
  created_at: Date | string;
};


function mapSavedOrderView(row: SavedOrderViewRow): SalesSavedOrderView {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    name: String(row.name),
    statusView: row.status_view,
    searchQuery: String(row.search_query || ''),
    sortBy: row.sort_by || 'newest',
    createdAt: new Date(row.created_at).toISOString(),
  };
}


export async function getSalesSavedOrderViews(): Promise<SalesSavedOrderView[]> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext();
  if (!canViewOrders(context)) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'SALES_PERMISSION_REQUIRED',
      'You do not have permission to view Sales orders.',
    );
  }

  const result = await context.pool.query<SavedOrderViewRow>(
    `
      SELECT id, name, status_view, search_query, sort_by, created_at
      FROM sales_order_saved_views
      WHERE company_id = $1
        AND user_id = $2
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY LOWER(name), created_at DESC
      LIMIT $3
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.userId, MAX_SAVED_VIEWS],
  );

  return result.rows.map(mapSavedOrderView);
}


export async function saveSalesSavedOrderView(
  input: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<SalesSavedOrderView> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext();
  if (!canViewOrders(context)) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'SALES_PERMISSION_REQUIRED',
      'You do not have permission to view Sales orders.',
    );
  }
  const name = cleanText(input.name, 80);
  const rawStatusView = cleanText(input.statusView, 40) || 'all';
  const rawSortBy = cleanText(input.sortBy, 40) || 'newest';
  const searchQuery = cleanText(input.searchQuery, 120);

  if (!name) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Enter a name for this saved sales order view.');
  }

  if (!ALLOWED_ORDER_STATUS_VIEWS.has(rawStatusView as SalesOrderStatusView)) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a valid sales order work queue.');
  }

  if (!ALLOWED_ORDER_SORTS.has(rawSortBy as SalesOrderSortBy)) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a valid sales order sort order.');
  }

  const countResult = await context.pool.query<{ count: number | string }>(
    `
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count
      FROM sales_order_saved_views
      WHERE company_id = $1
        AND user_id = $2
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.userId],
  );

  if (Number(countResult.rows[0]?.count || 0) >= MAX_SAVED_VIEWS) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'INVALID_INPUT',
      'You can save up to 25 sales order views. Delete an unused view before saving another.',
    );
  }

  try {
    const result = await context.pool.query<SavedOrderViewRow>(
      `
        INSERT INTO sales_order_saved_views (
          company_id,
          user_id,
          name,
          status_view,
          search_query,
          sort_by,
          created_by,
          updated_by
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $7)
        RETURNING id, name, status_view, search_query, sort_by, created_at
      `,
      [
        context.companyId,
        context.userId,
        name,
        rawStatusView,
        searchQuery,
        rawSortBy,
        context.userId,
      ],
    );

    return mapSavedOrderView(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error &&
      typeof error === 'object' &&
      'code' in error &&
      error.code === '23505'
    ) {
      throw new SalesError(
        'INVALID_INPUT',
        'A saved sales order view with that name already exists.',
      );
    }

    throw error;
  }
}


export async function deleteSalesSavedOrderView(
  input: Record<string, unknown>,
) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext();
  if (!canViewOrders(context)) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'SALES_PERMISSION_REQUIRED',

  }

      UPDATE sales_order_saved_views
      SET
        deleted_at = NOW(),
        updated_by = $4,
        updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = $1
        AND company_id = $2

        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      RETURNING id
    `,
    [viewId, context.companyId, context.userId, context.userId],

  if (result.rows.length !== 1) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'The saved sales order view was not found.');
  }

}



const ALLOWED_PIPELINE_VIEW_TYPES = new Set<SalesPipelineViewType>([
  'leads',
  'opportunities',
]);

const ALLOWED_LEAD_PIPELINE_STATUSES = new Set<SalesPipelineStatusView>([
  'all',
  'new',
  'contacted',
  'qualified',
  'disqualified',
  'converted',
]);

const ALLOWED_OPPORTUNITY_PIPELINE_STATUSES = new Set<SalesPipelineStatusView>([
  'all',
  'open',
  'won',
  'lost',
]);

const ALLOWED_LEAD_SCORE_VIEWS = new Set<SalesLeadScoreView>([
  'all',
  'high',
  'medium',
  'low',
]);

type SavedPipelineViewRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  view_type: SalesPipelineViewType;
  status_view: SalesPipelineStatusView;
  score_view: SalesLeadScoreView;
  search_query: string;
  created_at: Date | string;
};

function mapSavedPipelineView(row: SavedPipelineViewRow): SalesSavedPipelineView {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    name: String(row.name),
    viewType: row.view_type,
    statusView: row.status_view,
    scoreView: row.score_view || 'all',
    searchQuery: String(row.search_query || ''),
    createdAt: new Date(row.created_at).toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function getSalesSavedPipelineViews(): Promise<SalesSavedPipelineView[]> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.PIPELINE_VIEW);
  const result = await context.pool.query<SavedPipelineViewRow>(
    `
      SELECT id, name, view_type, status_view, score_view, search_query, created_at
      FROM sales_pipeline_saved_views
      WHERE company_id = $1
        AND user_id = $2
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY view_type, LOWER(name), created_at DESC
      LIMIT $3
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.userId, MAX_SAVED_VIEWS],
  );
  return result.rows.map(mapSavedPipelineView);
}

export async function saveSalesSavedPipelineView(
  input: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<SalesSavedPipelineView> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.PIPELINE_VIEW);
  const name = cleanText(input.name, 80);
  const rawViewType = cleanText(input.viewType, 30);
  const rawStatusView = cleanText(input.statusView, 30) || 'all';
  const rawScoreView = cleanText(input.scoreView, 20) || 'all';
  const searchQuery = cleanText(input.searchQuery, 120);

  if (!name) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Enter a name for this saved pipeline view.');
  }
  if (!ALLOWED_PIPELINE_VIEW_TYPES.has(rawViewType as SalesPipelineViewType)) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose either the lead list or opportunity pipeline.');
  }
  const viewType = rawViewType as SalesPipelineViewType;
  const allowedStatuses = viewType === 'leads'
    ? ALLOWED_LEAD_PIPELINE_STATUSES
    : ALLOWED_OPPORTUNITY_PIPELINE_STATUSES;
  if (!allowedStatuses.has(rawStatusView as SalesPipelineStatusView)) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a valid status filter for this pipeline view.');
  }
  if (!ALLOWED_LEAD_SCORE_VIEWS.has(rawScoreView as SalesLeadScoreView)) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Choose a valid lead score filter.');
  }
  if (viewType === 'opportunities' && rawScoreView !== 'all') {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Lead score filters can only be saved for lead views.');
  }

  const countResult = await context.pool.query<{ count: number | string }>(
    `
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count
      FROM sales_pipeline_saved_views
      WHERE company_id = $1
        AND user_id = $2
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.userId],
  );
  if (Number(countResult.rows[0]?.count || 0) >= MAX_SAVED_VIEWS) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'INVALID_INPUT',
      'You can save up to 25 pipeline views. Delete an unused view before saving another.',
    );
  }

  try {
    const result = await context.pool.query<SavedPipelineViewRow>(
      `
        INSERT INTO sales_pipeline_saved_views (
          company_id, user_id, view_type, name, status_view, score_view,
          search_query, created_by, updated_by
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $8)
        RETURNING id, name, view_type, status_view, score_view, search_query, created_at
      `,
      [
        context.companyId,
        context.userId,
        viewType,
        name,
        rawStatusView,
        rawScoreView,
        searchQuery,
        context.userId,
      ],
    );
    return mapSavedPipelineView(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error && error.code === '23505') {
      throw new SalesError(
        'INVALID_INPUT',
        'A pipeline view with that name already exists in this list.',
      );
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function deleteSalesSavedPipelineView(
  input: Record<string, unknown>,
) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.PIPELINE_VIEW);
  const viewId = requireUuid(input.viewId, 'Saved pipeline view');
  const result = await context.pool.query<{ id: string }>(
    `
      UPDATE sales_pipeline_saved_views
      SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_by = $4, updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = $1
        AND company_id = $2
        AND user_id = $3
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      RETURNING id
    `,
    [viewId, context.companyId, context.userId, context.userId],
  );
  if (result.rows.length !== 1) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'The saved pipeline view was not found.');
  }
  return { id: String(result.rows[0].id) };
}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_settings (
  company_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  default_currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'KES',
  default_validity_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14 CHECK (default_validity_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365),
  terms_and_conditions TEXT,
  default_notes TEXT,
  email_message TEXT,
  primary_color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#164a9f',
  secondary_color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#0f172a',
  footer_text TEXT,
  allow_online_acceptance BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  allow_online_rejection BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  allow_partial_invoicing BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  require_billing_customer_for_invoice BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  invoice_policy VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ordered'
    CHECK (invoice_policy IN ('ordered','delivered')),
  lock_confirmed_orders BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  require_quote_approval BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  credit_limit_enforced BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  quote_approval_threshold NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quote_approval_threshold >= 0),
  updated_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_sequences (
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  document_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (document_type IN ('quote','order','shipment','return')),
  prefix VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  next_number BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (next_number > 0),
  padding INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6 CHECK (padding BETWEEN 1 AND 12),
  format VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '{prefix}{number}',
  updated_by UUID,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (company_id, document_type)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_quote_templates (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,
  is_default BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  notes TEXT,
  terms TEXT,
  footer_text TEXT,
  primary_color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#164a9f',
  secondary_color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#0f172a',
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_by UUID,
  updated_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_quote_templates_name
  ON public.sales_quote_templates(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(name)))
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_quote_templates_default
  ON public.sales_quote_templates(company_id)
  WHERE is_default = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  quote_number VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
    CHECK (status IN ('draft','sent','viewed','accepted','rejected','expired','cancelled','converted')),
  quote_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  valid_until DATE,
  currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'KES',
  base_currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'KES'
    CHECK (base_currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'),
  exchange_rate NUMERIC(19,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (exchange_rate > 0),
  exchange_rate_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  exchange_rate_source VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'base',
  base_total_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (base_total_amount >= 0),
  deposit_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
    CHECK (deposit_type IN ('none','percent','fixed')),
  deposit_value NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (deposit_value >= 0),
  reference VARCHAR(255),
  salesperson_user_id UUID,
  approval_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required'
    CHECK (approval_status IN ('not_required','draft','pending','approved','rejected')),
  approval_requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  approval_requested_by UUID,
  approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  approved_by UUID,
  approval_rejected_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  approval_rejected_by UUID,
  approval_rejection_reason TEXT,
  customer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  customer_email VARCHAR(255),
  customer_phone VARCHAR(80),
  customer_tax_id VARCHAR(120),
  billing_address TEXT,
  shipping_address TEXT,
  subtotal NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  discount_total NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tax_total NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  shipping_total NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT,
  terms TEXT,
  internal_notes TEXT,
  sales_order_id UUID,
  latest_invoice_id UUID,
  public_token_hash VARCHAR(64),
  public_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  viewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  accepted_by_name VARCHAR(255),
  accepted_by_email VARCHAR(320),
  acceptance_note TEXT,
  acceptance_signature_consent_text TEXT,
  rejected_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  expired_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  converted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_by UUID,
  updated_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_order_items_v2 (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sales_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_orders_v2(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  catalog_item_id UUID,
  external_product_id UUID,
  stock_reservation_id UUID,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  sku_snapshot VARCHAR(180),
  unit VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unit',
  quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity > 0),
  shipped_quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (shipped_quantity >= 0),
  delivered_quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (delivered_quantity >= 0),
  invoiced_quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (invoiced_quantity >= 0),
  unit_price NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
  discount_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'percent'
    CHECK (discount_type IN ('percent','fixed')),
  discount_value NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount_value >= 0),
  discount_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount_amount >= 0),
  tax_name_snapshot VARCHAR(180),
  tax_rate NUMERIC(8,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tax_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  tax_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tax_amount >= 0),
  subtotal NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (subtotal >= 0),
  line_total NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (line_total >= 0),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT sales_order_items_v2_shipped_quantity_lte_quantity
    CHECK (shipped_quantity <= quantity),
  CONSTRAINT sales_order_items_v2_delivered_quantity_lte_shipped
    CHECK (delivered_quantity <= shipped_quantity),
  CHECK (invoiced_quantity <= quantity)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_order_items_v2_order
  ON public.sales_order_items_v2(sales_order_id, sort_order, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_order_invoice_batches (

  source_reference VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  invoice_id UUID,
  status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'creating'
    CHECK (status IN ('creating','created','failed')),
  requested_lines JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  error_code VARCHAR(120),
  created_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_order_invoice_batches_key

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_order_invoice_batches_order

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

  );

    ON public.sales_teams(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(name)))
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

    ON public.sales_teams(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(code)))
    WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    ON public.sales_teams(company_id, is_active, name)
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_team_members (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    team_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'
      CHECK (role IN ('manager','member')),
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    ON public.sales_team_members(company_id, user_id, is_active);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_targets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    target_scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
      CHECK (target_scope IN ('company','team','user')),
    team_id UUID REFERENCES public.sales_teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id UUID,
    metric VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
      CHECK (metric IN ('revenue','margin','orders')),
    period_start DATE NOT NULL,
    period_end DATE NOT NULL,
    target_value NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (target_value >= 0),
    notes TEXT,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK (period_end >= period_start),
    CHECK (
      (target_scope = 'company' AND team_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL)
      OR (target_scope = 'team' AND team_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL)
      OR (target_scope = 'user' AND team_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL)
    )
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_targets_period
    ON public.sales_targets(company_id, period_start, period_end, target_scope)
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = TRUE;

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_commission_plans (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,
    code VARCHAR(80),
    basis VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
      CHECK (basis IN ('revenue','margin')),
    rate_percent NUMERIC(9,4) NOT NULL CHECK (rate_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    threshold_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (threshold_amount >= 0),
    cap_amount NUMERIC(18,2) CHECK (cap_amount IS NULL OR cap_amount >= 0),
    valid_from DATE,
    valid_until DATE,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until >= valid_from)
  );

  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_commission_plans_name
    ON public.sales_commission_plans(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(name)))
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_commission_plans_code
    ON public.sales_commission_plans(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(code)))
    WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_commission_assignments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_commission_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    assignee_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
      CHECK (assignee_type IN ('user','team')),
    user_id UUID,
    team_id UUID REFERENCES public.sales_teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    valid_from DATE,
    valid_until DATE,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until >= valid_from),
    CHECK (
      (assignee_type = 'user' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND team_id IS NULL)
      OR (assignee_type = 'team' AND user_id IS NULL AND team_id IS NOT NULL)
    )
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_commission_assignments_active
    ON public.sales_commission_assignments(company_id, plan_id, assignee_type, is_active);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_commission_entries (

    source_event_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    accrued_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    reversed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(company_id, source_event_key)
  );

  ALTER TABLE public.sales_sequences
    ADD CONSTRAINT sales_sequences_document_type_check
      CHECK (document_type IN ('quote','order','shipment','return'));

  INSERT INTO public.sales_sequences (
    company_id,
    document_type,
    prefix,
    next_number,
    padding,
    format
  )
  SELECT
    company_id,
    'shipment',
    'SHP-',
    1,
    6,
    '{prefix}{number}'
  FROM public.sales_sequences
  GROUP BY company_id
  ON CONFLICT (company_id, document_type)
  DO NOTHING;

  INSERT INTO public.sales_sequences (
    company_id,
    document_type,
    prefix,
    next_number,
    padding,
    format
  )
  SELECT
    company_id,
    'return',
    'RMA-',
    1,
    6,
    '{prefix}{number}'
  FROM public.sales_sequences
  GROUP BY company_id
  ON CONFLICT (company_id, document_type)
  DO NOTHING;

  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_returns (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    sales_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_orders_v2(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    return_number VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested'
      CHECK (status IN (
        'requested',
        'approved',
        'received',
        'credited',
        'partially_refunded',
        'refunded',
        'cancelled'
      )),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    credited_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    refunded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(company_id, return_number)
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_returns_order
    ON public.sales_returns(company_id, sales_order_id, created_at DESC);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_return_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    return_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_returns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sales_order_line_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_order_items_v2(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(return_id, sales_order_line_id)
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_return_items_line
    ON public.sales_return_items(company_id, sales_order_line_id);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_return_credits (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    return_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_returns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invoice_id UUID NOT NULL,
    credit_note_id UUID NOT NULL,
    credit_note_number VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL,
    amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (amount >= 0),
    available_credit NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (available_credit >= 0),
    refunded_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (refunded_amount >= 0),
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(return_id, invoice_id),
    UNIQUE(company_id, credit_note_id)
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_return_credits_return
    ON public.sales_return_credits(company_id, return_id, created_at);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_return_credit_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    return_credit_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_return_credits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    return_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_return_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    invoice_item_id UUID NOT NULL,
    quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(return_credit_id, return_item_id, invoice_item_id)
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_return_credit_items_return
    ON public.sales_return_credit_items(company_id, return_item_id);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_forecast_snapshots (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    as_of_date DATE NOT NULL,
    horizon_days INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (horizon_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365),
    open_pipeline NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    weighted_pipeline NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    committed_orders NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    expected_revenue NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(company_id, as_of_date, horizon_days)
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_forecast_snapshots_date
    ON public.sales_forecast_snapshots(company_id, as_of_date DESC, horizon_days);


-- Sales 3.4 lead and opportunity pipeline.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_pipelines (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  is_default BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_by UUID,
  updated_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_pipelines_company_name
  ON public.sales_pipelines(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(name)))
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_pipelines_company_default
  ON public.sales_pipelines(company_id)
  WHERE is_default=TRUE AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_pipelines_company_active
  ON public.sales_pipelines(company_id, is_active, sequence, LOWER(name))
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_pipeline_stages (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_id UUID NOT NULL,
    pipeline_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_pipelines(id),
    code VARCHAR(60),
    name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    probability NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (probability BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    stage_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (stage_type IN ('open','won','lost')),
    is_won BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    is_lost BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    fold_in_kanban BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    description TEXT,
    color VARCHAR(20),
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  );

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_pipeline_stages_company
    ON public.sales_pipeline_stages(company_id, is_active, sequence, name);

  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_pipeline_stages_company_pipeline_name
    ON public.sales_pipeline_stages(company_id, pipeline_id, LOWER(BTRIM(name)));

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_pipeline_stages_pipeline
    ON public.sales_pipeline_stages(company_id, pipeline_id, is_active, sequence, name);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_leads (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    lead_number VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

      CHECK (status IN ('new','contacted','qualified','disqualified','converted')),
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR(255),
    contact_name VARCHAR(255),
    email VARCHAR(320),
    phone VARCHAR(80),
    source VARCHAR(120),
    notes TEXT,
    salesperson_user_id UUID,
    sales_team_id UUID,
    territory_id UUID,
    converted_opportunity_id UUID,
    disqualification_reason TEXT,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_by UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  );

    ON public.sales_leads(company_id, lead_number) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

    subject VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' CHECK (status IN ('planned','completed','cancelled')),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_opportunity_activities_due

    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_quotes_opportunity
    ON public.sales_quotes(company_id, opportunity_id) WHERE opportunity_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL;
-- Advanced quote approval workflow (Sales 3.4.2).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_quote_approval_policies (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  min_quote_total NUMERIC(20,6),
  max_discount_percent NUMERIC(7,4),
  min_margin_percent NUMERIC(7,4),
  currency_code VARCHAR(3),
  created_by UUID,
  updated_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  CHECK (min_quote_total IS NULL OR min_quote_total >= 0),
  CHECK (max_discount_percent IS NULL OR max_discount_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  CHECK (min_margin_percent IS NULL OR min_margin_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_quote_approval_policies_company
  ON public.sales_quote_approval_policies(company_id, is_active, priority)
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_quote_approval_policy_steps (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  policy_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_quote_approval_policies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  step_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (step_order > 0),
  approver_user_id UUID,
  approver_role_key VARCHAR(120),
  required_approvals INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (required_approvals > 0),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(policy_id, step_order),
  CHECK (approver_user_id IS NOT NULL OR approver_role_key IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_quote_approval_policy_steps_policy
  ON public.sales_quote_approval_policy_steps(company_id, policy_id, step_order);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_quote_approval_requests (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  quote_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  policy_id UUID REFERENCES public.sales_quote_approval_policies(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  quote_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','superseded','cancelled')),
  current_step_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (current_step_order > 0),
  requested_by UUID,
  requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_quote_approval_request_pending
  ON public.sales_quote_approval_requests(company_id, quote_id)
  WHERE status = 'pending';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_quote_approval_requests_queue
  ON public.sales_quote_approval_requests(company_id, status, requested_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_quote_approval_decisions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL,
  request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sales_quote_approval_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  policy_step_id UUID REFERENCES public.sales_quote_approval_policy_steps(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  step_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (step_order > 0),
  reviewer_user_id UUID NOT NULL,
  decision VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('approved','rejected')),
  reason TEXT,
  decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(request_id, step_order, reviewer_user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_quote_approval_decisions_request
  ON public.sales_quote_approval_decisions(company_id, request_id, step_order, decided_at);

-- Product variants are first-class, company-scoped records. Each variant is
-- also represented by its own invoicing_catalog_items row so quote, order and
-- invoice lines keep the exact SKU/name/price snapshot selected by the user.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sales_product_variants (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  base_catalog_item_id UUID NOT NULL,
  variant_catalog_item_id UUID NOT NULL,
  variant_label VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  attributes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(attributes) = 'array'),
  unit_price NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
  unit_cost NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (unit_cost >= 0),
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_by UUID,
  updated_by UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_product_variants_catalog_item
  ON public.sales_product_variants(company_id, variant_catalog_item_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_sales_product_variants_sku
  ON public.sales_product_variants(company_id, LOWER(BTRIM(sku))) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = TRUE;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_product_variants_parent
  ON public.sales_product_variants(company_id, base_catalog_item_id, is_active, variant_label) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

import 'server-only';

import type {
  WorkspaceSearchProvider,
  WorkspaceSearchResult,
} from '@/lib/search/types';

import {
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
  searchSalesPipelineRecords,
  searchSalesRecords,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/service';


type RankedSalesSearchResult = {
  kind: string;
  recordId: string;
  sourceOrder: number;
  sourceIndex: number;
  result: WorkspaceSearchResult;
};


export const SALES_SEARCH_PROVIDER:
  WorkspaceSearchProvider = {
    key:
      'sales',

    search:
      async (
        context,
        query,
      ) => {
        const canSearchSalesRecords =
          context.isOwner ||
          context.permissionSet.has(
            SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW,
          );

        const canSearchSalesPipeline =
          context.isOwner ||
          context.permissionSet.has(
            SALES_PERMISSIONS.PIPELINE_VIEW,
          ) ||
          context.permissionSet.has(
            SALES_PERMISSIONS.PIPELINE_MANAGE,
          );

        if (
          !canSearchSalesRecords &&
          !canSearchSalesPipeline
        ) {
          return [];
        }

        const [
          rows,
          pipelineRows,
        ] = await Promise.all([
          canSearchSalesRecords
            ? searchSalesRecords(
                context.tenantId,
                context.companyId,
                query,
                20,
              )
            : Promise.resolve([]),
          canSearchSalesPipeline
            ? searchSalesPipelineRecords(
                context.tenantId,
                context.companyId,
                query,
                20,
              )
            : Promise.resolve([]),
        ]);

        const ranked: RankedSalesSearchResult[] = [
          ...rows.map(
            (
              row,
              index,
            ) => ({
              kind:
                row.kind,
              recordId:
                row.id,
              sourceOrder:
                0,
              sourceIndex:
                index,
              result: {
                id:
                  'sales:' +
                  row.kind +
                  ':' +
                  row.id,
                kind:
                  'record' as const,
                title:
                  row.number,
                subtitle:
                  row.customerName,
                description:
                  row.currency +
                  ' ' +
                  row.totalAmount
                    .toLocaleString(),
                href:
                  row.kind ===
                    'quote'
                    ? '/apps/sales/quotes/' +
                      row.id
                    : '/apps/sales/orders/' +
                      row.id,
                iconKey:
                  row.kind ===
                    'quote'
                    ? 'file-text'
                    : 'shopping-cart',
                badge:
                  row.status,
                score:
                  100 -
                  index,
                action:
                  null,
                source:
                  'sales',
              },
            }),
          ),
          ...pipelineRows.map(
            (
              row,
              index,
            ) => ({
              kind:
                row.kind,
              recordId:
                row.id,
              sourceOrder:
                1,
              sourceIndex:
                index,
              result: {
                id:
                  'sales:' +
                  row.kind +
                  ':' +
                  row.id,
                kind:
                  'record' as const,
                title:
                  row.title,
                subtitle:
                  row.subtitle,
                description:
                  row.description,
                href:
                  '/apps/sales/opportunities',
                iconKey:
                  row.kind ===
                    'lead'
                    ? 'user-round'
                    : 'trending-up',
                badge:
                  row.badge,
                score:
                  100 -
                  index,
                action:
                  null,
                source:
                  'sales',
              },
            }),
          ),
        ];

        ranked.sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) =>
            right.result.score -
              left.result.score ||
            left.sourceOrder -
              right.sourceOrder ||
            left.sourceIndex -
              right.sourceIndex,
        );

        const seen =
          new Set<string>();
        const results:
          WorkspaceSearchResult[] = [];

        for (
          const item
          of ranked
        ) {
          const key =
            JSON.stringify([
              item.kind,
              item.recordId,
            ]);

          if (
            seen.has(
              key,
            )
          ) {
            continue;
          }

          seen.add(
            key,
          );

          results.push(
            item.result,
          );

          if (
            results.length >=
            20
          ) {
            break;
          }
        }

        return results;
      },
  };

FILE: lib\apps\sales\target-attainment-report.ts

import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';
import { queryControl } from '@/lib/db/control';

export type SalesTargetAttainmentStatus = 'scheduled' | 'on_track' | 'at_risk' | 'achieved' | 'missed';

export type SalesTargetAttainmentRow = {
  id: string;
  targetScope: 'company' | 'team' | 'user';
  teamId: string | null;
  teamName: string | null;
  userId: string | null;
  salespersonName: string | null;
  metric: 'revenue' | 'margin' | 'orders';
  periodStart: string;
  periodEnd: string;
  targetValue: number;
  actualValue: number;
  attainmentPercent: number;
  elapsedPercent: number;
  status: SalesTargetAttainmentStatus;
  notes: string | null;
};

export type SalesTargetAttainmentReport = {
  companyCurrency: string;
  canViewTargets: boolean;
  rows: SalesTargetAttainmentRow[];
};

const EMPTY_REPORT: SalesTargetAttainmentReport = {
  companyCurrency: 'KES',
  canViewTargets: false,
  rows: [],
};

function dateOnly(value: unknown): string {
  return value == null ? '' : String(value).slice(0, 10);
}

function percent(actual: number, target: number): number {
  if (target <= 0) return actual > 0 ? 100 : 0;
  return Math.round((actual / target) * 1000) / 10;
}

function attainmentStatus(
  actual: number,
  target: number,
  start: string,
  end: string,
  today: string,
): { status: SalesTargetAttainmentStatus; elapsedPercent: number; attainmentPercent: number } {
  const startMs = Date.parse(start + 'T00:00:00Z');
  const endMs = Date.parse(end + 'T00:00:00Z');
  const todayMs = Date.parse(today + 'T00:00:00Z');
  const periodDays = Math.max(1, Math.floor((endMs - startMs) / 86_400_000) + 1);
  const elapsedDays = Math.max(0, Math.min(periodDays, Math.floor((todayMs - startMs) / 86_400_000) + 1));
  const elapsedPercent = Math.round((elapsedDays / periodDays) * 1000) / 10;
  const attainmentPercent = percent(actual, target);

  if (todayMs < startMs) {
    return { status: 'scheduled', elapsedPercent: 0, attainmentPercent };
  }
  if (todayMs > endMs) {
    return { status: actual >= target ? 'achieved' : 'missed', elapsedPercent: 100, attainmentPercent };
  }
  if (target <= 0 || attainmentPercent >= elapsedPercent) {
    return { status: 'on_track', elapsedPercent, attainmentPercent };
  }
  return { status: 'at_risk', elapsedPercent, attainmentPercent };
}

export async function getSalesTargetAttainmentReport(): Promise<SalesTargetAttainmentReport> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const companyCurrency = String(context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase();
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );
  const canViewTargets = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.TARGET_VIEW,
  ) || hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.TARGET_MANAGE,
  );

  if (!canViewReports || !canViewTargets) {
    return { ...EMPTY_REPORT, companyCurrency, canViewTargets: false };
  }

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      SELECT
        target.id::text AS id,
        target.target_scope,
        target.team_id::text AS team_id,
        CASE
          WHEN target.target_scope = 'team' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(team.name), ''), 'Inactive or unavailable team')
          ELSE NULL
        END AS team_name,
        target.user_id::text AS user_id,
        target.metric,
        target.period_start,
        target.period_end,
        CURRENT_DATE AS today,
        target.target_value,
        target.notes,
        COALESCE(actuals.order_count, 0)::numeric AS order_count,
        COALESCE(actuals.revenue_actual, 0)::numeric AS revenue_actual,
        COALESCE(actuals.margin_actual, 0)::numeric AS margin_actual
      FROM sales_targets target
      LEFT JOIN sales_teams team
        ON team.id = target.team_id
        AND team.company_id = target.company_id
        AND team.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)::numeric AS order_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(
            (sales_order.subtotal - sales_order.discount_total)
            * COALESCE(sales_order.exchange_rate, 1),
            2
          )), 0) AS revenue_actual,
          COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(
            COALESCE(sales_order.margin_amount, 0)
            * COALESCE(sales_order.exchange_rate, 1),
            2
          )), 0) AS margin_actual
        FROM sales_orders_v2 sales_order
        WHERE sales_order.company_id = target.company_id
          AND sales_order.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND sales_order.status IN ('confirmed', 'closed')
          AND sales_order.order_date BETWEEN target.period_start AND LEAST(target.period_end, CURRENT_DATE)
          AND (
            target.target_scope = 'company'
            OR (
              target.target_scope = 'team'
              AND sales_order.sales_team_id = target.team_id
            )
            OR (
              target.target_scope = 'user'
              AND sales_order.salesperson_user_id = target.user_id
            )
          )
      ) actuals ON TRUE
      WHERE target.company_id = $1
        AND target.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND target.is_active = TRUE
        AND target.period_end >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
        AND target.period_start <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '90 days'
      ORDER BY target.period_start DESC, target.period_end DESC, target.target_scope ASC, target.metric ASC
      LIMIT 250
    `,
    [context.companyId],
  );

  const userIds = Array.from(new Set(
    result.rows
      .map(row => row.user_id == null ? null : String(row.user_id))
      .filter((id): id is string => id !== null),
  ));
  let activeUsers: Array<{ user_id: string; name: string }> = [];
  if (userIds.length > 0) {
    const users = await queryControl(
      `
        SELECT tu.user_id::text AS user_id,
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(u.full_name, '')), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), u.email) AS name
        FROM tenant_users tu
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tu.user_id
        WHERE tu.tenant_id = $1
          AND tu.user_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
          AND tu.status = 'active'
          AND tu.member_type = 'internal'
          AND tu.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      `,
      [context.tenantId, userIds],
    );
    activeUsers = users.rows.map(row => ({
      user_id: String(row.user_id),
      name: String(row.name || 'Salesperson'),
    }));
  }
  const names = new Map(activeUsers.map(user => [user.user_id, user.name]));
  return {
    companyCurrency,
    canViewTargets: true,
    rows: result.rows.map(row => {
      const targetScope = String(row.target_scope) as 'company' | 'team' | 'user';
      const metric = String(row.metric) as 'revenue' | 'margin' | 'orders';
      const periodStart = dateOnly(row.period_start);
      const periodEnd = dateOnly(row.period_end);
      const targetValue = Number(row.target_value || 0);
      const actualValue = Number(
        metric === 'orders' ? row.order_count
          : metric === 'margin' ? row.margin_actual
            : row.revenue_actual,
      );
      const today = dateOnly(row.today);
      const progress = attainmentStatus(actualValue, targetValue, periodStart, periodEnd, today);
      const userId = row.user_id == null ? null : String(row.user_id);

      return {
        id: String(row.id),
        targetScope,
        teamId: row.team_id == null ? null : String(row.team_id),
        teamName: row.team_name == null ? null : String(row.team_name),
        userId,
        salespersonName: userId === null ? null : names.get(userId) || 'Inactive or unavailable user',
        metric,
        periodStart,
        periodEnd,
        targetValue,
        actualValue,
        attainmentPercent: progress.attainmentPercent,
        elapsedPercent: progress.elapsedPercent,
        status: progress.status,
        notes: row.notes == null ? null : String(row.notes),
      };
    }),
  };
}
